jobs.title: Security Engineer III/DLP
jobs.excerpt: By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful.
jobs.description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

Security Engineer III/DLP

.

Primary purpose


The Security Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining, monitoring, and managing secure solutions in accordance with the organization’s architectural designs, best practices, and regulatory or compliance requirements. As risks change, the engineer recommends modifications and enhancements so the organization keeps pace with the threat landscape, and contributes to the corporate security strategy alongside security leadership and senior technologists.


This role focuses on designing, implementing, and managing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Microsoft Purview solutions to protect sensitive organizational data. The engineer develops and enforces data protection policies, monitors data activity across endpoints, cloud services, and on-premises environments, and ensures compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements. The engineer also advances Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) capabilities by identifying data risks, improving data visibility, classifying sensitive information, and strengthening data governance and security controls.


The engineer’s work supports IT infrastructure, application development, security operations, security audit, and end users, with an emphasis on securing systems, applications, third-party connections, service providers, and business-to-business initiatives. The ideal candidate collaborates with cross-functional teams to continuously assess and improve the organization’s data security posture, respond to incidents, and align with evolving security standards and best practices.

Essential functions and responsibilities

Data protection and DSPM


  • Design, implement, and tune DLP and Microsoft Purview policies, including sensitivity labels, classification, and data protection controls across endpoints, cloud services, email, collaboration platforms, and on-premises repositories.
  • Monitor data activity, triage and investigate DLP alerts, and work with the SOC and incident responders on data exposure events.
  • Identify data risks, improve data visibility, and report on data security posture with measurable benchmarks.
  • Partner with data owners, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance to define classification schemes and handling requirements, and to support data governance.

Operations and delivery


  • Handle daily implementation, monitoring, and operational support of hardware, software, customer applications, managed solutions, and service provider relationships.
  • Deliver information security projects on time, within budget, and within SLAs, evaluating existing security infrastructure and proposing changes as directed by security leadership and architects.
  • Manage service and escalation tickets within SLA expectations.
  • Participate regularly in change and project management meetings, and work closely with project managers to meet milestones.
  • Develop security test plans from architectural designs, identify deficiencies, and make enhancements so production is not impacted.
  • Research, validate, and deploy solutions that meet security and business needs, following security engineering fundamentals and processes in NIST 800-160.

Incident response


  • Assist with incident response and system stability issues, which may include involvement outside regular work hours.
  • Influence the planning and execution of incident response and postmortem exercises, with measurable benchmarks that show progress or gaps.

Automation and improvement


  • Develop technical solutions and new security tools to mitigate vulnerabilities and automate repeatable tasks, enabling the team to focus on more advanced work.
  • Conduct performance testing to stress the limits of security solutions without harming business processes.
  • Lead IT groups and business units as needed in troubleshooting compatibility issues between security tools and business or productivity programs.

Communication and collaboration


  • Work with architects, the SOC, incident responders, and infrastructure and development teams.
  • Analyze client and customer needs and provide clear, concise reports to leadership.
  • Work with management on assigned projects from inception through implementation, maintaining internal communication and user involvement.
  • Provide feedback and suggestions to management to improve IT security processes and procedures.

Additional functions


  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Travel as required.

Qualifications

Education and licensing


  • Bachelor’s degree in management information systems or a related field, and be pursuing a master’s degree in business administration or an IT-related field. Licenses as needed.

Experience


  • Three or more years of experience in cybersecurity with a systems or network security engineering background.
  • Preferably 2+ years of additional IT experience in technology design, implementation, and delivery.
  • Hands-on experience with DLP and Microsoft Purview, including sensitivity labels, DLP policy design, and data classification.
  • Extensive knowledge of traditional and modern security controls, such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, PKI, IDAM, antivirus, firewalls, EDR, threat intelligence platforms, security automation and orchestration, deception technologies, and application controls.
  • Experience managing SIEM, threat intelligence, automation and orchestration, IDS/IPS, file integrity monitoring (FIM), DLP, and other monitoring tools.

Preferred experience


  • DSPM tools and practices.
  • Application control listing software, SIEM solutions, and XDR solutions.
  • Artificial intelligence and machine learning, including data security considerations for AI.
  • CIS hardening.
  • Researching and advising leadership on emerging security technologies.
  • One or more of ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS, HIPAA, HITECH, SOX, GDPR, CIS standards, or SOC 2.

Skills and knowledge


  • Ability to work independently and solve problems as they arise.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with integrity.
  • Ability to continuously learn new technologies and guide team collaboration.
  • CIA triad and IT security frameworks expertise.
  • CISSP preferred. CISM, SANS, Microsoft security certifications (such as SC-401), or other security-related certifications are a plus.

Work environment


  • When applicable and appropriate, reasonable accommodations will be considered.
  • Mental: clear, conceptual thinking, excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle stress, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.
  • Physical: computer keyboarding; travel as required.
  • Auditory/visual: hearing, vision, and talking.

Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. jobs.excerpt: You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact.
jobs.description:
You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact.

If you dream of a life that is more like an adventure than a stable life, then becoming the AI-native right hand of our CEO is for you.

This isn’t another chief of staff or right hand job.

Most companies call themselves AI-first because they gave everyone a ChatGPT licence. We think that’s level 2, and there are 10.

At Paradox our ambition is $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. Here, AI doesn’t assist the work. It runs the loops, in every department. Your job is to make that true for the whole company, side by side with the CEO.

But wait a minute.

Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…

  • 🗽Freedom: working remotely or hybrid, and being trusted to deliver

  • 🔥Ambition: building one of the first truly AI-native companies, with teammates who push AI to its limits every week

  • 😍Impact: changing the trajectory of a whole company, not one line of a roadmap, with a product that transforms people’s lives at scale

Then, you have found the next adventure that will fulfill you.

WHAT AI-NATIVE MEANS AT PARADOX 🤖

In a company of fewer than 10 people, the right hand used to be the person who absorbed everything the CEO couldn’t do. Here, the right hand builds the machine that does it.

Our company has to be able to:

  1. Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, decisions, procedures, member stories and past experiments, in one shared company brain that every person and every agent reads before acting.

  2. Turn every decision into execution. A meeting, a voice note or a call with the CEO becomes briefs, tickets, follow-ups and deadlines, without anyone retyping it.

  3. Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: agents read and write in our whole stack, from code to CRM, billing, analytics, ads, email, calendar and documents.

  4. Ship. Produce the analysis, the contract draft, the page, the offer or the process, and put it live.

  5. Measure with real KPIs. Revenue, cash, margin, retention and the transformation of our members, not activity.

  6. Learn and loop on its own. Keep what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

People set the ambition, the taste and the standards. The machine runs the loop, and gets better every week.

This is already real. Our company brain holds our decisions and procedures. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment with its result. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars and audit our tracking after every live. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day, by text and by voice.

But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY? 😉

We believe self-help is broken. Most people use learning platforms the same way: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

They deserve more than content and more than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges and grows with them.

That’s why we merge:

  • Human Intelligence (coaches, peers and mentors)

  • Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)

  • Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

into one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS, the Operating System for Human Greatness, augmented with AI.

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world, and for something that will outlive any individual, its founder included.

Here’s the bet: A small team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

And that’s where you come in.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company.

Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches.

The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls. With fewer than 10 people, there is no department to hand things to. You build it.

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

1 - Be the CEO’s operating system

  • ❌The old way: a chief of staff takes notes in meetings, chases people by email and builds the weekly report by hand.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every CEO decision into execution. Meetings, voice notes and calls become briefs, tickets and follow-ups. Every Monday, the CEO gets one brief: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs his call.

  • You decide what the CEO must see and what he never needs to see again. His time goes to vision, product and members, not to coordination.

2 - Run strategic projects as a Pirate Squad of one, plus agents

Depending on your zone of genius, these are examples of strategic projects you could own:

  • Growth: run experiments with agents that generate, ship and measure them

  • Partnerships & sponsorships: find and close partners aligned with our brand, for our YouTube channel and events

  • International: build the machine that turns our French content into English, and open new countries

  • Launches: take a new offer or product from idea to live

  • People: find and assess the rare people who join a team of fewer than 10

  • ❌The old way: each new initiative needs a team, a roadmap and three months.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: one person with the right agents launches an offer, a channel or a country without disrupting the core. That’s what our Pirate Squad means now.

3 - Build AI-native operations

  • ❌The old way: an ops manager processes invoices, chases contracts, onboards people and answers the same support questions every week.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: finance, legal, HR, admin and customer support each get their agents, their context, their KPIs and their loop. You write the skills, plug them into our tools and write the evals that define "good": a reconciliation that matches to the cent, a contract that respects our playbook, an answer a member is happy with.

  • You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. An agent moves up a level only when its track record earns it.

  • Example: in your first month, you build the agent that reconciles payments, refunds and failed charges every night. In month one it only reports. By month three it fixes the simple cases alone, and you only see the exceptions.

4 - Strategy and business intelligence that check themselves

  • ❌The old way: someone builds dashboards in a BI tool, exports them to a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody fully trusts the numbers.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: agents watch revenue, cash, acquisition, retention, churn and competitors continuously, find where our sources disagree, and explain what changed and why.

  • Strategy: screen markets and competition, build growth models, explore business models, partnerships and acquisitions. Then challenge, formalize and ensure good execution of the strategy.

  • At Paradox things move fast, and our CEO is always reading business books and meeting great entrepreneurs. You’ll turn the best strategies and tactics into systems and agents the whole company uses.

5 - Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul

  • ❌The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: every decision, result and lesson goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before acting. The company never learns the same lesson twice.

  • You measure the machine itself: the share of work done without a human, the time from decision to execution, the agents that moved up an autonomy level this month, and revenue per person. You push those numbers up.

  • You help the team become AI-native too: you spot the work still done by hand, and you build the agent or show a teammate how to build it.

  • And always: our members trust us with their lives. No fake claims, no fake scarcity, data handled with care. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. People do.

How you’ll know you’re AI-native: you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. The company’s output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF? 😍

Experience

  • Top tier Business or Engineering School (HEC, ESSEC, INSEAD, EM Lyon, EDHEC, ESCP, Stanford, …) or other high-level academic training (Les Mines, X, Sciences Po Paris, etc.)

  • A wide-scope role behind you: founder, chief of staff, founder’s associate, strategy, consulting or operations in a fast-growing startup

  • You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, agent SDKs, MCP, automations, APIs, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

Traits

  • Driven with strong work ethic: this position requires a strong commitment and perseverance

  • Entrepreneurship spirit: able to own a project from scratch, with few resources and little guidance, doing a lot yourself

  • Builder, not coordinator: you’d rather build the agent than chase a person twice

  • Taste: you know the difference between an output that works and one that is great, and you hold agents to the second

  • Growth over ego: you are at ease with regular feedback, obsessed with learning and growing, able to put your ego aside

  • Analytical and system thinker: you quickly identify and formulate problems, and solve complex ones with data

  • Excels in communication: both written and verbal

Language

French: native or bilingual. English: fluent, you can hold a detailed conversation with English-speaking colleagues. Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

  • We are inspired by a culture of performance and ambition. Everything is fast-paced and there is a lot of change. You won’t always be told what to do or how to do it.

  • We tell each other things, even if they are uncomfortable. We value growth over ego. At Paradox, expressing disagreement to a manager and knowing how to debate is valued! We encourage critical and strategic thinking.

  • ❌ If you use AI for first drafts but your way of working looks the same as two years ago: wrong role.

  • ❌ If you want to manage a lot of people: we aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each managing a dozen agents.

  • ❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If all this makes sense with you, then we’ll love working with you (and you with us, you’ll be pampered!)

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Build one of the first truly AI-native companies from inside the CEO’s office, and write the playbook others will copy. You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

A work with Impact, Freedom and Ambition

Growth & Ambition 🚀

  • 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform, whilst being in a good mood

  • 🏋️‍♀️No more bosses, but ongoing conversations to support your growth

  • ⚡️Learning to build with AI faster than almost anywhere else

Impact & Meaning 🔥

  • 🦄Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products are used by millions of people

  • 🤩Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something! We receive messages every day from members who quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships and changed their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽☀️

  • 😎A company culture based on autonomy & accountability

  • 🗽Flexible working hours (but very hard working)

  • 🌎A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want

  • 🧍‍♀️Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices

  • 💻Work on Mac

  • 🏀350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, a dance class or whatever makes you feel great)

  • 📚150€ of books or education: at Paradox, we are learner lovers

  • 🔥Access to Athena, our AI coach, supporting you on anything personal or professional

HOW TO APPLY 📃

❌ Any copy-pasted and non-personalized application goes directly to the trash can.

⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this: do not apply ⚠️

Hiring process

  • 📃 A 6 to 8 minute application survey, with a short video and a link to something you built with AI

  • 💻 A 30-minute video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

  • 🛠️ A live build session: you solve a real Paradox problem with AI in front of us. We look at how you prompt, push back on the output and iterate, more than at a polished result.

  • 💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

  • 💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, on the company’s next milestones and how you’d build them

  • 💼 Reference calls with your previous managers

  • 🤗 Welcome aboard!

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀

The Regional Account Manager (RAM) is a client-facing leader responsible for managing and growing strategic client relationships across a defined territory. The RAM owns client satisfaction, growth targets, and the seamless coordination of internal WWHS teams to meet client needs. In addition to managing current accounts, the RAM plays a key role in identifying and securing new business opportunities, expanding portfolios, and supporting the long-term success of WWHS.

Responsibilities

Existing Client Mangement

  • Be the primary face of WWHS for assigned client accounts, managing relationships across all stages of the service lifecycle (onboarding, recruitment, immigration, and arrival).
  • Lead monthly client meetings and weekly status calls, responding promptly and professionally to all client requests.
  • Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders, including C-suite executives.
  • Plan and lead on-site client visits, including agenda development and presenting to executive leadership.
  • Drive S&OP planning by forecasting needs and securing re-orders in alignment with client hiring goals.

  • Monitor and report on key account metrics to track performance, growth, and service quality.
  • Identify client needs, pain points, risks, and experience challenges, and lead resolution efforts internally.
  • Document all client interactions and updates using CRM systems to ensure full transparency and continuity.

New Business Development

  • Identify and attend relevant business development (BD) events to generate new client leads.
  • Follow up with leads using the approved lead management process and CRM documentation.
  • Build strategic relationships with new and prospective clients, including executive-level engagement.
  • Own targets for new business growth and portfolio expansion within your territory.
  • Prioritize high-value accounts and direct resources accordingly to ensure maximum ROI.
  • Drive visibility and engagement with potential clients via LinkedIn and other channels.

Cross-Functional & Strategic Collaboration

  • Partner with internal WWHS teams to troubleshoot and resolve client-related issues quickly and effectively.
  • Document risks, issues, and action items to support business operations and project management.
  • Represent cross-functional needs of the business to the client, ensuring a unified, value-driven experience.
  • Keep business leaders informed of client updates, risks, and opportunities.
  • Contribute proactively to WWHS strategy discussions by sharing market trends, client feedback, and process improvement ideas.

Operational Excellence

  • Champion process rigor and continuous improvement, both internally and externally.

Through our industry-leading brands – OtterBox and OtterCares – we provide our partners and customers the number one selling and most trusted products in our categories. Responsibilities

jobs.description:
Who we are

Arkeus builds AI-powered sensing systems that help autonomous platforms detect, track and understand what's happening in the most complex and contested environments. Our technology is deployed across defence and national security applications — already protecting lives and strengthening security across the U.S. and allied markets.

Backed by QIC, Main Sequence, R+VC, Salus Ventures, Folklore Ventures, DYNE Ventures and Beaten Zone Venture Partners, Arkeus is entering a major growth phase. We are a small, fast-moving company with the energy and ambition of a start-up and the technical credibility of a world-class defence technology provider.

We work at the intersection of optics, autonomy, robotics and real-time AI and we deploy what we build. If you want to ship technology that matters, not technology that ships decks, this is where you belong.

Check it yourself on News | Arkeus

We have developed an inclusive, transparent and engaging culture that focuses on building a diverse workforce — realising that to attract the very best, we need to ensure our culture is ready to welcome people from all ages, genders and backgrounds.

About the Role

As the Business Development Director for US, your primary mission is to get Arkeus’ autonomous sensing systems and edge-AI perception payloads, led by our Warden, integrated and deployed into the US military’s uncrewed aerial fleet. This is an elite hunter role. You will own the sales pipeline, customer relationships, and capture strategies for US Department of Defense (DoD) UAS programs, Group 1 through Group 4.

You will focus heavily on two fronts: winning prime opportunities directly with DoD innovation and acquisition branches (e.g., DIU, AFRL, NAVAIR, Army PM UAS), and driving sub-contract integration wins by selling directly to Tier-1 and Tier-2 UAS Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). You will turn technical demonstrations into multi-million-dollar production contracts.

As an entrepreneur, you will become a trusted advisor within the US autonomous systems ecosystem – developing opportunities to extend the value we can bring through extensions to our current products, or drive evolutions through close collaboration with our advanced development and product teams.

About You

You are a relentless defense business development professional with an established, active network in the US military UAS ecosystem. You know the programs, the key decision-makers, and the major industry primes. You aren't just a relationship manager; you understand payload integration, SWaP-C (Size, Weight, Power, and Cost) constraints, and how computer vision, machine learning and artificial intelligence changes the game for ISR.

You thrive in high-autonomy, venture-backed startup environments. You don't wait for incoming leads—you actively map requirements, identify program gaps, and position our technology as the must-have solution for software-defined warfare.

You thrive in ambiguity, excel at translating cutting-edge AI capability into high-value customer propositions, and know how to build pipelines with a strong MOAT from the ground up.

 

What You'll Do

  • Trusted Advisor: Develop a trusted advisor relationship with key stakeholders and influencers within the US Department of Defence (DoD) and US OEM’s
  • Pipeline Execution: Source, qualify, and close multi-million-dollar sales opportunities within the US Air Force, Army, Navy, Marine Corps, and Special Operations UAS, or related, programs.
  • OEM Account Management: Establish and scale strategic commercial relationships with leading US UAS manufacturers to design Arkeus payloads into their next-generation airframes.
  • Capture & Proposal Leadership: Lead the capture strategy for targeted US government RFPs, OTAs, and SBIR/STTR transitions. Write winning proposals backed by deep technical understanding.
  • Mission-Aligned Selling: Translate complex user requirements (e.g., GPS-denied navigation, autonomous targeting, multi-domain ISR) into tailored Arkeus system configurations.
  • Flight Tests & Demos: Coordinate and execute high-impact product demonstrations and military flight trials alongside our technical Customer Success and Integration teams.
  • Market Intelligence: Feed critical US customer requirements, policy updates (such as Replicator initiatives), and competitor insights back to the product and engineering teams, driving information sharing through our CRM.
  • Leadership: Demonstrate leadership through example by putting our customers first through a culture of leadership, ownership, disruption and audacity.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days:

  • You have mapped the top 10 US military UAS program opportunities and Tier-1 OEM targets for Arkeus.
  • You have established a seamless working rhythm with the US leadership and international product and engineering teams.
  • You have secured your first set of introductory pipeline meetings with target program offices or OEMs.

In your first year:

  • You have successfully secured at least two major program wins or hardware integration contracts with US defense UAS customers/primes.
  • You have built a robust, qualified multi-year sales pipeline that ensures predictable revenue growth for the US entity.
  • Arkeus is actively participating in key US military operational exercises and flight demonstrations.
  • You have established Arkeus as the premier choice for autonomous sensing payloads among targeted US drone manufacturers

 

Your Experience and Skills

  • Defense BD Track Record: 5+ years of proven success in defense business development, capture management, or sales, with a verifiable history of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • UAS Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of the uncrewed aerial systems market, including payloads, sensors (EO/IR, radar), open architectures (MOSA), and autonomous software.
  • Procurement Fluency: Comprehensive understanding of US DoD procurement pathways, budget cycles, and contract vehicles (e.g., FAR, non-FAR, OTAs).
  • Technical Credibility: Ability to confidently discuss sensor specifications, edge-computing limits, and airborne software architectures with military operators and aerospace engineers.
  • Military/Industry Network: An active, relevant network of contacts across the US DoD UAS program offices and defense aerospace primes.
  • Clearance: Must hold, or be readily capable of obtaining, a U.S. Secret (or higher) security clearance. (Prior military or civil service experience is highly valued).
  • Culture: Passion for a fast-paced, dynamic, and creative environment that prioritizes our Customers receiving a Compelling Experience through demonstration of leadership, ownership, disruption and audacity.
  • Travel: Must be willing to travel up to 50%.

 

What We Offer

  • You will work on the hardest problems in deep-tech — optics, autonomy, real-time AI and hardware-software integration in a single product. The gap between what you build and where it ends up is almost nonexistent.
  • You will collaborate with exceptional leaders who have decades of combined experience in AI, optics and defense. You will be learning from — and contributing to — the best in the field.
  • You will become part of a close-knit, ego-free team where ideas compete on merit, not seniority. Low politics, high trust. The kind of team you will still be talking about in ten years.
  • You will work hard and be expected to bring your best — and in return you will grow faster than you ever would at a large organization.
  • You will work on technology that is already deployed in real environments — protecting lives and strengthening security across defense and national security applications.
  • You will receive a competitive, market-benchmarked salary, structured career pathways built to grow with you, and the opportunity to participate in our Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP).
  • You will have the opportunity to mentor bright emerging talent through our highly sought-after intern program and strong connections with leading universities.

 

If this sounds like you, please apply even if you don't check every box listed above, and join our growing team in improving security and saving lives!

jobs.title: Project Manager (ERP Automation)
jobs.excerpt: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne, where we have recently established new BLP hubs.
Regardless of your location, you will start with a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month). Afterwards, you can work from home or from one of our hubs, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region.
Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by BLP.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Project Manager, most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.

You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

  • Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

  • Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

  • Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

For the Project Manager level

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • The ability to run several projects at once without losing control of any of them.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

Job Title: Medical Writer

Department: Study Set Up

SUMMARY

The Medical Writer is responsible for interpreting complex clinical study protocols and other medical/scientific documentation to prepare and coordinate laboratory specification and study‑specific medical/technical documents for ACM Global Laboratories. They will partner with internal departments in the development, drafting, review, editing, and finalization of documents used to conduct clinical studies.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development, revision, and maintenance of complex clinical study and amendments in accordance to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and regulatory requirements.
  • With support of a mentor, work on the development, revision, and maintenance of high profile and expedited complex study documents and amendments in accordance to SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Responsible for authoring and finalizing global lab specification documents (GLSD) and other related documents, as needed.
  • Interpret, understand, and contribute to the scientific details of the protocol/technical documentation; identify and resolve gaps to ensure client satisfaction.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert (SME) for medical documentation utilized throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Lead, initiate, and manage multiple rounds of internal and external document review.
  • Liaise and drive timely collaboration between key stakeholders to ensure technical documentation meet high quality standards and aligns with business process.
  • Participate in client interactions during study start-up activities and/or during study amendment process.
  • Review of low to medium complexity GLSD in accordance to SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • With support of a mentor, work on the review of high complexity GLSD in accordance with SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • Lead the development, revision, and maintenance of lab manuals in accordance to SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Review lab manuals to ensure alignment with SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • Resolve challenges and build consensus between all cross-functional groups and collaborators in a timely manner.
  • Maintain a general working knowledge of Food & Drug Administration (FDA), Medical & Healthcare Regulatory Agency (MHRA), New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH and other pertinent regulations.
  • Demonstrate initiative in professional self-development to improve job performance to maintain relevant working knowledge of clinical trials.
  • Resolve queries for complex studies by using knowledge of regional differences and internal ACM processes for low and medium complexity GLSD and understanding of department responsibilities.
  • Perform other duties and/or tasks as assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BA/BS, or equivalent experience in scientific field
  • 1 yrs clinical trials or other laboratory experience required

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Applied knowledge of routine document content preparation, including the use of style guides, medical dictionaries, regulatory guidance documents, and templates
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and desktop publishing or word processing
  • Education in medical or technical writing
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to effectively influence others, work in a team environment, and collaborate across lines of business and functions
  • 1+ years’ experience drafting clinical trials documentation

EDUCATION:

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. Some roles may require flexible hours, TB screening, or a valid driver’s license.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position.  Company: Blessed Accountants of GA, Inc.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Company: Blessed Accountants of GA, Inc. (BFG Tax) | Location: India, remote (Kochi preferred; qualified applicants
across India welcome)
Engagement: Independent consultant, fixed-fee project | Initial duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks
Reports to: Founder & CEO | Collaborates with: Finance, Delivery, Marketing, Sales and U.S. Securities & Corporate
Attorney
1. About BFG Tax
BFG Tax is a U.S.-based accounting, tax, payroll and financial advisory business established in 2004. The company is
planning industry-focused expansion supported by marketing, customer acquisition, technology, strategic partnerships and
centralized service delivery.
2. Position Overview
We seek a hands-on fractional CFO or corporate finance specialist in India to develop investor-ready financial models,
forecasts, valuation scenarios and capital requirements for a U.S. private fundraising initiative. This is not a routine
bookkeeping, tax compliance or accounting management position.
3. Fundraising Project
Stage Proposed funding objective
1 - Existing client relationships $50,000-$100,000
2 - Additional private investors Balance required to reach $250,000 cumulative
3 - Potential subsequent round $750,000
Overall potential financing Up to $1,000,000
Management is considering business loans, equity and convertible notes for the initial financing. The CFO will evaluate
financial implications; U.S. legal counsel will determine legal feasibility and securities compliance. The CFO must
independently assess whether proposed funding amounts are appropriate.
4. Key Responsibilities
A. Historical Financial Review
  • Review historical income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, liabilities and operating costs.
  • Reconcile records supplied by the Finance Manager; identify gaps and material assumptions.
  • Separate recurring, one-time, seasonal and project-based revenue and analyze revenue by service.
  • Assess cash balances, outstanding loans, working capital and U.S.-India cost arrangements.
B. Financial Modeling and Forecasting
  • Build an integrated, formula-driven and editable Microsoft Excel financial model.
BFG Tax | Recruitment - Fractional CFO Page 2
  • Prepare monthly 2027 forecasts, detailed January-June 2027 cash flow, a rolling 13-week cash forecast, and three-year
projections.
  • Produce conservative, base and growth scenarios, break-even, cash runway and sensitivity analysis.
  • Document data sources, drivers, assumptions and model checks.
C. Marketing and Customer Acquisition
  • Model the proposed January-June 2027 advertising budget of $155,000, subject to approval.
  • Analyze lead costs, lead qualification, conversion, onboarding, acquisition costs and recurring-revenue timing.
  • Test retention, service delivery costs, contribution margin and alternative marketing spend levels.
D. Capital Requirements and Use of Funds
  • Determine minimum viable capital needs and recommended financing schedule.
  • Produce use-of-funds and liquidity scenarios for $50,000, $100,000 and $250,000.
  • Assess operating reserves, funding milestones, and the timing and need for a later $750,000 round.
E. Financing Alternatives
  • Compare business loans, equity and convertible notes.
  • Model debt service, repayment, interest, dilution, conversion and subsequent fundraising effects.
  • Coordinate with securities counsel on S corporation constraints and permissible instruments; do not provide legal opinions.
F. Valuation and Investor Materials
  • Prepare supportable valuation methodologies and pre-/post-money capitalization scenarios.
  • Clearly distinguish total annual revenue from recurring revenue.
  • Prepare financial exhibits, risks, assumptions, sensitivities and presentation-ready schedules.
5. Required Deliverables
  • Historical financial review and findings memorandum.
  • Fully editable, integrated Excel model with transparent assumptions and formulas.
  • January-June 2027 cash-flow forecast and rolling 13-week cash forecast.
  • Three-year financial projections and conservative/base/growth scenarios.
  • Marketing and customer acquisition model.
  • Use-of-funds schedules for $50,000, $100,000 and $250,000.
  • Debt, equity and convertible-note financial comparison.
  • Valuation, capitalization and dilution scenarios.
  • Investor-ready financial summary and supporting exhibits.
  • Written recommendations on funding amount, timing and financial risks.
  • Management presentation and handover of all model files.
6. Required Qualifications
  • CA, CPA, CFA, MBA (Finance) or equivalent professional qualification; preferably 10+ years relevant experience.
  • Proven investor-ready modeling work for U.S. businesses, including financial statements and cash-flow analysis.
  • Advanced Excel skills, valuation, capitalization and scenario modeling.
  • Understanding of U.S. financial reporting and strong written/spoken English.
  • Availability for scheduled U.S. Eastern Time meetings.
BFG Tax | Recruitment - Fractional CFO Page 3
7. Preferred Experience
  • Fractional CFO or transaction advisory work for U.S. small and midsize businesses.
  • Private fundraising, recurring-revenue economics and professional services businesses.
  • U.S.-India outsourced operations and cross-border financial analysis.
  • Investor/lender due diligence; familiarity with Xero, QuickBooks or Zoho Books.
8. Timeline and Compensation
The engagement is expected to last approximately 4-6 weeks. An initial financial assessment and preliminary model are
expected within 1-2 weeks, followed by iterative review and final delivery. Candidates should propose a realistic milestone
schedule and fixed-fee quote, identifying payment milestones, assumptions, exclusions, revision costs and possible ongoing
advisory support.
The consultant is not authorized to solicit investors, negotiate securities transactions or receive transaction-based fundraising
compensation under this engagement.
9. Application Requirements
  • Resume or firm profile and summary of relevant U.S. work.
  • Two or three comparable project examples; redacted model sample where permitted.
  • Proposed approach, project timeline, fixed-fee quote and earliest start date.
  • References from relevant U.S. or international clients where available.
10. Selection Process
Shortlisted applicants will complete a technical interview covering minimum funding requirements, marketing-led cash
forecasts, a $100,000 debt-versus-equity comparison, valuation and dilution, and investor due diligence. A short paid
modeling exercise may be used for finalists.
11. Confidentiality and Ownership
Engagement is subject to signed confidentiality and consulting agreements. All BFG-specific models and deliverables must
be handed over in editable form, with ownership and permitted reuse governed by contract. Confidential company, client,
employee and investor information must be handled under approved security procedures.

jobs.excerpt: Full-time | Remote, U. S.  | 9 a. m.  to 5 p. m.  Central Who We Are and What We Do We believe the best marketing comes from what a business owner already knows.
jobs.description:
Full-time | Remote, U.S. | 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central

Who We Are and What We Do

We believe the best marketing comes from what a business owner already knows. Fluxe Digital Marketing is a content marketing agency that interviews business owners about their expertise, then turns one hour of their time each month into a month of content in their own voice. Since 2009 we have worked with more than 150 clients across more than 30 industries, from concierge medical practices to ecommerce brands.

Please take some time to learn about our mission and values. They drive everything we do.

Why This Role Exists

Search is changing. AI answers now handle more questions before anyone visits a site, so showing up in search no longer guarantees the click. We are hiring a strategist who knows search deeply and can work out what each client should do about it, then own the plan from start to follow-through.

If this sounds like the work you want to do, we’d like to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Lead search and AI visibility

  • Track each client’s rankings and how often AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Overviews mention and cite them.
  • Find out why traffic moved, and decide what to fix, refresh, write, or stop.
  • Turn that into a three-month plan our writers and web team can act on.
  • Write the copy that matters most for search: product, category, and landing page copy, content briefs, and titles and meta descriptions.
  • Write clear specs a developer can build from, such as page templates, redirects, and structured data.

Own each client’s plan

  • Write and update a three-month plan for each client you lead.
  • Turn every client call into clear next steps with an owner and a date, then follow up until each one is done.
  • Bring us ideas that grow each client’s results.

Run the monthly reports and call prep

  • Pull the numbers from GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and the ad platforms, and explain what changed and what we will do next.
  • Write the agenda for each client call so the team walks in ready.

jobs.description:
As a Customer Delivery Manager at vCluster Labs, you aren't just keeping a project plan up to date; you are the person who turns a signed AI Cloud deal into a platform that's live, consuming GPUs, and ready to expand. Our AI Cloud engagements are growing in number and complexity, and you will own each one from kickoff to handoff: the plan, the timeline, the scope, and the call when something is about to slip. You'll sit at the center of our AEs, AI infrastructure architects, customer engineering team, and executive leadership and make sure every customer always knows exactly where they stand.

As a Customer Delivery Manager, your role will include:

  • Owning engagements end to end: You own timeline management, scope, and outcome for every active AI Cloud engagement, from kickoff to handoff. You set the cadence, run the working sessions, and keep the work moving.

  • Building implementation plans customers trust: You'll write the plans our customers ask for, with prerequisites, dependencies, milestones, and change management built in. When scope shifts, you run change control.

  • Holding the team accountable: You depend on AEs, architects, and engineers internally and on customer teams externally. You chase the inputs that block progress, follow up on every open request, and escalate early when success is at risk.

  • Tracking GPU consumption: Revenue depends on consumption. You'll track when strategic accounts expect GPUs, whether they've landed, and when customers plan to deploy on our platform, even between active engagements, so we know who is consuming what they bought and where they can grow.

  • Keeping leadership informed: You'll own a weekly executive summary of every engagement: where it stands, what's at risk, and what you need. When something needs escalation, you make the ask and the next steps unmistakable.

  • Improving how we deliver: You'll spot where our delivery motion breaks, push back when something isn't working, and drive the process changes that fix it.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Multi-party delivery experience: You've run multi-month engagements across several internal and external parties, with real change control and governance. Internal-only project management won't be enough here.

  • Infrastructure fluency: Working knowledge of Kubernetes and data center infrastructure. You can follow a technical customer call and push it forward without needing to make the technical decisions yourself.

  • Executive communication: You can turn a messy engagement into a summary an executive reads in two minutes, and you can articulate an escalation and exactly what it needs.

  • Backbone: You're comfortable pushing back on peers, customers, and leaders, and you advocate for process change when the current way isn't working.

  • Customer delivery roots: A background in technical account management, professional services delivery, consulting engagement management, or management consulting.

  • Global flexibility: Based in North America (EMEA considered), and comfortable flexing early or late to work with customers and teammates in Europe.

Bonus points for:

  • AI Cloud experience: Time at an AI Cloud provider or an NVIDIA Cloud Partner.

  • Hyperscaler experience: Delivery or customer-facing work at a major cloud provider.

  • Infrastructure software services: Professional services or forward-deployed engineering at an infrastructure software company.

  • GPU ecosystem familiarity: You know how GPU capacity gets bought, delivered, and put to work.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: $160K - $190K

Job Title: General Manager Academic Accounts Enterprise Solutions International (f/m/d)

Job Location: Remote, Switzerland

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Description Summary As Academics Leader for international markets, you will shape and lead GE HealthCare’s academic strategy outside the United States, Canada and China. Academic medical centers and research institutions adopt advanced technology early, publish, shape guidelines and train the next generation of clinicians. When we win with academics, we influence the whole market. You will build and personally own the commercial account strategy and executive relationships for approximately 20 strategic academic accounts, develop the International Academics commercial framework and orchestrate execution with country and zone teams. You will partner closely with Scientific Affairs under clearly defined Research-Commercial rules of engagement. This role owns the commercial strategy, customer experience, pipeline and business results for the International Academics segment. Focus markets include the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Spain, Japan, South Korea, Australia and India, as well as the international accounts among GE HealthCare’s top 50 global academic accounts. At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs—the human touch. Job Description Your role: Commercial academic relationships and account strategy • Build and maintain trusted, senior relationships with leading academic medical centers, research institutions, universities and scientific societies in the focus markets. • Personally own a portfolio of about 20 strategic academic collaborations, from identification and structuring through governance, delivery and renewal. • Develop flagship, multi-year and cross-modality commercial partnerships and enterprise solutions, including differentiated customer experience and co-location models where appropriate. • Use proven models from the United States and Canada and scale them to international accounts. • Establish reference and showcase sites that demonstrate GE HealthCare solutions, customer outcomes and innovation adoption, with any research claims or scientific outputs led and approved through Scientific Affairs and the appropriate functions. International Academics commercial framework • Develop and own the international academic commercial framework: one engagement model, standard work for academic account management, rules of engagement, key performance indicators (KPIs) and governance, including executive and C-suite governance for strategic accounts. • Segment academic accounts, including research-active private accounts, and define targeted value propositions and growth plans for each segment. • Lead with differentiated entry points, such as care pathways, theranostics, photon-counting CT, nuclear medicine, AI and areas such as human performance and longevity. • Continuously improve the framework based on results, customer feedback and learnings from the United States and Canada. Country orchestration • Work hand in hand with country and zone leadership teams to embed academics in every focus country plan and in plans for the top 50 global academic accounts. • Orchestrate the framework across countries, aligning country commercial teams, segment and care pathway leaders, product teams and services behind shared academic priorities. • Coordinate a virtual network of country academic account leads, clinical specialists and regional academic leaders, with clear roles and accountability. • Share best practices and results across markets, and escalate and resolve barriers to collaboration quickly. Scientific Affairs partnership • Partner closely with Scientific Affairs while maintaining clear separation of commercial and research activities and following the agreed Research-Commercial rules of engagement. • Align commercial stakeholder mapping and engagement plans with the Scientific Affairs-led KOL framework. • Support adoption of new product introductions at academic accounts through coordinated commercial launch planning, customer readiness and white-glove application and service support • Translate existing, approved evidence and scientific outputs into compliant commercial value propositions and customer communications in partnership with Scientific Affairs, Marketing, Legal, Regulatory and Compliance. • Identify customer needs or opportunities related to research, grants, evidence generation, publications, symposia or scientific meetings and refer them to Scientific Affairs for assessment, ownership and execution. Commercial performance • Own orders, revenue and margin targets for the international academic segment, and grow GE HealthCare’s share of wallet in target academic accounts. • Build and manage the international academic commercial pipeline, and run a disciplined cadence of account plans, opportunity reviews and forecasts. • Work with country commercial teams to close large, multi-year academic deals. • Ensure all engagements follow research-commercial policies and quality, regulatory and integrity standards. Your profile: Required • A master’s degree or higher, such as a PhD, MD, MBA, MS or MPH, or equivalent professional experience • Significant progressive commercial or general-management leadership experience in complex healthcare, medtech or academic-health-system environments • Established, credible relationships with academic leaders, KOLs and research institutions in several of the focus markets • A proven record of developing and closing large, multi-year, multi-modality healthcare solutions or strategic commercial partnerships • Experience designing and rolling out frameworks, engagement models or standard work across multiple countries • Strong understanding of academic health-system operations, capital and technology investment decisions, procurement and complex enterprise selling • The ability to orchestrate complex, matrixed organizations across countries and functions, including close work with scientific, medical, legal and compliance teams • Excellent executive engagement, communication and negotiation skills • A strong commitment to Research-Commercial separation, compliance and integrity • Fluent English, and willingness to travel internationally about 50 percent of the time Preferred • Experience leading academic or enterprise accounts across Europe and Asia-Pacific • Knowledge of advanced imaging, theranostics, nuclear medicine, photon-counting CT or AI • Experience using Salesforce, commercial analytics and data-visualization tools to drive account execution • Additional languages relevant to the focus markets This role can be remote based anywhere in Europe or EEU. About us GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally. We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health - digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world. Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. GE HealthCare - Creating a world where healthcare has no limits Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No At GE HealthCare, we see possibilities through innovation. We’re partnering with our customers to fulfill healthcare’s greatest potential through groundbreaking medical technology, intelligent devices, and care solutions. Better tools enabling better patient care. Together, we are not only building a healthier future but living our purpose to create a world where healthcare has no limits.

Rolle: Sales Development Representative
Standort: Hybrid / Full Remote (Homeoffice in Österreich oder Deutschland / Wien/ Hamburg)
Die Mission:Eine digitale Welt ohne Barrieren

Bei Accessiway sind wir nicht einfach nur ein SaaS-Unternehmen; wir sind ein Scale-up, das mit Lichtgeschwindigkeit wächst und ein ehrgeiziges Ziel verfolgt: Technologie für alle zugänglich zu machen – ohne „Wenn“ und „Aber“. Wir glauben, dass Barrierefreiheit kein einfaches Häkchen auf einer Checkliste ist, sondern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen die Welt erleben und gestalten.

Als Sales Development Representative (SDR) baust du nicht einfach nur Kontaktlisten auf oder telefonierst Leads ab. Du bist der erste Berührungspunkt mit unserer Vision, der strategische Türöffner für Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Inklusion und die Schlüsselperson, die aus ersten Gesprächen echte Business-Chancen und konkreten gesellschaftlichen Impact entstehen lässt.

Was wir dir bieten (Über die üblichen Versprechen hinaus)

  • Echten Impact: Deine Arbeit legt den Grundstein für die digitale Transformation von Unternehmen und trägt direkt dazu bei, dass deren Produkte für mehr als 1,3 Milliarden Menschen weltweit nutzbar werden.

  • Ein Spitzen-Team & echte Verbindungen: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives, dem Marketing-Team und internen Stakeholder:innen zusammen – unterstützt durch regelmäßige Team-Events und interne Initiativen, die den Zusammenhalt stärken.

  • Autonomie, Growth & Ownership: Wir pflegen eine Kultur, in der deine Ideen zählen. Du erhältst viel Raum für persönliches Wachstum, Eigenverantwortung und tägliches Lernen in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

  • Radikale Inklusion: Wir sind ein dynamisches, internationales und inklusives Team mit mehr als 15 Nationalitäten, in dem Vielfalt aktiv gelebt wird.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Profitiere von einem flexiblen Arbeitsmodell (Full Remote oder Hybrid – ganz nach deinen Bedürfnissen), das dein Privatleben ebenso respektiert wie deine berufliche Effizienz.

Deine Mission bei Accessiway

Indem du das Fundament für unser Neukundengeschäft legst, konzentrierst du dich auf:

  • Lead-Generierung & Qualifizierung: Identifikation und Qualifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten durch gezielte Outbound-Aktivitäten (Calls, E-Mails, LinkedIn) sowie die Bearbeitung von Inbound-Anfragen.

  • Demo-Koordination & Pipeline-Aufbau: Planung und Organisation qualifizierter Produkt-Demos für unsere Account Executives, um den gesamten Verkaufsprozess optimal vorzubereiten und voranzutreiben.

  • Interne Synergien: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Account Executives, dem Marketing und weiteren internen Teams, um unsere gemeinsamen Verkaufsergebnisse zu maximieren.

  • CRM & Struktur: Konsequente Nutzung unseres CRM-Systems für eine strukturierte Verwaltung von Pipeline, Forecasts und täglichen Aktivitäten.

  • Markttrends & Regulierungen: Ständiges Auf-dem-Laufenden-Bleiben über aktuelle Trends, den Markt und Regulierungen (wie RGAA / EAA / BITV) im Bereich der digitalen Barrierefreiheit.

  • Sales-Kultur & Wachstum: Eine proaktive, neugierige und lernbereite Arbeitsweise, mit der du aktiv zum Wachstum und zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Sales-Teams beiträgst.

Was wir bei dir suchen

  • Du bringst 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in Sales-Rollen oder in der Lead-Generierung mit.

  • Du bist hochmotiviert, stark ergebnisorientiert und zeichnest dich durch eine hohe Belastbarkeit sowie Resilienz im Vertriebsalltag aus.

  • Du verfügst über hervorragende Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Beziehungsfähigkeiten, mit denen du potenzielle Kund:innen schnell abholst und begeisterst.

  • Du zeichnest dich durch ein hohes Maß an Organisationsfähigkeit und Selbstständigkeit aus, um deine Arbeit in einem dynamischen, stark wachsenden Umfeld effizient zu strukturieren.

  • Du verfügst über gute Grundkenntnisse in CRM-Systemen und modernen Sales-Tools (wie HubSpot, Lemlist, Lusha oder Apollo).

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Bonuspunkte, wenn:

  • Du bereits Erfahrung im B2B-, SaaS- oder Tech-Vertrieb gesammelt hast.

  • Du ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an digitalen, Web- oder IT-Lösungen mitbringst.

  • Du ein ehrliches Interesse und eine hohe Sensibilität für digitale Barrierefreiheit, Inklusion und gesellschaftlichen Impact mitbringst.

Bist du bereit, das Wachstum eines sinnstiftenden Projekts voranzutreiben?Bewirb dich jetzt – Werde Teil des Accessiway-Teams!

Das finale Angebot wird auf der Grundlage objektiver, geschlechtsneutraler Kriterien festgelegt (insbesondere relevanter Berufserfahrung, Senioritätsstufe und für die Stelle erforderlicher Kompetenzen), die im Einklang mit unserem internen Stellenbewertungssystem einheitlich auf alle Bewerber:innen angewendet werden. Bewerber:innen können weitere Informationen zu den Kriterien anfordern, die für die Gehaltsentwicklung innerhalb dieser Spanne herangezogen werden.

Accessiway ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir feiern Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeiter:innen zu schaffen.
