jobs.description:
Work Schedule

Standard Office Hours (40/wk)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

Join Us as a Senior Project Manager - Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

The Senior Project Manager serves as the Project Lead and primary sponsor contact and is accountable for capturing and organizing scientific operations information (i.e. projects, work packages, dates, etc.) for BBP working with Group Leaders in BBP and Biosampling Project Leaders/Managers on clinical teams.


The Senior Project Manager establishes and communicates customer expectations to the project team with minimal direction and ensures that escalation pathways are adhered to internally and externally. The role involves leading the cross functional project team to meet or exceed deliverables and managing project(s) of increasing complexity (such as but not limited to: multi-service, multi/region/country, therapeutic complexity, financial scope).

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with group leaders, the BESM, and Immunogenicity leads.
  • Collaborate with BPL and BPM colleagues to ensure work packages are correctly set up and maintained in Tracker and Planisware.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting for the portfolio of work.
  • Provide operational support and act as a regular touchpoint between the scientific teams and operations teams
  • Serve as the primary contact between the sponsor and the organization at the project level.
    •Ensure escalation pathways adhered to internally and externally (Rules of Engagement – communication pathways).
    •On projects where the scope requires, ensure clear delineation in responsibilities and communication pathways for secondary project leads (such as lead in a specific region, lead for a specific vendor(s) or subset of delivery).
    •Drive and own the overall delivery of the cross-functional project (time, cost, quality).
    •Ensure financial stewardship at a project level by demonstrating an intimate understanding of the contract, resource alignment to budget, management of Out of Scope activity, drive the Con Mod process/negotiations and team execution to timelines.
    •Establish, communicate and manage customer expectations to achieve optimal delivery during the project.
    •Drive Risk Identification and Issue Resolution at project level (RBQM/RESOLVE).
    •Ensure project team compliance with organization policies, SOPs, ICH- GCP, regulatory and project specific requirements.

•Act as a mentor.

  • Develop or contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Education & Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification (ideally with PM certification)
    •Previous Project Management experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 8+ years’).

    Years of experience refers to typical years of related experience needed to gain the required knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the essential functions of the job. Years of experience are not to be used as the only determining factor in establishing the job class or making employment selection decisions.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Strong aptitude with AI tools and Planisware-type systems
  • Technical and systems competency, such as computer skills, to include effective use of systems and applications such as Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, as well as organization systems (CTMS, Preclarus, Clarity)
    •Ability to delegate and effectively prioritize workload and resources for project team members in a frequently changing environment
    •Effective oral and written communication and presentation skills
    •Proactive, solutions oriented and adaptable in changing priorities and situations
    •In-depth therapeutic area knowledge and clinical development guidelines and directives
    •Advanced knowledge of the key principles of cross functional project management (Time, Quality, Cost)
    •Effective interpersonal including the ability to lead, motivate and coordinate cross-functional project teams
    •Strong customer service skills with the ability to proactively address and prioritize expectations
    •Good judgment and decision making skills and proven ability to apply critical and analytical
    strategic thinking skills to manage complex/ambiguous situations
    •Strong negotiation skills with ability to influence others and achieve results, including a cross cultural awareness
    •Strong financial acumen with the knowledge and ability to minimize risk by proactively managing and adjusting budgets/forecasts/resources
    •Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Working Conditions and Environment:

  • Work supports BBP across the US and UK. Proximity to the Upper Providence, PA location for USA or Stevenage for UK is a nice to have as on-site presence is desirable but not required.
  • Work is performed in an office/ laboratory and/or a clinical environment.
    •Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
    •Exposure to electrical office equipment.
    •Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.

Why Join Us?

An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives.Come join the excellence!

Overview

The Voice and Hosted Cloud Connect Product Architect, working within TNS’s Communications market and under the Global Network Planning umbrella, will work to support the design and deployment related to LTE and 5G Roaming, and IMS/VoLTE services involving both signaling and user plane traffic. This position needs SME knowledge of voice interconnects via legacy- and VoIP-modeled systems; integration and testing support; SS7, SIP, ENUM, REST, and Diameter protocols; and cross-functional work experience.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead or supporting architect for TNS voice, VoIP, Hosted Cloud Connect, cloud communications, and carrier voice products.
  • Establish and maintain end-to-end architecture for Hosted Cloud Connect and associated voice services, including application, signaling, media, routing, security, monitoring, provisioning, billing, and operational-support components.
  • Translate Product roadmaps, customer requirements, commercial opportunities, and operational needs into documented technical architectures, implementation plans, product requirements, and engineering deliverables.
  • Partner with Product Management to evaluate and develop new voice capabilities, including call recording, softphone services, network call screening, carrier-direct voice services, call authentication, and other cloud-based voice applications.
  • Support Sales, Business Development, and Product teams during customer discovery, solution design, technical presentations, feasibility assessments, and responses to complex customer requirements.
  • Provide architectural leadership for integrations involving newly acquired voice platforms, third-party applications, internal TNS infrastructure, and external carrier or cloud environments.
  • Lead architectural planning for voice-platform modernization, consolidation, migration, and retirement initiatives, including the transition of services between legacy and strategic platforms.
  • Work directly with strategic technology partners and vendors, including Ribbon and other voice-platform providers, to evaluate roadmaps, resolve design or interoperability issues, and influence product capabilities needed by TNS.
  • Define voice service call flows, application interactions, routing logic, resiliency models, failover behavior, capacity requirements, security controls, and service-quality requirements.
  • Provide technical leadership for interoperability, integration, performance, resiliency, and customer-acceptance testing across SIP, IMS, SBC, media, application-server, and carrier-interconnect environments.
  • Support the investigation and resolution of complex production issues involving SIP call flows, call routing, media, interoperability, voice applications, SBCs, service platforms, and carrier interconnections.
  • Ensure new and modified voice products meet development, security, operational, monitoring, capacity, support, and commercial-readiness requirements before production deployment.
  • Identify architectural risks, platform dependencies, technical debt, scalability limitations, concentration-of-knowledge risks, and opportunities for simplification or automation.
  • Maintain current and target-state architecture documentation, including:
    • Product Architecture Design Documents
    • High-level and detailed solution diagrams
    • SIP call-flow and service-interaction diagrams
    • Platform integration and dependency models
    • Make-versus-buy analyses
    • Technical and operational impact assessments
    • Capacity and scalability models
    • Resiliency and failover scenarios
    • Monitoring and event-management requirements
    • Development, QA, and test-environment requirements
    • Security and compliance requirements
    • Test strategies and test-result assessments
    • Deployment, migration, and operational-readiness plans
    • Product lifecycle and platform-retirement recommendations
  • Communicate architectural decisions, alternatives, risks, costs, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Provide technical mentorship and domain guidance to Engineering, Operations, Product, and other architecture resources to broaden organizational voice and HCC expertise.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Seven or more years of telecommunications experience, with significant experience designing, integrating, deploying, or supporting carrier-grade voice, VoIP, or cloud communications solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience in voice application, solution, or product architecture, including the ability to take a voice capability from business concept and customer requirements through technical design, testing, deployment, and operational readiness.
  • Deep knowledge of SIP, SIP call flows, session management, call routing, number translation, media negotiation, voice interconnection, and common voice-service failure scenarios.
  • Experience with Hosted Cloud Connect, Ribbon voice platforms, Ribbon session border controllers, Ribbon application platforms, or comparable carrier-grade voice and cloud communications technologies is strongly preferred.
  • Experience architecting solutions involving several of the following:
    • Session border controllers
    • Softswitches and call-control platforms
    • Telephony application servers
    • Media resource functions and media gateways
    • Call recording platforms
    • Softphone and unified communications applications
    • Network call-screening or call-protection services
    • Carrier voice interconnection
    • Voice routing and least-cost routing
    • Toll-free, DID, and telephone-number management
    • STIR/SHAKEN and call-authentication services
    • Voice provisioning, billing, monitoring, and service-assurance systems
  • Strong working knowledge of SIP, SDP, RTP, RTCP, DNS, ENUM, REST APIs, TLS, TCP/IP, and voice codecs.
  • Working knowledge of SS7, ISUP, TCAP, SCCP, Diameter, IMS, and PSTN gateways, sufficient to support integrations with legacy and mobile-network environments.
  • Experience designing highly available, geographically resilient, secure, and scalable carrier-grade voice solutions.
  • Experience with public or private cloud architecture, virtualization, containers, APIs, and platform integration as applied to telecommunications or real-time communications is preferred.
  • Experience developing capacity models and defining performance, availability, resiliency, monitoring, and disaster-recovery requirements for voice platforms.
  • Experience integrating acquired products or third-party platforms into an established technology, operational, security, and commercial environment is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate competing technologies and vendors, conduct make-versus-buy analyses, identify architectural trade-offs, and make clear technical recommendations.
  • Experience working directly with Product Management, Sales, customers, software development teams, network engineering, operations, security teams, and technology vendors.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex end-to-end voice issues across application, signaling, media, network, carrier, and customer domains.
  • Ability to communicate complex voice architectures, risks, and recommendations clearly in written documents, diagrams, technical discussions, and executive-level presentations.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple competing priorities, and provide architectural leadership in a dynamic product and customer environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and architecture-design tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or an equivalent diagramming platform.

jobs.excerpt: THE COMPANY Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions.
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking a talented and motivated Graduate Digital Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design and verification of digital and mixed-signal IP for our chiplet solutions, including PCS (Physical Coding Sublayer) logic and custom high-speed interfaces such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe. Working alongside experienced digital and analog engineers, you will write RTL, build testbenches and behavioural models, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in digital design who want to learn fast through hands-on work in a small, high-impact team.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • RTL-to-GDSII Ownership: Own the physical implementation of digital blocks from RTL handoff to sign-off: synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock-tree synthesis, routing, optimisation and ECOs.
  • Floorplanning & Power Delivery: Define floorplans, power grids and macro/pin placement. Make the key area, congestion and power-distribution trade-offs, including for blocks that interface with sensitive analog circuits.
  • Timing Closure & Constraints: Write and validate SDC constraints, and drive STA and timing closure across corners and modes for high-speed designs. This includes multi-clock, CDC-heavy and high-frequency datapaths between PCS, DSP and analog front-ends.
  • Mixed-Signal Integration: Integrate hard analog and custom-layout macros (e.g. SerDes TX/RX, PLLs, ADC/DAC) with digital logic. Manage abstracts, pin and bump planning, shielding, isolation and top-level assembly together with the analog and layout teams.
  • Sign-off: Make sure blocks are ready for tape-out through IR-drop and EM analysis, physical verification (DRC/LVS/antenna/ERC), logic equivalence checking, parasitic extraction and final sign-off STA.
  • Low-Power & DFT: Implement UPF power intent where needed, and work with DFT to integrate scan, BIST and test structures without compromising PPA.
  • Flows & Automation: Build and improve our implementation flows and scripts (TCL, Python, shell). This includes AI-assisted tools that parse, compare and flag regressions across timing, congestion and power reports between runs.
  • Feedback to Design: Feed physical implementation insights back to RTL and architecture teams early, so designs are built to close.
  • Collaboration & Mentoring: Work with foundry, EDA and IP partners. Lead design reviews, document your work clearly and mentor less experienced engineers.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field
  • 5+ years of hands-on ASIC physical design experience, with multiple successful tape-outs
  • Strong experience across the full back-end flow: synthesis, floorplanning, CTS, place and route, STA, timing closure and physical verification
  • Strong command of SDC constraints and static timing analysis methodology, including multi-mode multi-corner (MMMC) analysis and OCV/AOCV/POCV
  • Hands-on experience with Cadence and/or Synopsys implementation and sign-off tools (e.g. Genus, Innovus, Tempus, Voltus, Quantus, Pegasus, or Fusion Compiler, PrimeTime, and Calibre)
  • Experience on advanced FinFET nodes (16/12/7/5nm or below)
  • Solid understanding of CMOS, RC parasitic extraction, IR drop/EM and the main physical design formats (LEF/DEF, Liberty, SPEF, GDS/OASIS, UPF)
  • Strong scripting skills in TCL and Python/shell, and comfort working in a Linux environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail and a hands-on debugging mindset

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.
Nice-to-have:
  • Experience implementing digital blocks for high-speed SerDes, UCIe, Ethernet or PCIe PHYs
  • Mixed-signal integration experience: working with analog/custom layout teams, hard macro integration, noise isolation and top-level chip assembly
  • Chiplet or multi-die experience, including bump planning, die-to-die interfaces and advanced packaging constraints (e.g. CoWoS, InFO, EMIB, organic substrates)
  • Experience with low-power implementation (multiple power domains, power gating, level shifters, isolation)
  • Experience defining or improving implementation methodologies and reference flows
  • Experience working directly with foundries, EDA vendors and third-party IP providers
  • Using AI tools in your engineering work, with a healthy scepticism wherever sign-off is on the line

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English, able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 45 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star: We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely: We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact: Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn't disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work: We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US
  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we'll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real digital and mixed-signal IP used in customer silicon, from your first months
  • Mentorship from day one – a dedicated manager and experienced engineers who will review your work and help you grow
  • Competitive, transparent compensation – adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – structured onboarding, AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview (90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Optional: Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. HR & Culture Call (45 min) – values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  5. Offer & Next Steps – we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.

Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.

The program provides supplemental grants to state, tribal, territorial and local governments, and certain types of private non-profits so communities can quickly respond to and recover from major disasters or emergencies. PA can fund the repair, restoration, reconstruction or replacement of eligible public or certain nonprofit facilities or infrastructure damaged or destroyed by a disaster. This is not health or social services.

EverPro - Director of Implementation, Service Fusion

EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. Through EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell, we provide end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications for the Home and Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our company, culture, and values at evercommerce.com/about-us/careers.

About the Role

The EverPro Home Improvement solution group is seeking a Director of Implementation to lead the Service Fusion implementation team of Implementation Specialists and Onboarding Managers. You will own the new customer journey from signed contract to go-live on our field service management platform, partnering with our data team on data migration and integrations and reporting to the leader of our Implementation organization.


Your mandate is to make onboarding significantly faster, more scalable, and more digital, so customers reach value sooner and stay longer. You will also evolve the team's approach to helping customers rethink and improve how they run their business rather than simply teaching them which buttons to click — and make onboarding a continuation of the sales relationship rather than a handoff away from it.


What you'll do

  • Speed to Go-Live: Own go-lives and time to live for Service Fusion. Set and deliver an aggressive reduction target, and connect faster onboarding to lower early-life churn.
  • Scaled and AI-Assisted Onboarding: Lead build vs. buy decisions on self-serve and AI-assisted onboarding, backed by pilot data. Design tiered paths: assisted onboarding for higher-value accounts, scaled digital journeys for the rest.
  • Payments Activation: Make payments attach a standard stage of implementation, partnering with Sales and Payments to raise attach rates and shorten time-to-first-payment.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the team, and partner with Talent Acquisition to manage capacity against new customer bookings.
  • Process, Metrics and Handoffs: Build implementation playbooks and stage-gate reporting in CRM and onboarding platforms. Own clean handoffs from Sales and to Customer Success, including an escalation path for blocked accounts.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work with Product, Engineering, Payments, the data team, Customer Success, and Support so every customer launches with accurate configuration, clean data, working integrations, and trained users.
  • Remote-First Delivery Model: Build and continuously refine a scalable, primarily virtual delivery model suited to a small business pros.
  • Escalation Management: Serve as an executive point of escalation for at-risk implementations, working cross-functionally to get stalled implementations back on track.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in implementation, onboarding, or professional services in B2B SaaS, including 5+ years managing people (ideally managers)
  • A track record leading high-volume SMB launches, with measurable reductions in time to live or time-to-value
  • Experience designing tiered onboarding and deploying self-serve, digital, or AI-assisted onboarding tools, including build vs. buy decisions backed by pilot data
  • A data-driven operator who has built onboarding stage-gates and reporting in CRM and onboarding platforms (for example,)
  • A strong coach who creates clear paths for growth
  • A clear communicator who resets expectations, handles escalations, and influences across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with field service management software or SMB trades businesses (plumbing, HVAC, electrical)
  • Experience with embedded payments or fintech activation during onboarding
  • Familiarity with onboarding/CS tooling (e.g., Planhat, Salesforce and GuideCX or similar)
  • MBA or relevant advanced degree a plus

Where: US Remote

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you're close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits

  • Flexibility to work where and how you want within your country of employment: in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.excerpt: Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data The BIM Specialist supports an owner-side Record Drawing Update (RDU) program for a global data center portfolio.
jobs.description:
Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data

The BIM Specialist supports an owner-side Record Drawing Update (RDU) program for a global data center portfolio. You will keep facility drawings and BIM models current and usable throughout the life of each facility, helping operations, engineering, and project teams work from a reliable record set.

This is a hands-on role focused on reviewing model handovers, incorporating completed retrofit and field changes, and maintaining quality-controlled records—not primarily creating design models or managing a Revit family library. You will serve as the RDU contact for assigned campuses while also completing planned work across other campuses as part of a shared team.

You will love this job if…

  • You enjoy solving drawing and model problems, not just producing new content.
  • You take work from intake through review and delivery.
  • You ask clear questions, investigate missing information, and know when to escalate.
  • You like helping people use reliable information and improving how the team works.

What you’ll do…

  • Maintain facility records. Update Revit models and CAD drawings using completed project deliverables, reviewed redlines, and confirmed field information. Work may include architectural, MEP, security, life-safety, and connectivity changes within the assigned scope.
  • Incorporate retrofit changes. Bring completed retrofit and technology-modification updates into the current maintained record set. Check source revisions and overlapping project scopes so newer work is not overwritten by older inputs.
  • Review model handovers. Document deficiencies, follow up on review comments, and assess readiness for turnover under the program’s procedures.
  • Check model and drawing quality. Review file integrity, links, worksets, coordinates, phasing, naming, sheets, schedules, and model health against applicable BIM requirements.
  • Manage native-file handover and maintenance. Migrate, cloud-share, relink, and upgrade models through approved workflows.
  • Own campus relationships. Represent RDU at project and closeout kickoffs, explain deliverable expectations, review incoming requests, and coordinate with Stakeholders.
  • Support drawing and model requests. Provide current record copies, transmittals, and required exports to internal teams and project partners. Help resolve missing native files, broken links, and format issues.
  • Improve repeatable work. Contribute to BIM standards, checklists, workflow documentation, and onboarding. Create or modify families and templates when needed for record updates, and help test automation or AI-assisted tools with human quality checks.

You should have…

  • 3-5 years of hands-on BIM experience in AEC, construction, facilities, or an owner-side environment.
  • Advanced Revit skills, including linked models, worksharing, sheets, schedules, parameters, families, and troubleshooting.
  • Working proficiency in AutoCAD and PDF review/comparison tools such as Bluebeam.
  • Experience updating models from redlines and reviewing record or as-built deliverables.
  • Ability to read architectural and MEP drawings and understand how changes affect related models, sheets, and schedules.
  • Experience with cloud-based model collaboration and document workflows, preferably Autodesk Forma.
  • Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to manage several tasks across a distributed team.

    • Preferred qualifications

    • Data center or other mission-critical facility experience.
    • Experience with project closeout, record-model migration, connectivity documentation, or owner-side facility information management.
    • Willingness to learn Dynamo, pyRevit, Python, Revit APIs, or AI-assisted automation.
    • Experience training others or writing practical BIM guidance

    Characteristics of an ideal candidate

    • Responsive; we take pride in reacting quickly and positively to clients and teammates, internal and external
    • Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas
    • Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients
    • Empowered; you take ownership, drive the work rather than waiting to be assigned it, and bring solutions instead of problems
    • Performance Driven & Accountable; sets goals and helps raise our high-performance bar
    • Even-tempered; stays steady under pressure and thrives when things move fast
    • Coachable; recognizes strengths and weaknesses and is open to guidance
    • Authentic; likes to have fun and be yourself at work

    What's in it for you

    • Remote-first, genuinely. Flexible arrangements and a team that has worked this way since 2015.
    • Large owners, serious programs. Data centers, transportation, government and public infrastructure, commercial real estate, education, healthcare, manufacturing, power and energy, water and wastewater.
    • More of the lifecycle than most roles allow. As part of Accenture Construct, you’ll see how the systems you build connect to strategy, engineering, delivery, and operations.
    • The whole of Accenture behind you. Specialists in engineering, advisory, digital, data, and AI, with the tools and capabilities of the wider firm at your fingertips.
    • More paths than one lane. Move across sectors, geographies, and capabilities as your career develops, backed by development and certification support.
    • Benefits that matter: competitive compensation, health insurance, flexible PTO, and our Philanthropic Matching Gift Program. And more…

    About Avicado

    Owners of the biggest capital programs in the world run them across systems that don’t talk to each other. The information exists; getting a connected view of it is the problem. That’s the work at Avicado.

    Founded in 2015, Avicado is a digital-native construction technology consultancy. We help owners of complex capital programs connect their systems, strengthen project controls, and get more out of their data. In October 2026, we joined Accenture Construct, Accenture’s global capital projects business, expanding our ability to support capital programs from strategy through handover. Our expertise helps power the digital transformation behind these programs.

    We partner with leading enterprise organizations across industries, including data centers, higher education, healthcare, and real estate development, to create seamless interoperability across their teams, processes, and technologies. As we enter this exciting new chapter, we’re looking for talented individuals who want to help shape the future of construction technology.

    We believe diverse perspectives, collaboration, and continuous learning are essential to delivering meaningful results. We value an environment where individuals are respected, encouraged to contribute their ideas, and empowered to grow professionally.

    As part of Accenture Construct, we’re excited about the opportunities ahead to expand our impact, collaborate across teams, and continue delivering innovative solutions for our clients. We offer competitive benefits and opportunities for professional growth, with specific offerings varying by role and location.

    Our commitment to creating a remarkable workplace has been recognized through our Great Place to Work certification, three consecutive years on Inc.’s Best Workplaces list, and the AYA Award, honoring allies who promote equality and positive change for women in technology.

    If you’re a self-motivated professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, collaborating with talented teams, and making an impact on some of the world’s largest capital programs, we’d love to hear from you!

  • Comfortable with technology and the ability to evolve the claims systems and processes to drive better efficiencies and outcomes

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role

PROJECT OVERVIEW

Our client is building the software that hearing clinics run on patient records, bookings, hearing tests and sales. Clinic chains and hospitals use it every day. You join the team that owns the Sales domain: quote, invoice, insurance claim and payment. We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who ships business outcomes, not just tickets. You own features end to end - from why a clinic needs them, through design and build, to checking in production that they worked. AI coding agents are a normal part of every step of your work.

Tech environment:C# / .NET 8.0, Azure Services (Azure SQL, AI Search, Service Bus, App Insights, Data Factory), Entity Framework Core, Docker, Kubernetes, MassTransit, React with TypeScript, plus growing use of Python for AI tooling and experimentation.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

  • Design, build and run full-stack features in the Sales domain: .NET services, event-driven integrations and React front end.

  • Work with the Product Owner and QA from discovery onwards. Shape the spec and agree acceptance criteria before code is written.

  • Find the gaps in a spec before you build. Close the small ones yourself and bring only business questions to the Product Owner.

  • Use AI tools across the whole lifecycle: planning, design, build, testing, review and maintenance. Keep the human judgement on correctness, security and data protection.

  • Follow features into production: watch telemetry and usage, support releases, investigate incidents and close the loop with the product team.

    • Start every feature with the business question: who in the clinic uses it, and what problem it solves for them.

    • Push back with alternatives when a request is expensive and a simpler solution gives most of the value.

    • Explain technical trade-offs in business terms to Product Owners, delivery and customer-facing colleagues.

    • Look at usage, support tickets and customer feedback after release, and feed what you learn into the next iteration.

IF YOU ARE

  • Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and running production systems. We value practical experience and demonstrated capabilities over years alone.

  • Strong hands-on experience with C# and modern .NET, including:

    • ASP.NET Core and Web APIs.

    • Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.

    • Clean Architecture and maintainable application design.

  • Solid frontend development experience using React and TypeScript, particularly for complex business applications.

  • Practical experience designing and developing microservices architectures.

  • Understanding of asynchronous communication and event-driven systems, ideally using:

    • Azure Service Bus.

    • MassTransit.

    • Similar messaging and event-processing technologies.

  • Strong SQL database experience, including relational data modelling and transactional business data.

  • Experience with API design, automated testing, debugging, and security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents as part of everyday development, such as:

    • Ability to demonstrate practical AI-assisted development workflows, including examples of reviewing AI-generated code, identifying mistakes, and understanding when AI should not be used.

    • Strong product mindset, with examples of contributing to feature definition, understanding business needs, and influencing technical and product decisions.

    • Good command of English (B2 or above), both written and spoken.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Python for AI tooling, evaluations and prototypes.

  • Features built on LLM APIs: prompting, tool use, and measuring the quality of the results.

  • Experience in regulated domains (medical devices, healthcare, finance) or with sensitive personal data.

  • AKS / Kubernetes.

  • You have built or improved developer tooling, CI/CD or AI agent setups that other engineers use.

AS AN OPINOV8R, YOU WILL HAVE

  • Remote Work Model:Balance your professional and personal life with our flexible working conditions, empowering you to deliver your best from anywhere.

  • Exciting Projects:Dive into impactful projects across industries that challenge and spark creativity.

  • Boost Your Expertise:Grow your career with continuous learning, development opportunities, and hands-on experience.

  • Join the Best Team Ever:Collaborate with our diverse and cross-cultural team of passionate technologists and creative thinkers.

HOW’S THE HIRING PROCESS GOING

jobs.description:
Presently we're recruiting Product Testers (from home) in several US

required.

Hope services is a products survey company that specializes in
product testing and product development work. We design and conduct
In-Home Usage Testing (IHUT) locally and nationally to provide actual
user feedback to consumers and market research firms to evaluate
products, packaging, related product instructions and more.

We leverage our network of private panels (In-Home Usage Testers) to
provide product testers to companies for evaluating the in-home
experience with a wide variety of products to ensure proper product

certification and greater market access.

Please note that although this job can be done from home 95% of the
time, very occasionally In-Home Product Testers may be asked to visit
the client's office, laboratory, store, warehouse or factory for
training or meetings (visits are local and scheduled at no more than 20
minutes drive from the In-Home Usage Tester address). These optional

visits are also paid by the hour.

During your application process, we will determine your consumer
profile and establish what products would be suitable for you to test
according to your demographics, lifestyle, consumer behavior, skills,
hobbies and ability. Research questionnaires are used to identify and
target certain types of consumers, to ensure the right participants are
engaged and to achieve the representative sample needed. Job candidates
for In-Home Usage Testing are also screened to meet the client’s needs
for the project to ensure that the product is one that they qualify to
test and that they have a balance of demographics and attitudes.

Participation in these product testing and consumer panels is always
free, secure and private. In-Home Usage Testing is a quick, easy and fun
way to make extra cash by telling big brands what you think about their
upcoming products and services in the American market.

Main Duties

Sign and return non-disclosure agreements before the product to be
tested is shipped. Individuals who complete the required documents will

have the products sent to their homes.

Once the product is received for In-Home Usage Test (IHUT), the
Product Tester must take care of the product being tested and use it

responsibly.

Read and strictly follow the In-Home Usage Test Daily Schedule
provided with each product testing project. In-Home Usage Test Daily
Schedules may include tasks to do such as: unpacking, reading
instructions, journal entries, online or mobile feedback, usage of
product for certain amount of time, writing reviews, taking pictures,

etc.

Properly document In-Home Usage Test as instructed in the In-Home
Usage Test Daily Schedule. Types of documentation commonly used for
In-Home Usage Tests are snapshots, audio recordings, videos and Product

Journals.

Attend Skype meetings or conference call meetings with Account
Managers, Brand Managers, Research Managers, Product Managers or small
business owners to offer ongoing product usage feedback. These short
virtual meetings may take place 2-3 times per week and are paid by the

hour also.

Some In-Home Usage Tests projects may require participants to use
MFour’s Mobile In-Home Use Test Technology (cutting edge smartphone
technology to capture Point-of-Emotion® insights to gain unparalleled

depth of responses).

Paid Product Testing is done from home 95% of the time, but very
occasionally paid Product Testers may be asked to visit the client's
office, laboratory, store, warehouse or factory for training or
meetings. These visits are paid by the hour also.

Write reviews as requested in the In-Home Usage Test Daily Schedule for each project.

Review requirements can vary, however, the standard requirement is a
written review, photos of the reviewer with the product and a video

review.

Requirements

Great ability to follow precise instructions

Be open to write short reviews, record audio or short video (doesn't have to be perfect), no experience needed

Great attention to detail and curious spirit

Be able to work 15-20 hours per week and commit to a certain routine

Have access to a computer and a reliable internet connection

Have access to a digital camera or cellphone that takes pictures

Be honest and reliable

Good communication skills is an asset

No Experience Required

High School Diploma

18 years or older

A paid Product Tester position is perfect for those looking for an
entry level opportunity or for seasonal work, temporary work or
part-time work. The hours are completely flexible and no previous
experience is necessary. Our paid Product Testers come from all
backgrounds and industries ranging from customer service and sales to
administrative assistant. If you are a manager, receptionist, warehouse
or factory worker, driver, medical assistant, nurse, cleaner, college
student, messenger, maid, teacher, retail associate, salesperson,
secretary, server, janitor, cashier, contract worker or intern who is
looking for a flexible part time or seasonal job, you should try paid
Product Testing to supplement your income. Also if you have been
involved in accounting, clerical jobs, marketing, management, security
or data entry jobs you may qualify for a paid product tester position.

Benefits

Very competitive salary

Weekly pay

Work around your schedule

Learn about an exciting industry

Telecommute (you can work from home, work or school)

Most of the time you can keep the product tested

An incredible team comprised of motivated and talented individuals.

What Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) contributes to Cardinal Health:

Practice Operations Management oversees the business and administrative operations of a medical practice.

Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) is responsible for managing the financial lifecycle of patient accounts and ensuring timely and accurate payment for services provided. The RCM team focuses on a series of clinical and administrative processes that healthcare providers utilize to capture, bill, and collect patient service revenue in a manner that is compliant with payer rules and requirements. The revenue cycle shadows the entire patient care journey and begins with patient intake and ends when the patient’s account balance is zero. This team also encompasses a payer administration function that ensures we are successfully operationalizing payer rules and requirements as well as facilitating payer relations and escalation efforts.


The Supervisor, Revenue Cycle Management, is responsible for overseeing patient-facing revenue cycle operations, including patient AR escalations, patient refunds, financial assistance billing, vendor performance management, and patient collection processes. This role serves as a liaison between internal revenue cycle teams, third-party vendors, and patients to ensure timely resolution of account issues, accurate account balances, regulatory compliance, and an exceptional patient financial experience.

On behalf of UKRI we are looking for anIdentity & Collaboration Architect(Inside IR35) for an initial 4 month contract. Remote working with occasional office travel.

The Identity & Collaboration Architect will lead the architecture and design of a large-scale Microsoft 365 consolidation programme involving the migration of multiple Microsoft 365 tenancies, mail domains and identity platforms into a single strategic environment.

The role is accountable for developing the future-state architecture for identity, authentication, directory services, email namespace, collaboration services and associated governance models. The architect will work across technical, operational and business stakeholders to establish a coherent, sustainable target operating model that balances organisational requirements with Microsoft's strategic cloud architecture.

A key aspect of the role is the development of target-state identity and namespace strategies, including the transition from multiple independentlymanaged directories and Microsoft 365 tenancies to a consolidated identity platform centred on Microsoft Entra ID.

As an Identity & Collaboration Architect your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Develop target-state identity architecture for a multi-organisational Microsoft 365 environment.
  • Define authoritative sources for identity information and attribute ownership.
  • Establish identity lifecycle architecture covering joiners, movers and leavers.
  • Define future-state email namespace strategy.
  • Develop mail domain architecture covering multiple existing SMTP domains.
  • Analyse impacts of domain consolidation, retention and rationalisation.
  • Support definition of future-state architecture for Microsoft 365 services and ancillary solutions
  • Support tenant consolidation strategy and migration planning.
  • Design core platform services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive.
  • Develop architectural principles and standards.
  • Establish decision frameworks for identity and namespace management.
  • Lead discovery activities across multiple organisations.
  • Analyse current-state identity, directory and messaging environments.
  • Engage senior stakeholders across IT, security, HR and business functions.
  • Facilitate workshops to define identity, namespace and governance requirements.

Essential:

  • Demonstrable experience in designing and delivering Identity Architecture within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of directory services, domain architecture and identity lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, conditional access, identity governance and privileged identity management.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing Microsoft 365 architectures.
  • Experience developing target-state architectures, migration strategies and transition roadmaps across multiple organisations or business units.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops and present architectural recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience defining governance frameworks, operating models and architectural standards.

Desirable:

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Experience working within hybrid or legacy technology environments.
  • Experience within the Public Sector or similarly regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with security, compliance and identity governance requirements in complex organisations.

Multilingual Licensed Therapist — K-12 School-Based Telehealth Program

Job Title: Multilingual Licensed Therapist – K-12 School-Based Telehealth Program with a $1,500 Sign-On Bonus

Employment Type: W-2 Part-Time

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Important — Insurance Paneling: This is a licensed position. Before starting, all licensed clinicians must be credentialed (paneled) with VPM's insurance providers. The paneling process can take up to three months. We are looking for clinicians who are comfortable applying now and joining once paneling is complete.

Virtual Peace of Mind is looking for a 16-month post-insurance-paneling commitment. VPM will make an initial investment to panel all its clinicians. Due to this upfront cost, there is a required 16-month commitment to work at Virtual Peace of Mind, beginning on the date paneling is complete.

Scheduling & Availability (ET): This is an after-school role. Weekday sessions are scheduled Monday–Friday, 4:00–8:00 PM. Weekend schedules are dependent on clinician availability.

Clinician Availability: You provide your weekly availability upfront, and VPM assigns cases to fill it. Weekday sessions are only scheduled 4:00–8:00 PM. Weekend sessions are scheduled based on clinician availability. You will not work all of those hours. Actual client sessions depend on referrals.

Clinicians will onboard in a ramp format, building to a minimum of 10 client sessions per week within 30 days.

Applicant Note: Please do not apply for this position if you are unavailable to attend onboarding on your date of hire. Onboarding is required on day one — four hours starting at 9:00 AM (2 hours organizational onboarding + 2 hours documentation onboarding) — and will most likely fall during your full-time job's business hours. Onboarding hours are paid. If you are unable to take off during business hours, this is not the job for you.

Compensation: $65–$70/hr for scheduled client sessions (rate based on experience/credentials).

Sign-on bonus: $1,500. Payment schedule and terms are provided in the offer letter.

About Virtual Peace of Mind (VPM)

Virtual Peace of Mind (VPM) is a fast-growing, fully remote mental health practice dedicated to providing evidence-based mental health services to children, adults, and families across multiple states. This position is for our Student Assistance Program (SAP), our children's program (Virginia). Our mission is to expand equitable access to mental health services through high-quality virtual care — and to support the clinicians and professionals who make that care possible.

We're building a culture that is mission-driven, accountable, supportive, and built for sustainable remote work.

Why Join VPM

At VPM, you'll be part of a team transforming access to youth mental health through virtual care — with a remote model designed to support excellent work and real life.

What you can expect:

  • Mission-Driven Impact: Contribute to meaningful work improving access and outcomes for youth and families.
  • Remote by Design: Fully remote environment with clear expectations and supportive infrastructure.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work with a multidisciplinary team that values integrity, empathy, and shared learning.
  • Growth & Leadership Pathways: Opportunities to expand scope and take on leadership or consulting responsibilities as we scale.
  • Professional Development: Access to training, resources, and continued learning opportunities aligned to role scope.
  • State & School-Based Partnerships: Join initiatives that strengthen school-based mental health delivery and expand access across communities.

Role Overview

VPM is seeking bilingual Licensed Therapists to provide short-term, school-based tele-therapy to K–12 students across Virginia through a state-funded initiative in partnership with the Virginia Department of Education (VDOE).

This position focuses on delivering culturally responsive, evidence-based therapeutic services in English and a second language through a secure, HIPAA- and FERPA-compliant virtual platform. Therapists will play an essential role in expanding access to care for students regardless of insurance coverage, immigration status, or language barriers — including students and families who prefer to receive services in a language other than English.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are seeking clinicians who:

  • Have the real capacity to work clinical hours in the evening, after a full workday.
  • Have strong self-reflection — they know their own limits and do not overcommit to part-time clinical hours when they already have a full-time job.
  • Realistically assess their energy after a full workday, and can consistently protect those evening hours without burning out.
  • Value sustainability over overpromising — they apply only if this truly fits their life right now.
  • Strong on documentation — completes clinical notes within 24 hours.
  • Are looking for a home, not another stop — they want to settle in and provide compassionate care to children, not move from role to role.
  • Value language access — they are comfortable delivering therapy in more than one language and meeting students and families in the language they prefer.

Licensed clinicians will have opportunities for leadership, school consultation, and program development within our expanding clinical framework.

Who This Role Is Not For

This role may not be the right fit for clinicians who:

  • Need their evenings free after a full workday, or whose evenings are already full.
  • Have family commitments that conflict with working many evenings.
  • Running from a full-time job — whether it is traffic or anything else — to go right into mental health therapy is not mentally healthy, and it conflicts with productive continuity of care for clients.
  • Tend to say yes to more than they can realistically carry.
  • Find their energy is spent by the end of their workday, with nothing left for clinical work.
  • Are looking for a short-term stop rather than a place to settle in.
  • Struggle to complete clinical notes within 24 hours.
  • Need daytime hours, or a traditional daytime schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Direct Client Care

  • Deliver individual tele-therapy sessions for K–12 students
  • Deliver therapy sessions in English and a second language, matched to each student's and family's preferred language
  • Utilize short-term, evidence-based modalities such as CBT, DBT, and solution-focused therapy
  • Address a range of concerns including anxiety, grief, trauma, academic stress, and family or peer conflict
  • Provide services to diverse student populations, including multilingual learners and those without insurance

Collaboration & Communication

  • Coordinate with school counselors, family resource managers, and administrative teams
  • Engage in family outreach when appropriate to promote continuity of care
  • Participate in case consultations, supervision, and ongoing professional development
  • Maintain responsive and professional communication with both school and internal VPM partners
  • Check VPM email daily for changes, updates, or cancellations from families and VPM, and respond promptly

Documentation & Compliance

  • Complete all clinical documentation (intake, progress, and discharge notes) within 24 hours
  • Ensure compliance with all licensure board requirements, HIPAA, FERPA, and program-specific standards
  • Contribute to quarterly outcomes reporting through standardized metrics and case summaries
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Preferred Experience

Licensure

  • Active Virginia license as LPC, LCSW, LMFT, or equivalent

Language Proficiency

  • Fluency in English and a second language (such as Spanish), with the ability to conduct therapy sessions and communicate with families in both languages

Experience

  • Minimum of 1 year of clinical experience working with children, adolescents, or school-aged youth
  • Prior experience in school-based therapy, community mental health, or tele-health preferred
  • Experience with trauma-informed care and crisis response a plus

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficiency in evidence-based interventions (CBT, DBT, solution-focused, narrative therapy)
  • Strong time management, organization, and documentation skills

Location: 100% remote (EMEA + South America)

Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into.

This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them.

About Miaplaza

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on

We’re a C# and platform growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both product and engineering initiatives. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers.

How management works at Miaplaza

We're a US-based company, so this may differ from what you've done before:

  1. You start as an engineer. You’ll onboard as a senior engineer on your own team for two months, begin manager onboarding in month two, and take over the team at around week 10. Both phases matter equally, and this isn’t negotiable.

  2. You stay hands-on. Around 50% of your time stays hands-on after onboarding, but leading and supporting your engineers always comes first.

  3. You teach. Growing your engineers and those around you is a core responsibility. You'll have full oversight of your direct reports' work, because you can't teach well without seeing the process behind the output.

  4. Feedback is the norm. You'll give specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something, and you'll receive it too.

Requirements

What you must bring

We can only move forward with candidates who meet these requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in software development in one or more object-oriented programming languages

  • 3+ years of experience with front-end software development in a reactive front-end framework

  • 3+ years of experience with software architecture

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader

  • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • Experience working directly with product and design on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience being on-call and resolving production incidents

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

What makes you stand out

  • Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

  • Experience with consumer platforms at scale

  • Experience building in regulated environments

  • Experience with DevOps technologies (eg K8s, IaC, sysadmin, build pipelines, etc.)

  • Extensive senior front-end development experience

Responsibilities

  • Work with your teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable web applications using primarily C# and Vue.js

  • Collaborate with your product trio (PM, UX, EM), product leadership team, and other EMs to scope, prioritize, and deliver features that matter to students and families

  • Set the quality bar for your team. You'll have dedicated capacity for reliability and architecture work rather than fitting it around feature delivery, and a strong say in where that capacity goes.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean architecture, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, so our process is longer than usual. At every stage we try to respect your time.

  1. Application and CV review. We review your application answers and CV, then follow up with an update.

  2. Initial technical screen (20 min). A few administrative questions and short technical questions related to the role.

  3. Behavioral interview (1 hour). With a member of our HR team, about your experience and approach so far.

  4. 1st technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to answer technical questions tailored to our work.

  5. 2nd technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to dive into a hypothetical scenario and how you’d tackle it.

  6. Leadership interview (1 hour). With our Head of Engineering or executive leadership.

  7. Reference check. We contact the 3 references you provide, including at least one former or current manager, a colleague, and a former or current direct report.

  8. Offer and background check. Once you sign your offer, we run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Our compensation philosophy aims for equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement in the range depends on demonstrated skills, internal equity and local labor market rates for your area.

Miaplaza is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

  • Monitor compliance with legal, regulatory and internal requirements, identifying and escalating potential gaps or issues.
  • Maintain accurate compliance records, documentation, registers and supporting evidence.
  • Carry out regular compliance checks and reviews, documenting findings and tracking agreed actions through to completion.
  • Work with colleagues across the business to help them understand their compliance responsibilities.
  • Provide practical guidance on compliance policies, processes and requirements.
  • Assist with internal and external audits and assurance reviews, coordinating information and evidence as required.
  • Monitor compliance actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure completion within agreed timescales.
  • Help the business understand and respond to changes in relevant regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Assist with the management and documentation of compliance incidents, escalating where appropriate.
  • Prepare clear and accurate compliance information and reporting for management.
  • Identify practical opportunities to improve compliance processes, controls and ways of working.

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous experience within compliance, risk, governance, assurance, audit or controls.
  • Good understanding of compliance processes, policies and procedures.
  • Experience supporting compliance reviews, audits or control activities.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
  • Good organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Confidence working with stakeholders across different areas of a business.
  • A practical and collaborative approach, with a willingness to continue developing your knowledge and experience.

  • Awareness of recognised risk, compliance or governance frameworks.

  • Compliance issues and gaps are identified and addressed appropriately.
  • Compliance records and supporting documentation are accurate and up to date.
  • Colleagues understand their compliance responsibilities and know where to seek guidance.
  • Audit, assurance and compliance actions are effectively tracked through to completion.
  • Regulatory changes and compliance incidents are responded to appropriately.
  • Management receives clear, accurate and timely compliance reporting.

You’ll be joining a collaborative Insurance Software organisation where compliance plays an important part in supporting a successful, trusted business. DXC’s existing Insurance Software recruitment materials emphasise an environment built around collaboration, autonomy, continuous learning and development.

The role offers the opportunity to work with colleagues across different parts of the business, broaden your compliance experience and continue developing

Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. Position Summary

Grants Specialists (GS) play a vital role in the sponsored project life cycle, ensuring that research proposals adhere to sponsor guidelines and are successfully submitted. The Senior GS supports faculty, center directors, and staff throughout the pre-award stage of sponsored projects, including proposal preparation and submission, just-in-time requests, and compliance.
Responsible managing a portfolio of faculty post award and payroll sourcing activities with minimal supervision/oversight, particularly for a research-intensive department.

Job Description

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

Proposal/Grant Management

  • Performs pre-award job duties in response to specific proposal guidelines and terms and conditions for more complex proposals, such as program projects, ARPA-H, DOD, DOE applications with minimal guidance. Work with faculty in proposal preparation and submission.
  • Manages budgeting, analysis, justifications for proposals; gathers information for protocols and non-technical proposal components as needed.
  • Serves as a liaison between the Chair, Faculty, and Department Administrators.
  • Stays current on federal and university developments regarding research administration and complex regulations.
  • May coordinate the submission, work with PI to prepare budget, obtain pricing quotes from other Departments. Compiles and ensures accurate regulatory compliance of necessary data collected from various sources. Works with Principal Investigator to compile and submit the entire grant according to established agency/university guidelines.
  • Prepares and reviews all agency forms for submission.
  • Enters grant budgeting documents online, as needed.
  • Obtains PI and institutional signatures for proposal submissions.
  • Initiates subaward setup through SUBS system (new process/system). Uploads pre-award documents and hands it off to Post-award to enter fund number.
  • Coordinates with the Post-award unit and OSRS to ensure timely implementation of contracts and subcontracts by examining and supplying the necessary requirements in the SUBS system.

Award Management

  • Manages reviews of more complex notice of award (NOA), including sponsor award documents, to SPA and PI, noting any special terms and conditions as well as committed effort.
  • Monitors and works with PI to submit annual agency reports (e.g., Research Performance Progress Reports/RPPRs).
  • Oversees and coordinates the proper transfer of PI grants and contracts into WashU.

Research Compliance

  • Coordinates the necessary support with internal and external requests for complex grant-related information (i.e. current biosketches, trainee information, and human/animal protocol approvals, other support).

Research Reporting

  • Assists with analysis of online database of grants submitted, awarded, rejected, etc. metrics and funding trends.
  • Organizes and determines proper action plans including the oversight for advanced alerts to PIs of upcoming deadlines for continuation, competitive renewals, progress reports, etc.

Grant Closeout

  • Serves as responsible for closure of complex sponsored projects accounts.
  • Submits final progress report and invention statement (if applicable) to the appropriate agency.
  • Follows up with PI and facilitates submission of delinquent final technical, outcomes, patent, and property reports.

Post Award

  • Manages and monitors complex sponsored projects budgets and ensures appropriate and timely expenditures and reconciliation of funds.
  • Approves purchasing documents and provides guidance to purchasing staff on appropriate expenditures according to specific grant policies.
  • Manages subawards, including, receiving the subaward invoice, reviewing and forwarding to PI for approval.
  • Checks for accuracy and provides complex troubleshooting error resolutions/solutions for fund profile setups and financial reports.
  • Creates, addresses, and processes correspondence of moderate complexity with granting agencies (i.e. inquiries, carry forward requests, change in effort requests, prior approvals, no cost extensions, equipment purchase, and budget reallocation requests).
  • Serves as internal liaison and grant content representative with SPA to ensure that all funds are set up in a timely manner; prepare any necessary project advances, no-cost extensions, and ensure that funds are carried forward as appropriate.
  • Ensures that human and animal study protocols are associated with the applicable proposal or award.
  • Obtains documentation on participation of foreign nationals on research projects.
  • Coordinates the necessary support with internal and external requests for grant-related information (i.e. audit inquiries, effort distribution, trainee information, and human/animal protocol approvals,).
  • Stays in communication with the leadership on pre- and post-award activities to ensure the highest level of customer service to faculty.
  • Tracks and maintains online database of grants submitted, awarded, rejected, etc.
  • Prepares monthly financial reports on complex research accounts and distribute/discuss with PIs and senior leadership.
  • Assists DA in reconciling funds and monitoring spending levels, overdrafts, and cost sharing commitments. Processes budget adjustments on expense categories as needed.
  • Obtains signatures and forwards grant/contract financial status reports to PI and senior leadership.
  • Works with PIs to provide fund management and make any necessary budgetary changes.
  • Oversees and coordinates the proper transfer of PI grants and contracts from Wash U to new institutions or new departments.

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees.
