Job Description:

We are currently searching for a Workday Adaptive Planning Senior Consultant to join our growing Baker Tilly Digital practice. As a part of Baker Tilly, you will find that our global brand and entrepreneurial environment will give you the support you need to apply your industry and technical experience to build your career across a wide range of services to meet our clients’ important needs. You will contribute to some of the most important activities in our firm which include operating and growing the business, serving the client, developing the best people, and shaping our culture.

As a member of our team, you will help businesses select and implement a comprehensive portfolio of software tools—known as an enterprise system—to solve operational and financial needs. The Senior Consultant will execute as part of a team to implement, support, and use Workday Adaptive Planning in helping clients improve their financial reporting, planning and forecasting processes. As part of this team, the position will work with a wide variety of projects and industries.

We’re looking for an experienced FP&A professional with a strong technical aptitude to join our team as a Workday Adaptive Planning Senior Consultant. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working hands-on with financial systems, collaborating with clients to solve real-world problems, and finding ways to make processes more efficient and effective.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you’ll work closely with clients to understand their financial planning needs and help them implement solutions that make a tangible difference in their operations. We’re seeking someone who brings a mix of FP&A expertise, technical skills, and a practical approach to problem-solving. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Client Collaboration: Facilitate working sessions with client teams to map out their business operations, define goals for their planning cycles, and identify key metrics that drive decision-making

  • Model Development: Build, configure, and maintain financial forecasting and planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning, ensuring they meet client requirements and align with best practices

  • System Implementation: Support the implementation process from start to finish, including configuration, testing, and optimization of Workday Adaptive Planning

  • Data Integration: Has strong experience in JavaScript, SQL, and other integration platforms to incorporate data from a wide variety of ERP systems into Workday Adaptive Planning

  • Process Improvement: Help clients streamline their financial processes by automating workflows and reports using system capabilities

  • Data and Reporting Efficiencies: Identify opportunities to reduce the time clients spend compiling data, allowing them to focus more on analysis and strategy

  • Training and Support: Provide training to client teams to ensure they can effectively use the tools and systems implemented

  • Documentation: Create clear and concise documentation of processes, reports, and system configurations for both clients and internal use

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required; major in accounting, finance, business analytics, management information systems, financial technology or information systems preferred

  • Workday Adaptive Planning or Financial Systems experience preferred

  • A solid understanding of financial planning, forecasting, and reporting, with experience working in or with FP&A teams is preferred

  • Minimum of 3 years of corporate financial accounting experience required

  • Minimum of 1 year of corporate financial planning experience required

  • Strong background in financial reporting, financial report systems, and data flows preferred

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience working with data and using systems to create efficiencies and improve decision-making

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with clients and team members

  • Able to articulate business value of systems enhancements or process change

  • Able to communicate technical information to a non-technical audience

  • Experience with process improvement and root cause analysis

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office

  • Ability to travel as needed, approximately 20%

The compensation range for this role is $85,910- $162,890 Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

jobs.description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.
We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Job Highlights:

  • Role: Senior Paid Media Manager

  • Department: Paid Media

  • Salary Band: $90,000 - $115,000

  • Location: Remote (U.S.)

  • Position Status: Actively hiring for this role

  • Application Deadline: We review applications on a rolling basis, so there’s no cutoff date. If this job sounds like you, go for it.

Today, we’re ready to add another Senior Paid Media Manager to our team. Our new Senior Paid Media Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to Paid Media. You will act as a true paid channel expert, developing and managing a portfolio of Paid Media accounts and marketing campaigns, building great relationships, managing projects and deliverables, and growing accounts.

You’ll work on a team of other Paid Media Specialists and Managers, but as the Sr. Manager, will be expected to go “above and beyond” to exemplify excellence in your work & contribute to internal initiatives like developing media best practices, disseminating industry updates, and enhancing Silverback’s overall media product. You’ll serve as a role model and mentor to your peers, and in some cases, will even directly manage 1-2 junior teammates.

The Senior Paid Media Manager is expected to work cross-functionally, finding opportunities to enhance our clients' overall digital programs through Paid initiatives and complementary strategies with other services. You'll collaborate internally with teammates in Creative, Measurement, SEO, and Client Services functions. You’ll be the true face of Paid Media for your assigned clients, and will spearhead the kickoff, development, tactical execution, and ongoing testing, optimization, and overall success of your clients’ media strategies & performance.

Here’s what we expect from our Senior Paid Media Manager.

—What You'll Do—

  • Responsible for driving the strategy, innovation, and performance of multiple client Paid Media strategies

  • Fully “own” the success of a portfolio of a few (3-5) client accounts

  • Plan, implement, and audit paid media campaigns & strategies that align with client KPIs and marketing goals

  • Successfully plan & execute campaigns in both Search and Social paid media platforms (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok)

  • Pioneer testing and deployment of “outside the box” media channels & tools

  • Collaborate closely with internal teammates in our Creative and Measurement teams to drive successful creative strategy/performance & analytics measurement, tag management, etc

  • Collaborate cross-functionally whenever appropriate (i.e. on multiservice clients) with counterparts in SEO to drive successful cross-channel marketing strategy for clients

  • Regularly create, analyze, and present insightful and actionable Paid Media performance reports directly to clients

  • Leverage various tools to carry out analysis and to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of Paid Media accounts

  • Serve as the lead point of contact for all things Paid Media for your “owned” clients; lead biweekly and ad hoc client calls to build & maintain strong client relationships

  • Successfully retain & even grow your assigned client portfolio through best-in-class communication, storytelling, presentation, and relationship building

  • Accurately communicate project timelines to clients; manage client expectations and proactively update clients as things change

  • Understand the client’s industry, audience and goals and stay on top of industry changes, trends, and best practices

  • Play a close role in sales enablement, including but not limited to identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and contributing to sales pitches, client onboardings/kickoffs, etc

  • Effectively delegate support tasks as appropriate to junior teammates; manage quality assurance for teammates’ work & ensure clients are receiving high-quality deliverables 100% of the time

  • In some cases, directly manage (i.e. act as the dedicated people manager) for 1-2 Paid Media teammates (Managers, Specialists, or Associates)

  • Contribute to the overall success of the Media department through proactive involvement in product development, process improvement, and direct collaboration with the Associate Directors and Senior Director of Paid Media

—What We’re Looking For—

  • 5+ years of experience (minimum) managing Paid Search AND Social campaigns. (Main platforms are Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok)

  • Previous agency experience is a must-have!

  • Experience serving as the main point of contact on client engagements (at least 3+ years of client-facing experience); strong comfortability being client-facing

  • Strong experience driving/leading paid media account strategy

  • Strong testing & innovation mentality

  • Experience collaborating with Creative resources and contributing to creative briefs + driving paid social performance creative

  • Advanced proficiency with Google Analytics 4 and Google Sheets/Excel

  • Experience with Google Tag Manager and Supermetrics is a plus!

  • Strong analytical skills, technical knowledge and attention to detail

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Eagerness to deliver under tight deadlines

  • Genuine curiosity that will guide the research to inform your technical work

  • Outstanding time management and organization skills

  • The ability to accept constructive criticism in a professional manner and to learn from edits

  • Comfort with constant personal and professional growth

—Why Silverback?—

    Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

  • Work with the A team: We are ruthless about putting the best possible team on the field.

  • Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.

  • Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.

  • Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

—Benefits & Perks—

    Great work deserves great support. That’s why we offer a competitive total compensation package, with benefits built around how our people actually live and work.

  • Fully remote team

  • Unlimited PTO & Summer Fridays

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

  • Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks for primary caregivers, 6 weeks for non-primary caregivers

  • Life and short term disability insurance, on us

  • 401(k) with employer match

  • Company-paid ClassPass membership

  • Monthly Team Events that bring our remote team together

—Work Environment—

  • We're a fully remote agency with employees working across the U.S., and our culture is built for it. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication so work moves forward and no one is left guessing.

  • We pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly “work hard, play hard” mentality.

  • Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss.

    • Think this sounds like your kind of team? Apply today. We can't wait to hear from you!

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Job Summary:


Location: USA: Remote (Must be willing to work PST hours)


Concentrix is looking for a highly experienced SAP IS-U Billing Functional Lead to lead the design, configuration, testing, implementation, and support of SAP IS-U Billing and Invoicing solutions for utility clients. This role requires deep functional expertise in utility billing processes, strong integration knowledge across SAP IS-U modules, and the ability to drive complex billing transformation initiatives from requirements gathering through post-production support.

The successful candidate will serve as the primary Billing SME, collaborating with business stakeholders, system integrators, technical teams, and project leadership to deliver innovative and compliant billing solutions.


Key Responsibilities

SAP IS-U Billing & Invoicing

  • Lead the design, configuration, enhancement, and support of SAP IS-U Billing and Invoicing solutions.
  • Configure and maintain billing schemas, rate categories, operands, tariff structures, pricing configurations, and billing master data.
  • Design and support invoice and bill print functionality, including customer-facing billing outputs.
  • Configure and maintain utility rate structures and pricing models aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
  • Analyze and resolve complex billing exceptions, billing failures, invoicing errors, and outsort processing issues.

Time-of-Use (TOU), EDM & Advanced Billing

  • Design and configure Time-of-Use (TOU) rates and billing scenarios.
  • Support Energy Data Management (EDM) functionality, including interval data processing, profiles, and usage calculations.
  • Implement and support advanced billing programs such as:
    • Net Metering
    • Aggregate Billing
    • Renewable Energy Programs
    • Distributed Energy Resources (DER)
    • Emerging Utility Products and Services

Device Management Integration

  • Ensure accurate integration between Device Management and Billing processes.
  • Support meter-related processes including:
    • Meter Reads
    • AMI/Smart Meter Data
    • Device Installations
    • Device Removals
    • Device Replacements
    • Register Management
  • Troubleshoot billing issues related to estimation, meter reading validations, implausible reads, and rate determination.

FICA Integration & Meter-to-Cash

  • Manage billing integration with SAP FICA to ensure accurate invoice posting and financial processing.
  • Support contract accounts, account determination, budget billing, dunning, collections, and payment processing.
  • Partner with FICA teams to resolve:
    • Posting Errors
    • Reconciliation Issues
    • Account Determination Problems
    • Billing-to-Finance Integration Defects
  • Validate and support the complete Meter-to-Cash lifecycle.

Functional Leadership

  • Lead business requirements and solution design workshops.
  • Translate business requirements into functional designs and system solutions.
  • Develop detailed RICEFW functional specifications.
  • Collaborate with ABAP development teams throughout design, development, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Provide leadership and mentoring to junior consultants and billing team members.
  • Serve as the primary functional lead for the Billing workstream.

Testing, Deployment & Production Support

  • Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution.
  • Validate end-to-end integrations across Billing, Device Management, EDM, and FICA.
  • Participate in deployment planning, cutover activities, hypercare support, and production issue resolution.
  • Ensure solution quality, scalability, and compliance with utility business requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of SAP IS-U Billing & Invoicing functional experience.
  • Strong hands-on configuration experience in:
    • Billing Schemas
    • Rate Structures
    • Tariff Structures
    • Billing Master Data
    • Price Management
    • Bill Print Configuration
  • Experience with:
    • Time-of-Use (TOU) Billing
    • Energy Data Management (EDM)
    • Net Metering
    • Aggregate Billing
    • Utility Billing Transformations
  • Deep understanding of SAP IS-U Device Management integration.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP FICA integration and financial posting processes.
  • Experience supporting the end-to-end Meter-to-Cash process.
  • Ability to write detailed RICEFW functional specifications.
  • Experience leading workshops and managing stakeholder relationships.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Utility industry experience supporting electric and/or gas utilities.
  • Experience working with Investor-Owned Utilities (IOUs).
  • Multiple full-cycle SAP IS-U implementation experience.
  • Experience with AMI Smart Meter and Meter Data Management (MDM) integrations.
  • Knowledge of SAP CRM, Front Office, and Customer Service integration.
  • Experience with SAP BW reporting and analytics.
  • Familiarity with OpenText Ex stream or other bill presentment solutions.
  • Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA Utilities transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of regulatory compliance, tariff filings, and utility rate changes.
  • Experience implementing renewable energy and Distributed Energy Resource (DER) programs

The base salary for this position is $106,087- $144,709 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. We move fast, hold a high bar, and care deeply about doing things right. If that's how you're wired, you'll love it here. You'll be surrounded by people who are sharp, humble, and genuinely energized by the mission. A team that shows up for each other, celebrates wins loudly, and has real conversations early.

  • Make our sellers more productive. You’ll find where AEs, AMs, and SDRs lose time and where deals stall, then fix it. That might mean a cleaner stage process, better account and contact data, or an AI agent that handles research, CRM updates, and follow-ups so reps can spend more time selling.

  • Own pipeline and the forecast. You’ll run the weekly forecast and pipeline review cadence with sales leaders, keep stages and hygiene honest, and show us where pipeline is leaking and what to do about it.

  • Run territory, quota, and capacity mechanics. You’ll build and maintain territories, quota models, and coverage, and partner with Finance on comp so incentives match the motion we want.

  • Build the top-of-funnel engine. You’ll own how inbound and outbound pipeline is structured and tracked: lead lifecycle, routing, scoring, SLAs, and source attribution, with funnel metrics Sales and Marketing both trust.

  • Run a fast, clean deal desk. You’ll oversee quoting, order forms, approvals, and CPQ, and keep cutting the time from verbal yes to signed and booked.

  • Bring ops rigor to the customer side. You’ll stand up CS operations for renewals, expansion, implementation, and support, plus partnership ops, so post-sale teams get the same visibility and process as new business.

  • Own our GTM systems. You’ll own Salesforce and the GTM tool stack, decide what we build, buy, or retire, and keep our data clean enough that leaders and AI agents can trust it.

  • Scale ops with AI, not headcount. You’ll build and ship agents, skills, and automations in Claude and similar tools, both inside our ops processes and for sellers and leaders. You’ll also help the rest of the GTM team build their own.

What makes a great candidate

  • You’ve spent years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, and you’ve led the function or a large part of it.

  • You understand sellers. You’ve sat in pipeline reviews, know what a healthy deal looks like at each stage, and can tell when a forecast is real.

  • You’ve owned forecasting, territory and quota design, and pipeline management, and you can point to how your work moved win rates, cycle time, or rep productivity.

  • You know Salesforce deeply and have run deal desk and CPQ, lead routing, and GTM tooling.

  • You’re AI-native. You already build with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to automate real work, not just summarize it, and you’d rather build an agent than hire for a task.

  • You set direction without being told. You bring a recommendation and the data behind it, and you change your mind when the data says you should.

  • You’re a credible partner to sales, CS, and marketing leaders, and you can explain a complex model simply to a first-time manager or an exec.

  • You thrive on a fully distributed team and move fast without losing rigor.

  • Bonus: you’ve worked in compliance, HR tech, or legal tech, or sold to enterprise buyers in a regulated space.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.excerpt: Clover is reinventing health insurance by working to keep people healthier.
jobs.description:
Clover is reinventing health insurance by working to keep people healthier.

We value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of healthcare. Clover's engineering team is empathetic, caring, and supportive. We are deliberate about the team and culture we are building. We seek engineers who are strong in their own work and care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

We are looking for a senior software engineer to make Counterpart Health's existing customer-facing platform agentic. You will build applied AI systems that retrieve relevant information, call tools, and help healthcare users complete meaningful work. You will work with engineers, data scientists, and healthcare professionals, with ownership across data pipelines, backend services, model behavior, and the user experience.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Simplify the complexities of healthcare by building systems that multiply human efforts.
  • Build and maintain customer-facing agentic AI software, with ownership from data ingestion through to the user interface.
    • Develop retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, pipelines for ingestion, ETL, storage, indexing, retrieval, and context assembly.
    • Build agent workflows that call tools and use application services, with clear permissions, execution limits, and human review where needed.
    • Choose models, storage, retrieval, and orchestration patterns based on product needs and measured results.
  • Protect PHI and tenant boundaries across data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and outputs in a HIPAA-regulated environment.
  • Use customer feedback and failure analysis to improve answers and tool execution.
  • Measure and improve quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Master new tools and technologies to solve concrete user problems while keeping the system simple enough for the team to maintain and operate.
  • Help the team define development practices that support fast iteration and quality, including tests and documentation of key implementations.
  • Work with Product Managers and operational staff to choose useful workflows, define success, and deliver features to customers.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have personally owned a production agentic system used by external customers. You can explain your contribution across ingestion, ETL, storage, retrieval, the tool-calling loop, inference, and UI integration.
  • You have used evaluations to improve a live system. Can explain the test data, failure categories, release criteria, and limits of automated or LLM-as-judge scoring.
  • You bring senior software engineering experience and can write, test, debug, and operate the application code behind an AI feature. Python and TypeScript or JavaScript experience are useful, as is comparable experience in another production language.
  • You have experience with SQL, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud services such as GCP or AWS.
  • You have handled practical LLM limitations, such as context-window limits, unsupported answers, retrieval failures, and incorrect tool calls.
  • Experience with healthcare or another regulated industry is a plus. Experience with tools such as LangGraph, Langfuse, pgvector, or OpenSearch is useful, but we care more about your engineering decisions and production results than a particular framework. Using AI coding assistants, building demos, or shipping internal tools alone does not meet the production AI experience required for this role.

You will love this job if:

  • You are curious about how systems work and use pragmatic engineering to solve complicated problems. You test whether an AI approach improves the workflow and use simpler software when it is the better choice.
  • You enjoy a collaborative environment where you help define priorities and own delivery. You bring clarity to ambiguity and change your view when new evidence calls for it.
  • You take responsibility for what reaches customers. You investigate broken behavior, fix the cause, and improve the tests and evaluations that should catch it.
  • You care about what good technology can do for people and want to work with healthcare professionals on tools they can trust.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are anE-Verify company.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is:
$169,200—$220,000 USD

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.

At Arctic Wolf, we are transforming our Application Security function to be AI-first, fundamentally changing how security work is executed and scaled across the organization. We are seeking a Lead Application Security Engineer to help scale secure-by-design practices across our cloud, SaaS, and AI-enabled platforms.

In this role, you will lead threat modeling, define application security standards, assess product and platform architectures, and integrate security throughout the SDLC. This includes securing emerging AI and GenAI capabilities using frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLMs.

The role requires deep technical expertise, strong communication skills, and the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives. You will own and drive multiple AppSec programs, reduce risk, shape internal security practices, and coach engineers and Security Champions to raise the overall security maturity of the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Lead threat modeling exercises for applications, microservices, APIs, and AI/LLM-enabled systems
  • Define reusable security patterns and drive secure design reviews for product and platform architectures
  • Own AppSec initiatives end-to-end and drive risk-reduction programs across R&D
  • Influence engineering and product leaders to adopt secure practices through clear guidance and rationale
  • Conduct security assessments for new features, cloud architectures, and AI/GenAI capabilities
  • Implement and optimize AppSec tooling including SAST, DAST, IAST, SCA, IaC scanning, and container security
  • Establish metrics, dashboards, and scalable process improvements
  • Drive R&D wide security practices and help shape internal standards for secure development
  • Explore emerging technologies, and promote continuous learning within AppSec and the Security Champions community

  • 7+ years of experience in Application Security, Product Security, Secure Software Development, or a related security engineering discipline.
  • Deep expertise in secure design and development principles, including the OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, and modern application security best practices.
  • Proven experience leading threat modeling exercises, security architecture reviews, and risk assessments for complex applications and services.
  • Hands-on experience with application security tooling, including SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC, container, and cloud-native security solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify security risks, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop practical, scalable solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence engineering teams and technology leaders through collaboration, technical expertise, and sound risk-based decision making.
  • Experience driving the adoption of secure development practices and integrating security into engineering workflows and SDLC processes.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable guidance for both technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of leading security initiatives, establishing standards, and delivering measurable improvements to an organization's security posture.
  • Passion for mentoring engineers, fostering a security-first culture, and elevating the security capabilities of development teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience securing cloud-native applications and architectures in AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
  • Knowledge of AI and GenAI security concepts, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, model and agent security risks, and secure AI system design.
  • Experience supporting large-scale SaaS platforms, highly distributed systems, or organizations operating in regulated environments.

About Navista:


We believe in the power of community oncology to support patients through their cancer journeys. As an oncology practice alliance comprised of more than 40 sites, Navista provides the support community practices need to fuel their growth—while maintaining their independence.


What Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) contributes to Cardinal Health:

Practice Operations Management oversees the business and administrative operations of a medical practice.

Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) is responsible for managing the financial lifecycle of patient accounts and ensuring timely and accurate payment for services provided. The RCM team focuses on a series of clinical and administrative processes that healthcare providers utilize to capture, bill, and collect patient service revenue in a manner that is compliant with payer rules and requirements. The revenue cycle shadows the entire patient care journey and begins with patient intake and ends when the patient’s account balance is zero. This team also encompasses a payer administration function that ensures we are successfully operationalizing payer rules and requirements as well as facilitating payer relations and escalation efforts.


The Supervisor, Revenue Cycle Management, is responsible for overseeing patient-facing revenue cycle operations, including patient AR escalations, patient refunds, financial assistance billing, vendor performance management, and patient collection processes. This role serves as a liaison between internal revenue cycle teams, third-party vendors, and patients to ensure timely resolution of account issues, accurate account balances, regulatory compliance, and an exceptional patient financial experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Review and identify opportunities for improvement on Power BI.
  • Oversee daily patient accounts receivable activities and ensure timely resolution of outstanding patient balances.
  • Manage and prioritize complex patient account escalations requiring advanced review and resolution.
  • Monitor patient AR inventory, aging trends, and account resolution timelines.
  • Develop workflows to improve account accuracy and reduce preventable patient balance issues.
  • Review complex patient disputes involving insurance payments, adjustments, estimates, financial assistance, billing errors, statements, and collections.
  • Partner with Patient Financial Services, billing teams, operational leaders, and payers to resolve account concerns.
  • Identify recurring root causes of patient escalations and implement corrective action plans.
  • Track and report escalation trends, resolution outcomes, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and third-party assistance vendors to ensure timely application and posting of approved assistance.
  • Monitor accounts requiring financial assistance review and ensure appropriate follow-up.
  • Evaluate financial assistance trends and recommend workflow enhancements to improve patient access to available programs.
  • Supervise patient refund workflows and ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor refund aging and turnaround times.
  • Review high-dollar or complex refund requests for accuracy and approval.
  • Identify trends contributing to refund volume and implement process improvements to reduce refund occurrences.
  • Serve as the primary operational contact for statement vendors, collection agencies, financial assistance vendors, and other revenue cycle partners.
  • Monitor vendor performance metrics, service levels, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct routine business reviews and collaborate with vendors to improve operational outcomes.
  • Escalate and resolve vendor-related issues affecting patient satisfaction or financial performance.
  • Analyze patient AR, refund, escalation, collections, and financial assistance data to identify trends and opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain reporting and dashboards to support leadership decision-making.

  • Maintain billing staff PTO requests and ensure proper staffing and department coverage.

What You Will Do
The Manager of Risk Adjustment-SHP provides strategic leadership and oversight of Sharp Health Plan's enterprise risk adjustment program across ACA, Medicare Advantage, and CalPERS products. This role drives accurate risk score capture, regulatory compliance, financial performance, and provider engagement through effective risk adjustment strategies, analytics, and operational oversight. The Manager partners closely with medical groups, vendors, and internal stakeholders to improve documentation, coding, and member outreach efforts. This position serves as the organization's risk adjustment subject matter expert and provides leadership to ensure program success and accountability.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in health care, business, or related field.
  • 7 Years experience in risk adjustment, managed care, provider reimbursement, healthcare analytics, coding operations, population health, or related healthcare disciplines.
  • 5 Years direct experience supporting risk adjustment programs.
  • 2 Years leadership experience.

Essential Functions

  • Program Strategy and Oversight
    Develops, implements, and continuously evolves SHP’s enterprise risk adjustment strategy across ACA, Medicare Advantage, and CalPERS products.
    Establishes annual risk adjustment goals, performance targets, key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational priorities.
    Identifies strategic opportunities to improve risk score performance, coding accuracy, member capture rates, and program effectiveness.
    Evaluates emerging industry trends, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions to enhance program performance and operational efficiency.
    Participates in enterprise and system-wide risk adjustment workgroups, committees, and strategic initiatives.
  • Analytics and Performance Management
    Oversees the development, validation, and distribution of risk adjustment reporting and analytics used for operational, physician, medical group, executive, and Board-level decision making.
    Directs analysis of risk score performance, coding opportunities, suspect condition capture, documentation trends, and benchmark comparisons.
    Collaborates with internal analytics resources and external vendors to develop actionable reporting that supports targeted outreach and intervention strategies.
    Monitors performance against program benchmarks and recommends corrective actions when performance gaps are identified.
  • Provider and Medical Group Engagement
    Partners with delegated medical groups to develop and execute prospective and retrospective risk adjustment strategies.
    Facilitates collaborative discussions regarding member targeting, outreach strategies, workflow optimization, coding performance, and documentation improvement opportunities.
    Promotes accountability for risk adjustment outcomes through routine performance tracking, operational meetings, and executive-level reporting.
    Supports development of provider-facing education and performance improvement initiatives based on retrospective reviews, audit findings, and coding trends.
  • Vendor Management
    Oversees strategic and operational performance of risk adjustment vendors, ensuring contractual deliverables, timelines, quality standards, and performance expectations are achieved.
    Directs vendor activities related to analytics, chart retrieval, coding reviews, and audit support.
    Evaluates vendor performance and identifies opportunities for process improvement and operational optimization.
    Participates in vendor selection, implementation, and ongoing program evaluation activities.
  • Audit, Compliance, and Regulatory Oversight
    Oversees enterprise readiness and response activities related to RADV audits, chart validation efforts, and other risk adjustment-related regulatory reviews.
    Establishes processes to monitor coding accuracy, documentation quality, audit outcomes, and corrective action implementation.
    Maintains awareness of CMS, HHS, OIG, and state regulatory requirements affecting risk adjustment operations and compliance activities.
  • Financial Planning and Executive Reporting
    Partners closely with the Chief Strategy Officer and Chief Financial Officer to evaluate risk adjustment performance and financial implications.
    Supports budgeting, forecasting, accrual development, pricing strategy, and financial planning processes through risk adjustment analytics and reporting.
    Develops executive-level presentations and Board materials that clearly communicate risk adjustment performance, trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
    Translates complex analytical findings into business-focused recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Leadership and Staff Development
    Provides leadership, coaching, performance management, and professional development for assigned staff
    Establishes departmental priorities, performance expectations, and development plans.
    Fosters a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and innovation.
    Ensures staff maintain current knowledge of risk adjustment methodologies, coding standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Comprehensive knowledge of Medicare Advantage, ACA, and other risk adjustment methodologies, including HCC models, coding requirements, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, evaluate performance, and develop actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to translate technical risk adjustment concepts into concise and meaningful communications for executive leadership, Boards of Directors, providers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of healthcare finance, managed care reimbursement, forecasting principles, and the financial impact of risk adjustment performance.
  • Strong leadership, project management, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships and influence outcomes across departments, medical groups, vendor organizations, and executive leadership teams.
  • Skilled in performance measurement, KPI development, benchmarking, and operational improvement methodologies.
  • Knowledge of ICD-10-CM coding principles, documentation requirements, coding audit processes, and provider education methodologies.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Proficiency with healthcare analytics, reporting, and presentation tools, including Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, manage ambiguity, and drive accountability for results across a highly matrixed environment.

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Today, we’re looking to add a new Senior SEO Manager to the team.

Silverback’s next Senior SEO Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to SEO & Organic Search. You will develop and manage a portfolio of 4-6 SEO accounts while building great client relationships and managing projects & deliverables. You’ll bring a scrappy & tenacious attitude to your work, diving headfirst into the “new frontier” of organic search by pushing the boundaries of AI search testing. You’ll flex best-in-class data analysis chops to break down performance metrics and directly impact the success of our clients’ businesses.

Here’s what we expect from our Senior SEO Manager.

—What You'll Do—

  • Strategic Chops: Responsible for driving and executing the strategy, innovation and performance of multiple client SEO strategies.
  • AI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs, including their influence on search behavior and the ability to implement optimized strategies for these engines. Ability to identify new opportunities
  • Analytical Skills: Fluently leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other SEO platforms, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Client-Facing: Lead recurring status and reporting calls & serve as assigned clients’ primary point of contact with Silverback for all things SEO. Clearly communicate complex SEO strategy and execution details to clients in a digestible, jargon-free manner.
  • Client Management: Act as a trusted advisor & consultant to clients — an extension of their marketing team — to build long-lasting client relationships.
  • Tactical Execution: Translate channel strategy to time-bound, tactical roadmaps. Build and maintain structured content systems, including topic clusters, pillar pages, internal links, and supporting schema. Prioritize performance-based initiatives and drive authoritative content at scale.
  • Innovation: Research emerging trends in search and AI technologies to refine strategies and implement innovative best practices.
  • Process/Delivery Improvements: Identify opportunities to improve the SEO delivery and process to increase the value of the work or improve efficiency.
  • Data Analysis: Review performance data to identify trends, measure the impact of initiatives and build actionable strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teammates across measurement, paid media, and creative to bring strategies to life.
  • Sales Support: Work with the sales team to put together SEO strategy proposals and audits that align with their goals and objectives.

—What We’re Looking For—

  • Agency Background: You’ve previously “done the work” at another performance marketing agency, and know what it takes to deliver results.
  • Years of Experience: We’re seeking candidates with at LEAST 3 years of agency experience; 5+ years of overall relevant marketing/SEO experience is required.
  • Client-Facing Comfortability: This role is not a good fit for someone who doesn’t want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the SEO engagement with your assigned clients.
  • Embrace Complexity: As a Senior SEO Manager, this role will be exposed to more complex and challenging situations. You have a strong ability to navigate complexity and tackle challenges head on.
  • AI Search Testing & Optimization: You have hands-on experience optimizing for AI search (not theoretical; actual tests). You don’t have all the answers — nobody does! — but you’re excited to test, experiment, and figure it out.
  • Business Acumen: Being able to build & execute SEO strategies across multiple industries is crucial, but your ability to tie SEO wins to a measurable impact on the clients’ business, bottom line, etc is what will make you a superstar.
  • Content Experience: You’re an expert at driving content strategy based on audience, keyword and competitor research. You have a strong ability to craft content briefs to provide to content teams for production.
  • Tools/Platforms: You’re a pro with common SEO tools & platforms such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, AHRefs, and Screaming Frog.
  • Get Sh*t Done” Mentality: You’d rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. You’re energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king.
  • Adaptability & Growth: Feedback fuels you. You lean into change, sharpen your skills, and push yourself and your team to get better every day.
  • Project & Time Management: You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don’t throw you.

—Why Silverback?—

    Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

  • Work with the A team: We are ruthless about putting the best possible team on the field.

  • Unlimited PTO & Summer Fridays

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

—Work Environment—

  • We're a fully remote agency with employees working across the U.S., and our culture is built for it. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication so work moves forward and no one is left guessing.

  • We pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly “work hard, play hard” mentality.

  • Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss.

jobs.description:
Job Description: Senior Databricks Engineer

Company: Altera Health (A Harris Computer Business)

Location: India (Remote / Hybrid)

Function: AI & Automation — Engineering

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Databricks Engineer to join our AI and Automation team. In this role, you will lead the architecture and delivery of scalable data platforms on Databricks, drive engineering best practices, and act as a technical anchor for data pipeline and lakehouse initiatives. You will work closely with AI, automation, and reporting teams to build production-grade data infrastructure that powers healthcare IT operations at scale.

We are looking for someone who is deeply self-sufficient — someone who can independently diagnose, debug, and resolve complex technical issues without hand-holding, and who actively uses AI tooling as a force multiplier to deliver faster and smarter solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end design and architecture of Databricks-based data platforms, including Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) lakehouse patterns
  • Define and enforce engineering standards for pipeline development, testing, and deployment across the team
  • Lead technical design reviews and contribute to architectural decision-making alongside senior stakeholders
  • Evaluate and recommend tools, frameworks, and platform configurations to meet evolving business needs
  • Independently investigate and resolve complex platform, pipeline, and performance issues — bringing structured debugging and root cause analysis skills to production incidents

Azure Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Demonstrate deep, hands-on understanding of the Azure ecosystem — not just as a storage layer but as an integrated platform:
  • Understand Azure cost governance and resource optimisation at scale
  • Architect cross-service solutions that leverage Azure-native capabilities alongside Databricks

Open Source Stack Proficiency

  • Bring strong working knowledge of the broader open source data ecosystem:
    • Docker — containerization of data applications and pipelines
  • Evaluate and adopt open source tooling pragmatically — choosing the right tool without over-engineering

GitHub & Development Practices

  • Operate confidently and independently in GitHub:
    • Branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based development)
    • Pull requests, code reviews, and merge conflict resolution
    • Repository organisation, tagging, releases, and change management
  • Maintain clean, well-documented codebases and enforce code quality standards across the team
  • Treat infrastructure and pipeline code with the same rigour as application code

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Actively and fluently use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) as a core part of the engineering workflow — not occasionally, but as default practice
  • Use AI to accelerate complex problem-solving: debugging cryptic errors, generating boilerplate, refactoring code, writing tests, and exploring unfamiliar APIs
  • Leverage LLMs for data pipeline design ideation, documentation generation, and query optimisation
  • Comfortable prompting AI effectively to get production-quality outputs and critically evaluating AI-generated code before shipping
  • Stay current with AI tooling evolution and bring new productivity patterns to the team

Data Engineering & Pipelines

  • Build and optimise complex ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark on Databricks at production scale
  • Architect Delta Lake solutions with strong focus on reliability, performance tuning, and cost governance
  • Design reusable, modular pipeline frameworks that accelerate team delivery
  • Drive CI/CD adoption for data pipelines — automated testing, deployment, and rollback strategies

Analytics & Reporting Enablement

  • Collaborate with Power BI reporting teams to deliver well-modelled, governed semantic layers
  • Own the design of data models that balance query performance with flexibility for changing requirements
  • Act as a technical bridge between engineering and business/reporting consumers

AI & Automation Integration

  • Lead data engineering workstreams supporting AI/ML initiatives — feature stores, training pipelines, model serving data flows, and MLflow integration
  • Design data feeds and integration layers connecting Databricks outputs with operational tools such as LogicMonitor and ServiceNow ITOM
  • Identify and prototype new AI/automation use cases enabled by the data platform

Platform Governance & Reliability

  • Own Databricks workspace governance — Unity Catalog, cluster policies, access controls, cost monitoring, and security configurations
  • Implement robust data quality frameworks, observability, and alerting for pipeline health
  • Ensure compliance with data handling standards relevant to healthcare IT environments
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, conducting code reviews and upskilling the team

Required Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of overall data engineering experience, with 4+ years hands-on on Databricks
  • Deep expertise in Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala) — including performance tuning, partitioning strategies, and cluster optimisation
  • Strong command of Delta Lake — ACID transactions, schema evolution, time travel, optimisation techniques
  • Advanced SQL and data modelling skills (Kimball, Data Vault, or Lakehouse patterns)
  • Deep, proven hands-on experience with Azure — ADLS Gen2, ADF, Azure DevOps, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Monitor, AAD/Entra ID; able to architect cross-service solutions independently
  • Strong open source stack knowledge — Kafka, Airflow, dbt, Docker, and related tooling
  • GitHub proficiency — branching, PRs, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and repository management
  • Strong independent debugging and troubleshooting skills — able to own and resolve complex production issues without escalation
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in day-to-day engineering — GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent; uses AI to solve problems, not just for autocomplete
  • Excellent communication skills — able to represent technical positions clearly to non-engineering stakeholders

Good to Have

  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog and enterprise data governance at scale
  • Familiarity with Power BI — DirectQuery, composite models, semantic layer design
  • Exposure to MLflow, Feature Store, or Model Serving on Databricks
  • Knowledge of healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR, claims/EHR data)
  • Familiarity with LogicMonitor telemetry or ServiceNow data models
  • Databricks Certified Associate or Professional certification
  • Experience with FastAPI/Flask for building lightweight data APIs

Who You Are

  • Deeply self-sufficient — you don’t wait for someone to unblock you; you dig in, debug, research, and solve
  • You use AI as a natural extension of your engineering toolkit — it makes you faster, not dependent
  • Strong instinct for data quality, platform reliability, and operational excellence
  • Comfortable driving technical direction in a lean, fast-moving team
  • Genuinely curious about AI/automation applications in IT operations and healthcare
  • A collaborative mentor who raises the engineering bar across the team
  • Treat GitHub as a professional discipline — clean commits, meaningful PRs, documented decisions

jobs.excerpt: Senior Software Engineer, Salesflow (Systems & Reliability) Location: Remote from Mexico, Brazil, or Central/South America, working in US time.
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Salesflow (Systems & Reliability)

Location: Remote from Mexico, Brazil, or Central/South America, working in US time.

Reporting to: Head of Data

Employment: Full time. Employee in Brazil; independent contractor elsewhere.

About Crimson Education

Crimson Education is the world's leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world's top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. We're backed by leading VC firms, recently closed a USD $40M Series D at a USD $640M valuation, and operate across 28 markets worldwide.

The Role

Crimson is replacing Salesforce with Salesflow, an AI-native CRM we build in-house. It runs the whole sales journey: lead intake, meeting scheduling, call transcription analysis, AI-drafted appraisals, contracts and e-signature, and invoicing. It is live for our US sales team today and rolls out to every other market over the coming months.

Our team is small and builder-heavy, and the rate of growth has made it hard to keep the underlying infrastructure and logic clean and tidy. As examples, CI checks things that have been fully deprecated, newly added modules do not always take into account legacy compatibility, and bug fixes are sometimes too narrow in scope, fixing the place the problem was seen and not the underlying cause. Compounding the above is that the code itself is for the most part written by AI – this is what enabled us to build a fully working CRM in a matter of months, but is what makes it very easy to inadvertently cross wires during development.

We are looking for the person who fixes this: you will own the backend view of the system as a whole and maintain the code that glues everything together. That means a system inventory and state transition models, CI that tests only what is needed and does that well, shared guarded entrypoints in place of multiple writers with inconsistent guards, and clear definitions for what is the source of truth when fields are shared among multiple synced systems. Salesflow is live and people depend on it every day, so this is done in steps while it runs: there is no rewrite. This is not a hands-off design role: you will be expected to push code as well as design.

In addition to the above, you'll also help to unblock users – the support team funnel tickets that prevent a user from working and require a backend code change to the dev team, most of whom are not in US time zones. You will join the team and cover the US working day, when the other members are offline.

We fully expect you to use AI to augment your analyses and write code for you but absolutely require that you have the experience to read and write code yourself, and that you know how to use AI to write code (e.g., which questions to ask, what to check, how to build internal memory structures).

What are the main responsibilities for this role?

Your top priority is to build and maintain the view of the CRM as a whole: inventory all functions, edge functions, flows, and integrations with outside systems; build the state transition map and the set of business rules the system is held to; and then ensure that architecture and CI align to this. In practice this can be split into:

  • setting up a live and auto-updating inventory and model: the repo has multiple pushes every day; no-one should try updating a model by hand

  • coordinating with team members on business rules: the team has, collectively, all the info; your job is to organize it and embed it in the checks

  • after the above two, move into implementation: resolve technical debt caused by rapid organic growth without consistent pruning, and set up the infrastructure such that future growth automatically falls into the correct path and does not create new debt.

Aside from this, you will assist in unblocking users during US daytime hours: addressing current bugs will help you gain insight into the system as a whole, informing the main priority.

  • Your first 14 days: inventory and build a model of the system; integrate into the ticket queue

  • Your first 28 days: start shipping basic sanitation: clean CI and updated CLAUDE.md files (the instructions our AI agents read) so future pushes don't create more problems

  • Your first 3 months: the worst of the debt is cleared and guardrails are in place, so a bug that has been fixed does not come back; your time will transition over to building new features

What skills and experience are required?

You think in systems. Shown a new product, you look for the states, the transitions and the rules that must always hold before you look at the code. You can draw how it works on one page, and you can predict from that drawing where it will break.

You learn fast and you know how you learn. You will be dropped into a large codebase you did not write. We care much more about how quickly you build an accurate picture of something unfamiliar, and how you change that picture when a fact contradicts it, than about which frameworks you already know.

You have done this before, hands-on. You have owned something that had to be right: a ledger, a billing system, an order or contract lifecycle, a reconciliation between two systems that disagreed. You ran it in production, you can tell us what went wrong with it, and you can tell us what you changed so it could not go wrong again. Being sharp is not a substitute for having done it.

You have built the checks, not only passed them. You have set up CI, tests or release gates for a team that ships many times a day, and you can tell us which checks earned their place and which ones you deleted.

You are fluent with AI coding tools and you do not trust them. You direct Claude Code or similar every day, you verify what it tells you, and you can explain why a plausible AI-written fix is wrong.

You are strong in PostgreSQL and comfortable in TypeScript. Our stack is React and TypeScript on Supabase (Postgres, edge functions). Your depth should be on the data side; you need to read and change the front end without fear, not to be a front-end specialist.

You can make yourself understood. We work in English, mostly in writing: design notes, review comments, briefs for AI agents, replies to colleagues. You need to explain your thinking, ask questions and follow a technical discussion, in writing and on a call. Your English does not need to be polished, and no other language is required.

You say what you think. You will disagree with people who built this system, and with your manager, and we want you to. Bring the evidence.

Typical background: four or more years building production systems, some of it at a company where money or contracts moved through your code. We will happily talk to someone with fewer years and unusual ability.

Nice to have: Supabase, work with CRM integrations.

How we hire

Our process tests how you think. There are four steps: a short video screen; a timed written exercise on an unfamiliar system (up to 90 minutes, no code to write); an interview with your direct manager; and a technical conversation with our lead engineer.

Why this role

You will have a direct hand in a piece of software that replaces a global company's CRM and defines how it sells for the next decade. The team is small, the system is young, and the part you would own does not have an owner today. What you decide will stick.

Why work for Crimson?

  • Rapidly growing company with a flexible working environment where you are empowered to structure how you work

  • Limitless development and exposure: internal promotions and role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year

  • $1000 individual training budget per year, we love to 'Level Up' (it's one of our core values)

  • Psychologist on staff

  • Insightful fireside chats and workshops to support our high-performing and ambitious team

  • Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by

  • We're a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe

If you like understanding how a whole system works and cannot leave a bug alone until you know why it happened, we'd love to hear from you.

Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

Posting Type

Job Overview

About Relativity

Legal technology is having its moment, and Relativity is at the centre of it.

We are a leading legal data intelligence company. Our extensible, AI cloud platform, RelativityOne, is trusted by the world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies to turn complex data into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, arbitration, and other high-stakes legal matters.

In Asia, the momentum speaks for itself: RelativityOne adoption jumped 46% year-over-year, a sign that organisations have moved beyond experimentation and are now applying AI in production environments to modernise how legal work gets done at scale.

To meet this moment, we’re expanding our Singapore team and on-the-ground presence. This is an opportunity to be part of an exciting growth story. You’ll have the backing of an established industry leader and the opportunity to help grow our customer base across Asia.

If you’re ready to help write the next chapter of legal AI in Asia, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description and Requirements

Overview

The Senior Customer Success Manager owns outcomes for a portfolio of large, complex, or strategically

important accounts and raises the bar for what excellence looks like across the team.


This role operates as a strategic consultant and change-management partner, helping customers adopt new product features and

transform how they practice law with AI. Senior CSMs lead multi-use case adoption, advise on AI governance and workflow defensibility, and bring executive presence to high-stakes customer conversations.


What You'll Do:

Own Customer Outcomes End-to-End

  • Build and execute outcome-driven account plans anchored to each customer's business objectives
  • Own the customer's health score across all four dimensions (ROI, adoption, utilization, engagement); drive year-over-year improvement
  • Lead multi-use case and multi-feature adoption strategies; connect platform depth and breadth to measurable customer ROI
  • Deliver referenceable Verified Outcomes that serve as marketing assets; target VO champion status within key accounts

Lead AI Adoption and Change Management

  • Own adoption of our GenAI aiR Suite at the account level, building a clear plan to goal, identifying blockers, overcoming objections, and identifying next steps for each account
  • Lead the conversation from "how to use the product" to "how to transform the way you work," helping customers redesign workflows, calculate their return on investment at the project level, and build the internal case for change
  • Deliver customized onboarding presentations and partner with teams across the business to tailor advanced sessions to customer needs
  • Advise customers on aiR governance and defensibility: what to automate, what to govern, and where human expertise is irreplaceable
  • Document and share AI adoption and change-management playbooks that become team standards

Lead Risk, Retention, and Growth Strategy

  • Independently identify, own, and remediate health risks before they become escalations or commercial risks
  • Anticipate renewal-year dynamics and, in partnership with Sales, build the business case for renewal throughout the account lifecycle
  • Identify expansion signals and surface them to Sales with a documented account perspective; act as a credible commercial partner without owning the transaction

Operate with Executive Presence and Stakeholder Depth

  • Build multi-threaded relationships, including C-suite and executive sponsors; be recognized by customers as a peer
  • Lead tailored Business Reviews and Success Forums with narrative control, business-outcome framing, and quantified impact
  • Navigate complex stakeholder environments; influence direction, challenge assumptions, and orchestrate change without formal authority

Elevate Team Standards and Build Leverage

  • Develop at least one playbook, framework, or enablement asset per year that is adopted by peers or incorporated into team methodology
  • Serve as an informal mentor to L4 CSMs; provide coaching on VO quality, exec engagement, AI adoption conversations, and change-management strategy
  • Represent the team in cross-functional forums; bring customer insight back to inform product, enablement, and operational decisions
  • Use generative AI tools to absorb routine work and model what AI-accelerated execution looks like for the broader team

What We're Looking For

  • 5–8 years in Customer Success, Consulting, or Account Management, with demonstrated ownership of complex enterprise relationships
  • Proven record of driving measurable customer outcomes
  • Strong analytical fluency: able to build and present data-backed ROI narratives to executive audiences
  • Executive presence: credible with C-suite, able to lead high-stakes conversations with clarity and authority
  • AI fluency: able to advise customers on aiR adoption strategy, workflow transformation, and governance
  • Change-management capability: able to help customers build the internal case for AI adoption and navigate resistance across stakeholder levels
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives without formal authority

Required

  • Experience in legal technology, eDiscovery, litigation support, or a regulated workflow environment

Preferred

  • Expertise in AI adoption strategies within enterprise SaaS, including governance and defensibility frameworks
  • Gainsight, Salesforce, or equivalent CS platform proficiency
  • Hands-on experience advising legal teams on AI workflow integration

Account Management, Collaboration, Communication, Customer Advocacy, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Customer Relationships, Customer Retentions, Customer Success, Relationship Management, Strategic Planning

We are looking for a senior commercial leader to own the player economy and monetization strategy across our portfolio.

This is a high-impact leadership role with direct access to senior management, significant decision-making authority and clear ownership of commercial outcomes.For an exceptional candidate, we offer a top-of-market executive compensation package, significant performance-based bonus and meaningful equity participation.

About the Role

You will own the player economy across our RMG and Sweepstakes brands: bonuses, offers, VIP and loyalty, GC/SC coin packages and pricing, segmentation, economy-driven features, game RTP and content mix. You set the economic rules, measure the outcomes and adjust.

You will work across Product, CRM, VIP, User Acquisition, Analytics, Casino, Customer Service and Marketing so every team operates against one economic and monetization plan.

  • Define monetization and economy strategy by vertical, brand and player segment: bonus cost as a share of GGR, promotional depth, VIP reinvestment, pricing and RTP policy.

  • Approve the economics of promotions proposed by CRM, VIP, Customer Service and Marketing and hold teams accountable to the plan.

  • Set RTP policy by brand, market and game category, and manage game/provider mix against margin and retention targets.
