jobs.excerpt: At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people.
jobs.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Clinical Data Science (CDS) is a business unit within Development whose mission is to achieve regulatory approval and successful marketing of new therapies through a reproducible, transparent, efficient, and validated approach to study design, data acquisition, analysis, and interpretation. Our pursuit is to deliver on unmet medical needs by introducing therapies for life-threatening diseases. Within CDS, we strive to reach this goal through excellence in data management, analytical methods, and advanced programmatic approaches to gain insights from a wide range of data assets.


To achieve the commitments of our clinical portfolio, CDS has been developing an agile and sustainable resource model that leverages external partnerships to form a strong alliance with internal Gilead roles. Together, these teams will deliver statistical programming outputs that meet study analysis needs and requirements. The Analysis Oversight Statistical Programming (AOSP) Lead is essential to these partnerships. As a member of the Study Management Team (SMT), the AOSP Lead works closely with the study team to determine the statistical programming requirements, understand study milestones and programming dependencies, and leads the development of the programming outputs.


The Analysis Oversight Statistical Programming Lead is accountable for the development of Analysis Data Model (ADaM) and Table, Figure, and Listing (TFL) deliverables, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance with regulatory and quality standards. This role will progressively review vendor performance metrics in governance meetings to monitor trends and address any challenges, risks, and/or bottlenecks encountered by the study programming team.


The position requires a strong acumen in statistical analysis, focused on achieving high-quality outputs that support clinical results. In addition, the candidate will need to perform quality management, coach and mentor programming colleagues, and provide statistical guidance as it relates to specifics of the study and general processes and statistical program education. The candidate will need to closely monitor the quality and timeliness of clinical trial programming deliverables, provide process guidance, support creation and maintenance of onboarding materials, and direct prioritization and coordination of study related deliverables.


Key Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Exhibits strong statistical & programming knowledge & expertise to influence key decisions on statistical programming outputs and provide guidance to statistical programmers.
  • Attends SMT Meetings, providing functional input on programming related activities and potential risks.
  • Reviews and approves statistical programming requirements (e.g. ADaM Mapping Specifications).
  • Communicates SMT decisions, discussions, and action items to statistical programmers.
  • Reviews and approves key study documents.
  • Helps statistical programmers understand critical study documents.
  • Reviews statistical programming timelines and negotiates with study team if needed.
  • Participates in internal and external audits and identifies areas of opportunity to refine and simplify procedural steps.
  • Analyse vendor performance through assessment of Key Performance and Quality Indicators (e.g. KPI, KQI), metrics, and results.
  • Participates as needed in vendor governance discussions to address any performance related risks and/or concerns.
  • Ensures adequate statistical programming resourcing for study milestones.
  • Assigns tasks to statistical programmers based on experience and ability.
  • Closely monitors and tracks study statistical programming activities within task management system.
  • Maintains regular communications on study statistical programming milestone activities with appropriate study team members and stakeholders.
  • Influences and supports data and submission standards, templates, etc.
  • Performs quality checks to ensure deliverables are complete, accurate, and comply with Gilead and CDISC standards.
    • Ensures programming activities are executed in correct order.
    • Ensures validation documentation, folder locking, and TMF requirements are observed.
  • Surfaces the need for new or updated standards to improve efficiency and uniformity across TA or Indication level objects.
  • Provides prioritization decisions and coaching to fellow onboarding staff as needed to advance their knowledge on Gilead processes and statistical programs & methods.
  • Ensures the programming team identifies data issues and enters accordingly into the Data Issue Log. In addition, ensures all issues and observations noted on the issue log have been resolved prior to final production release.
  • Holds analysis team meetings with Biostatisticians.
  • Serves as the point-of-contact with vendors, and liaisons with other functions.
  • Requests the locking and archiving of study folders.

Minimum Required Education and Years of Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree and Eight Years’ Experience OR Masters' Degree and Five Years’ Experience
  • Minimum 4 years leading studies in Virology, Oncology, or Inflammation Therapeutic Area

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Mature statistical knowledge and expertise in the development of ADaM and TFLs and dependent tasks/activities.
  • Proven track record in delivering high quality statistical programming datasets and outputs.
  • Ability to collaborate and work effectively with global team members and build strong relationships.
  • Expertise working in global teams, across various time-zones to achieve clinical trial milestones.
  • Remains current and has deep knowledge of GCP, ICH guidelines, and regulatory requirements, specifically as it relates to quality oversight, quality assurance, and risk management.
  • Ability to problem-solve using data-driven approaches to help determine the best path forward.
  • Excellent customer-focus with proven track-record in building relationships through superlative communication and writing skills.
  • Superior skills in coaching and mentoring staff of varying skillsets and respectful of cultural differences especially communication styles.
  • Results-oriented and able to work closely with others through great collaboration to resolve challenges, bottlenecks, or risks.
  • Ability to motivate large diverse teams to achieve a common set of goals.
  • Strong experience in data analysis and demonstrated critical thinking skills.
  • Strong programming experience in non-compartmental Pharmacokinetics (PK) analysis for various study designs.
  • Oversee and guide the development of statistical programs for TQT, cQT, pharmacokinetics (PK), and pharmacodynamics (PD) analysis, ensuring adherence to study protocols and regulatory submissions.
  • Able to lead and mentor effective cross functional teams and keep programming team promptly informed of all study activities.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

NAMs Science and Technology Integration Sr Partner

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) are human-relevant approaches that are implemented to improve the quality, speed, and consistency of scientific decision-making. The NAMs Science and Technology Integration Sr Partner, reporting and working in close partnership with the Scientific Director, Translational NAMs Science and Technology Integration, will support our NAMs strategy by connecting scientific expertise, resources, and communities in a way that makes NAM implementation more scalable, reusable, and impactful across the organization. You will help build and sustain the organizational framework that enables cross-functional collaboration, communication, and execution across people, projects, and scientific initiatives to advance coordinated NAM adoption and implementation.

Working at the intersection of scientific strategy, research operations, and organizational enablement, you will partner with leaders across Research functions including Therapeutics Discovery, Research Biology, Data Sciences, Translational Safety and Risk Sciences, Pharmacokinetics and Drug Metabolism; Development functions such as Regulatory Policy; and external collaborators, to coordinate initiatives spanning human-relevant model development, data infrastructure, regulatory engagement, and scientific communities.

Key responsibilities:

  • Partner with the Scientific Director to support development, implementation, and maintenance of an enterprise NAMs strategy, multi-year roadmap, and operating model aligned with Research and Development priorities
  • Establish planning tools and operating rhythms to coordinate implementation of scientific strategy integrated workplans that include milestones, timelines, dependencies, ownership, and success criteria
  • Define, monitor, and communicate outcome-based metrics demonstrating NAM adoption and impact, organizational value, decision support, capability development, and external influence
  • Develop and maintain knowledge-management approaches that curate and enable discovery, reuse, and continuous improvement of NAM models, datasets, contexts of use, model capabilities, and strategic opportunities across the portfolio

  • Partner with scientific leadership to organize and execute meetings, workshops, seminars, and other cross-functional initiatives
  • Help translate strategic scientific opportunities into executable workplans, including scope, deliverables, dependencies, resourcing, timelines, and decision points
  • Partner with scientific leadership to monitor emerging organizational needs and implement operational improvements that enhance collaboration, efficiency, and execution

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 2 years of scientific integration, research operations, strategic initiative experience, or related experience experience

OR

Master’s degree and 4 years of scientific integration, research operations, strategic initiative experience, or related experience experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of scientific integration, research operations, strategic initiative experience, or related experience experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 10 years of scientific integration, research operations, strategic initiative experience, or related experience experience

OR

High school diploma / GED and 12 years of scientific integration, research operations, strategic initiative experience, or related experience experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting or leading complex cross-functional scientific initiatives and demonstrated ability to coordinate large matrix organizations without direct authority
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and manage integrated program plans, including milestones, risks, dependencies, and resource needs, across a complex organization
  • Strong scientific integration, organizational, and relationship-building skills with the ability to align multiple initiatives across diverse stakeholders
  • Experience facilitating scientific collaborations across internal scientific teams and external partners, including academic institutions, CROs, technology providers, industry consortia, and regulatory organizations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex scientific activities into clear plans and executive updates
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and the effective application of AI tools to enhance workplace productivity
  • Experience with NAMs, human-relevant models, in vitro systems, computational/in silico approaches, data-enabled research, or qualification/validation of scientific methods for defined contexts of use
  • Experience building or supporting scientific communities, knowledge-sharing systems, or cross-functional networks that enable collaboration
  • Familiarity with nonclinical regulatory science and the evolving global landscape for NAM acceptance and implementation
  • Experience defining performance metrics and communicating progress, risks, and strategic recommendations to senior scientific leadership
  • Experience supporting strategic planning, business case development, change management, and executive communications in the context of scientific committees or large-scale initiatives
  • Familiarity with drug discovery, translational science, nonclinical safety, and advanced human-relevant model systems
  • Demonstrated ability to develop organizational processes that improve transparency, communication, and operational efficiency
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working in an evolving scientific environment with developing organizational structures and organizational ambiguity

What you can expect from us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Business Area:

IT

Seniority Level:

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

About the Team & Role

We are building an enterprise-grade, Everything-as-Code (EaC) Data Mesh that transforms corporate IT from a manual ticket-driven delivery model into an automated, machine-executable software factory. As the Lead Data Mesh Engineer, you will own the architectural execution and hands-on delivery of our high-throughput, asynchronous event-streaming infrastructure and hybrid data pipelines.


Operating in an environment where every asset, route, and policy must exist as declarative code inside Git, you will architect the "Data-in-Motion" backbone across multi-cloud environments (AWS MSK, Apache NiFi on EKS) and insulate our core on-premises data lakehouse.

As a Lead Data Mesh Engineer, you will:


  • Event-Streaming Architecture (IaC): Architect, provision, and maintain multi-AZ Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (AWS MSK) clusters and Apache NiFi runtimes on Amazon EKS (Graviton ARM64) using Terraform and declarative GitOps patterns.
  • Contract-First Schema Governance: Integrate vendor-neutral Schema Registries (AWS Glue / Apicurio) to enforce strict Apache Avro and AsyncAPI data contracts defined in our central Governance Hub before payloads hit production event topics.
  • Egress & FinOps Optimization: Implement high-performance partition strategies, dynamic storage auto-scaling (gp3/io2), and mandatory local payload compression (Snappy/Zstd) to minimize cross-cloud data movement fees and optimize compute consumption.
  • Resiliency & Out-of-Band Telemetry: Build fault-tolerant Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) automated replay loops and ensure all streaming payloads carry lightweight, out-of-band tracing context across service hops.

We are excited if you have (Required Experience):

  • Bsc/Msc in related field or equivalent experience
  • Distributed Observability: Practical understanding of out-of-band telemetry exhaust, OpenTelemetry standards, and W3C distributed tracing context propagation (Datadog, Otel/OpenTelemetry).
  • Core Streaming & Orchestration: 6+ years of deep, hands-on experience architecting and operating Apache Kafka (preferably AWS MSK) and Apache NiFi in containerized Kubernetes environments (EKS).
  • Data Serialization & Contracts: Expertise in Apache Avro, AsyncAPI, and schema registry management for Master Data Management (MDM) enforcement.

You may also have:

  • Exposure to Policy-as-Code tools (Open Policy Agent / Rego).
  • Hybrid Mesh & Lakehouse Integration: Demonstrated background connecting cloud event meshes to enterprise data lakehouses or big-data monoliths (Cloudera CDP, Hadoop, Hive).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code & GitOps: Advanced proficiency with Terraform and GitOps deployment tools (ArgoCD or Flux) operating under a strict pull-based model.

This role is not eligible for Immigration Sponsorship.

  • Phone and Internet Reimbursement program

  • Access to Continued Career Development

jobs.description:
We Are

Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond, and recover along with all points of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business in every industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, turnkey solutions tailored to our client's needs across their entire value chain. Whether we’re defending against known cyberattacks, detecting and responding to the unknown, or running an entire security operations center, we will help companies build cyber resilience to grow with confidence. Our team of the security sector’s brightest people uses the coolest tech to out-hack the hackers and help clients build resilience from within. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security, and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle.

Do you have the deep functional and technical experience to help implement security solutions that align with our clients’ business objectives? Do you have the expertise to design and deliver solutions for establishing system user's credentials, and processes for applying those credentials to access enterprise systems and applications?

You Are

The Cybersecurity Security Compliance Senior Manager owns the strategy, delivery, and commercial success of cybersecurity compliance programs and assessment portfolios for clients operating within the Defense Industrial Base (DIB), federal marketplace, and regulated commercial environments. This role provides senior leadership across multiple workstreams and Managers (ML7), is accountable for overall program quality, risk, financial performance, and client satisfaction, and serves as a trusted advisor to client CISOs and executive stakeholders.


Engagements will span CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 certification readiness and assessment support, FedRAMP authorization packages (Moderate and High baselines), NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) implementations, and security assessment and authorization (A&A) programs across Products industry clients — with initial demand concentrated in Aerospace & Defense and other highly regulated sectors, including the Rolls-Royce program and the active pursuit pipeline.


The Senior Manager also plays a central role in growing the Security Compliance practice — leading pursuits and solutioning, shaping offerings and delivery accelerators, building and developing the delivery team, and partnering with Accenture Federal Services (AFS) and Products industry leadership to establish a scalable, sustainable delivery model.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own end-to-end delivery of CMMC, FedRAMP, and NIST RMF compliance programs — setting delivery strategy, governing quality, and ensuring on-time, on-budget execution across multiple workstreams

• Serve as the senior client relationship lead for compliance engagements — building trusted-advisor relationships with CISOs, program executives, Authorizing Officials, and IT leadership

• Lead pursuits, proposal development, solution scoping, pricing, and staffing model design for new and expanding compliance opportunities across the Products industries

• Provide executive-level guidance on CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 scoping, CUI identification, assessment boundary decisions, and C3PAO engagement strategy

• Direct FedRAMP authorization strategy — including boundary definition, baseline selection (Moderate and High), Agency and JAB authorization path planning, and continuous monitoring approach

• Oversee quality of core compliance artifacts — System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), Control Implementation Summary (CIS) documents, and authorization packages — before client or assessor submission

• Manage program financials, including revenue forecasting, utilization, margin, and change control, and maintain accurate resource plans aligned to the phased hiring and demand ramp

• Identify, escalate, and resolve material program risks, issues, and dependencies with client and Accenture leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop Managers (ML7), Senior Consultants (ML8), and Consultants (ML9) — setting performance expectations, providing career guidance, and building a strong team culture

• Partner with AFS, Cyber Defense, and Products industry leads to coordinate staffing, share delivery assets, and transition from AFS-supported delivery to a dedicated Security Compliance bench

• Contribute to thought leadership, reusable delivery accelerators, methodology development, and offering definition that scale the Security Compliance practice

• Participate in recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding to build the team required for Q1–Q3 demand

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here’s what we need

  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including a minimum of 4 years in a role with direct program, portfolio, or team leadership accountability in a client-facing or delivery context — experience must include planning, managing, and delivering complex multi-workstream programs, not solely technical or individual contributor activities
  • Minimum of 8 years direct, hands-on experience leading cybersecurity compliance, assessment, or authorization programs involving one or more of the following: CMMC (Level 1 or Level 2), FedRAMP (Moderate or High baseline), NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, or NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) — general NIST CSF awareness alone does not satisfy this requirement
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in a relevant Products industry environment (Aerospace & Defense, Consumer Goods, Life Sciences, Industrial, or similarly regulated sector) with demonstrated understanding of industry-specific regulatory requirements, compliance drivers, and client operating environments
  • Minimum of 8 years demonstrated experience managing program financials, resource plans, and delivery risk across complex, multi-stakeholder engagements
  • Minimum of 8 years demonstrated experience supporting pursuits, proposals, or solution development for cybersecurity or compliance services
  • Minimum of 8 years working knowledge of CMMC scoping guidance, CMMC Practice requirements (Levels 1 and 2), and the Cyber AB ecosystem — including the roles of OSCs, C3PAOs, RPOs, Registered Practitioners (RPs), and Registered Practitioner Advanced (RPA)
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years work experience; Associate's Degree + minimum 6 years work experience)

Professional Skills requirements

  • Familiarity with federal cybersecurity policy — including DFARS 252.204-7012, FISMA, CUI handling requirements (32 CFR Part 2002), and OMB guidance applicable to contractor and agency compliance obligations

The Construction Engineer III is a senior technical contributor within SOLV’s Construction Engineering organization, focused on advanced engineering judgment, problem‑solving, and technical leadership, not personnel management. This role applies deep construction and engineering expertise across Warranty Analysis, Emerging Technologies Implementation, Construction Engineering Support During Operations, and Pile Load Testing Support During Initial Design. The Construction Engineer III independently resolves complex technical issues, leads high‑risk engineering scopes, and serves as a technical authority for project teams while remaining an individual contributor.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.


Position Responsibilities and Duties:

Warranty Forensics

  • Lead technical root‑cause analysis of complex or high‑impact warranty issues involving design intent, installation methodology, or system performance.
  • Independently evaluate field conditions against engineering standards, specifications, and contract requirements to determine technical responsibility.
  • Develop engineering‑based remediation recommendations and preventative measures to reduce recurrence.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point for warranty issues requiring advanced engineering judgment.

Emerging Technologies Implementation

  • Serve as a technical subject‑matter expert for advanced construction technologies including GPS‑enabled pile driving, drone‑based surveys, and machine‑control systems.
  • Review, validate, and approve engineering datasets and workflows prior to field deployment.
  • Troubleshoot complex technology or data‑integration issues and develop corrective technical solutions.
  • Lead refinement of technical SWIs related to construction technology usage and data integrity.
  • Evaluate new construction technologies and provide technical feasibility and risk assessments to leadership.

Construction Engineering Support During Operations

  • Serve as a senior technical resource for field teams, project managers, and external engineers when resolving complex constructability or design‑execution challenges.
  • Lead resolution of technically complex RFIs and engineering clarifications requiring interpretation of design intent, contract language, and field constraints.
  • Identify systemic or recurring constructability risks and recommend engineering or procedural improvements.
  • Support owner and independent engineer (IE) discussions as a technical representative, defending engineering positions when required.

Pile Load Testing Support During Initial Design

  • Lead technical coordination and interpretation of pre‑construction pile load testing programs.
  • Analyze pile load test results to identify trends, anomalies, and implications for foundation design and constructability.
  • Provide expert technical input to civil, structural, and geotechnical teams based on testing outcomes.
  • Identify early‑stage foundation risks and recommend mitigation strategies grounded in data and field observations.

General Engineering Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced drawing reviews, scope validations, and constructability assessments across multiple projects.
  • Mentor junior engineers through technical guidance and knowledge sharing, not formal supervision or performance management.
  • Contribute to development of engineering standards, best practices, and lesson-learned documentation.
  • Serve as a technical advisor to Construction Engineering Managers and leadership on complex or high‑risk scopes.

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Environmental Studies, or a closely related technical field (required).
  • Typically, 4–7 years of relevant experience in construction engineering, EPC execution, or equivalent technical roles, demonstrating progressive technical responsibility.
  • Demonstrated progression in technical competency, with the ability to independently analyze, diagnose, and resolve complex construction engineering challenges without direct supervision.
  • Advanced ability to read, interpret, and apply civil, structural, electrical, and geotechnical drawings, specifications, and design standards.
  • Proven experience supporting construction operations, pile load testing programs, warranty analysis, and multidisciplinary engineering coordination.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, including the ability to evaluate technical risk, assess constructability impacts, and recommend engineering‑based solutions.
  • Ability to serve as a technical authority for field teams and internal stakeholders on complex engineering issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with project teams, consultants, owners, and independent engineers.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word); working knowledge of CAD, GIS, GPS machine‑control datasets, and drone‑based survey platforms preferred.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast‑paced construction environment while supporting multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Willingness and ability to perform field work and travel as required to support project execution

Are you passionate about fostering organisational thriving, mental wellbeing, and staff resilience during times of change? As our Senior P&C Partner for Wellbeing, Resilience, and Engagement, you will provide high-level strategic coaching, hands-on guidance, and innovative thought leadership across our global network.

In a world of evolving challenges and shrinking civic spaces, you will work closely with senior leaders across National and Regional Organisations (NROs) to nurture staff vitality, embed data-informed engagement strategies, and champion inclusive practices. If you are driven by care, collaboration, and systemic impact, this role offers a meaningful opportunity to help build a workplace culture where everyone can truly flourish.

The Senior P&C Partner, Wellbeing, Resilience, and Engagement provides high-level, proactive, and client-focused support to relevant stakeholders by proactively strengthening the strategic P&C function across Greenpeace. A central priority of this role is supporting NROs capacity to maintain staff engagement while navigating moments of turbulence, including organisational change, shrinking civic spaces, stress and burnout, and resource constraints. Partnering directly with senior leaders in NROs, the role delivers coaching, strategic guidance, and operational support.

Additionally, the Senior P&C Partner provides thought leadership in wellbeing, resilience, and engagement to global community leaders across the Greenpeace network. The role drives cultural transformation and enhances the overall employee experience by identifying and implementing opportunities for experimentation.

Working collaboratively and embedding a diverse, inclusive, and agile approach, the Senior P&C Partner helps to build and reinforce an organisational culture anchored in sustainability and impact.

In this role you will

  • Design and embed wellbeing and engagement strategies and initiatives that support the contribution, vitality, and wellbeing of staff across GPI and the global network.

  • Partner directly with senior leaders in National and Regional Organisations (NROs) to deliver strategic guidance, coaching, and operational support during moments of organisational turbulence, shrinking civic spaces, and resource constraints.

  • Build and maintain a network of external specialists focused on wellbeing and engagement to support P&C priorities.

  • Implement data-informed tools and metrics to track wellbeing, resilience, and engagement across organisations to shape strategic direction.

  • Roll out knowledge-sharing initiatives, toolboxes, and guidelines across the network, while acting as a trusted advisor to key stakeholders on broader P&C matters.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align P&C strategies, embed JEDIS principles, and facilitate healthy employee relations across diverse cultural contexts.

For further information about this role, please see the job description and terms of reference.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

Remember no one has every skill or experience needed for this role and you’ll have the opportunity to learn a lot from the team.

Note: We are happy to consider applicants who don't meet all criteria below as we are open to considering this role as a growth opportunity. The level of appointment will match the successful candidate (Partner or Sr. Partner).

  • Demonstrated skill in coaching and advising, especially senior level roles

  • L&D and change management experience, particularly focusing on stakeholder analysis and engagement

  • Confidentiality, diplomacy, and empathy in client service across a diverse range of clients

Greenpeace is a global campaigning network. It comprises 26 independent national/regional organisations, and a coordinating organisation, Greenpeace International.

Greenpeace uses peaceful, creative confrontation to expose global environmental problems, and develop solutions for a green and peaceful future.

Our goal is to ensure the ability of the earth to nurture life in all its diversity. That means we want to:

  • protect biodiversity in all its forms

  • prevent pollution and abuse of the earth’s ocean, land, air and fresh water

  • end all nuclear threats

To Apply

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead (PLG B2B SaaS, Remote, Ukraine)
jobs.excerpt: Our client is an early-stage, product-led B2B SaaS company that helps B2B teams make their LinkedIn advertising pay off sooner.
jobs.description:
Our client is an early-stage, product-led B2B SaaS company that helps B2B teams make their LinkedIn advertising pay off sooner. The product picks up the signals that lead to revenue before a deal closes (LinkedIn engagement, website visits, movement in the CRM) so customers can see what works in time to shift their budget.

The product is self-serve, with a 30-day free trial and no card required. A growing share of it already works inside the AI assistants customers use every day, such as Claude: through the company's MCP server, an assistant reads the account's ad, CRM and website data and turns it into reports, audits, benchmarks and recommendations.

In its first year on the market the team went from a product alone to steady inbound demand, top Google rankings for its core keywords, a daily publishing rhythm, a network of partnerships and a fast-growing user community. The next step is already in progress: the team is prototyping the next, AI-first version of the product.

Why this role exists

There is a Growth Marketing Lead who covers how people find the product and sign up. The Product Marketing Lead role owns what happens next: which of those people are the right users, how they reach value, why they pay and why they leave.

You sit between product and marketing. The product team decides what gets built and what the architecture allows; you bring the market evidence, shape how the product is packaged, priced and onboarded, and come back with proposals for what the product should do to win. We are not looking for someone who waits for a finished feature and is then told to go sell it.

What you will own

  • ICP and messaging: who the product is for, what we tell them, and one shared place where this lives for the whole team.
  • Activation, retention and churn: the path from sign-up to first value to paid, why accounts leave, and the experiments that change both.
  • Packaging and pricing, together with the product lead: what goes into each plan, where the price sits against competitors, how the credit-based model should evolve. This is among the first things you will work on.
  • Onboarding: how a new account learns the product in its first weeks.
  • The company's own LinkedIn Ads: you run the company's LinkedIn campaigns using the product itself, so you know it the way customers use it.
  • Market and competitor research turned into product proposals, brought to the product team with evidence, including into the work on the next version of the product.
  • Hands-on work: in a small team everyone contributes to strategy and everyone ships.

How the team works

  • You report directly to the company's founder.
  • You work every day with the Growth Marketing Lead, the Content Lead, the product lead and the CTO. Growth answers for how many leads come in; you define which leads are the right ones.
  • Some friction with product on pricing and packaging is expected, and welcome: that is how the two sides find the right answer.
  • Claude and other AI tools are provided and used daily. The team expects you to use them a lot, check what they produce, and know the product well enough to see when the output is wrong.
  • The team values people who will say openly what is not working in the product and propose what to change, with confidence that comes from their own experience.

Requirements

  • Product marketing in a product-led (PLG) B2B SaaS company. This weighs more than anything else here. In PLG the product is the sales channel: you change what people see in the product so that more of them try it, reach value and stay.
  • LinkedIn Ads you launched yourself. You have personally set up and run LinkedIn campaigns, even small ones. Deep optimization can be learned on the job; a first launch of your own cannot be skipped. Experience with Meta (Facebook) or Google Ads does not replace it.
  • Activation, retention and pricing experience: you have worked on the path from trial to paid, on churn, or on plans and prices, and can show what changed as a result.
  • Your own market research, and a view on what the product should build next.
  • Practical, daily AI use: research, analysis and reports with AI tools, and the habit of checking what they produce.
  • Self-management: you plan your own week and close what you start without reminders.
  • English at C1: you write messaging and pages for the US market yourself.
  • Fluent spoken and written Ukrainian: the team works in Ukrainian.

Nice to have

  • Experience with hybrid "subscription plus consumption" pricing (credits, usage-based plans) and choosing a value metric.
  • Hands-on work with MCP, AI connectors or open APIs, or product marketing for a product with such an integration.
  • Experience at a similar early stage, where one person covered research, pricing and onboarding.
  • Experience shaping product positioning.
  • Building your own automations with AI.

This probably isn't a fit if you

  • Have worked only in sales-led or enterprise marketing, where the sales team closes the deal.
  • Are a performance marketer first, without product marketing ownership of activation, pricing or onboarding.
  • Have paid-ads experience only on Meta or Google.
  • Prefer to take a finished feature and take it to market rather than shape what gets built.

What we offer

  • Full-time, remote from anywhere in Ukraine. Lviv is a plus. One trip to Lviv to meet the team is welcome; there is no regular travel.
  • Military service deferment (бронювання) through the company, details at the offer stage.
  • 24 calendar days of paid vacation plus 5 sick days a year, and Ukrainian public holidays.
  • Learning paid by the company: LinkedIn Learning and courses on platforms such as Coursera.
  • Claude and the other tools you need for the work.

Interview process

  • Screening call with DNA325
  • Interview with the president
  • Test task
  • Soft skills assessment
  • HR interview
  • Final interview with the company's investor

Before you apply

Please answer these three questions in your cover letter. Applications without answers will not be reviewed.

  • The PLG B2B SaaS product you did product marketing for: its name, a link, and your role there.
  • LinkedIn Ads: did you create and launch campaigns yourself in Campaign Manager? Roughly how many, over what period, and in what monthly budget range?
  • One link to something you shipped that users saw: a pricing page, onboarding flow, in-app message, email sequence or landing page (live or archived), plus one line on what you changed.

  • Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Engineering, and Application teams to plan and track remediation.
  • Follow up on overdue items and escalate through defined channels.
  • Maintain auditable records of remediation decisions and approvals.
  • Support security reviews for transformation and new technology projects to identify risks early.
  • Support Security Operations and Incident Response with vulnerability context during active threats.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Supports the organization's quality program(s).
  • Travels as required.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Licensing
Bachelor's degree in a computer related field from an accredited college or university preferred or equivalent. Major in information systems or computer science preferred. CompTIA Security+ certification, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender (GCED), and/or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) is a plus.

Experience

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in vulnerability management, information security, or a related IT infrastructure or security role.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise vulnerability scanning platforms (for example Tenable, Qualys, or Rapid7).
  • Working knowledge of vulnerability scoring and classification frameworks such as CVSS, CVE, and CWE, and of exploit prioritization concepts such as EPSS and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
  • Understanding of operating systems (Windows and Linux), networking fundamentals, and common enterprise technologies.
  • Experience coordinating remediation with technical teams and tracking items to closure through ticketing systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Vulnerability management lifecycle: discovery, assessment, prioritization, remediation, verification, and reporting.
  • Vulnerability scoring and intelligence sources, including CVSS, CVE, CWE, EPSS, and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
  • Network architecture and protocols, including segmentation, firewalls, and exposure of internet-facing assets.
  • Application security concepts, including OWASP Top 10 and the use of SAST, DAST, and SCA results.
  • Attack surface management and asset discovery concepts.
  • Common attacker techniques and exploit trends, including the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and PCI DSS.
  • Risk-based prioritization using exploitability, asset criticality, and business impact.
  • Ability to validate findings and distinguish true positives from false positives.
  • Data analysis and trend identification for metrics such as mean time to remediate and SLA compliance.
  • Sound judgment when recommending compensating controls where patching is not feasible.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including translating technical risk for non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to influence and drive accountability with system and application owners without direct authority.
  • Effective escalation and stakeholder management.
  • Collaboration with Security Operations, Incident Response, Engineering, Cloud, and Infrastructure teams.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and meet defined deadlines.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive vulnerability and risk information.
  • Commitment to continuous learning as the threat landscape evolves.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Job title: Lead – US Public Affairs and Patient Advocacy, Immunology

  • Location: Remote, US

About the Job

The mission of the US Public Affairs & Patient Advocacy (PA & PA) team is to listen, act, and lead as the trusted partner for patient advocacy organizations and professional societies in pursuit of increasing the patient voice in R&D, protecting access, and improving health for patients and caregivers.


We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as the Lead, US Public Affairs & Patient Advocacy - Immunology. This role will play a crucial part in shaping the company's public affairs strategies and patient advocacy efforts in the field of immunology.


Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities for the US PA team

  • Manage constellation of advocacy partners (new and existing), build engagement plans, and nurture robust, long-term relationships
  • Develop and implement disease-specific strategic plans with corresponding budgets to guide engagement and investment on shared priorities
  • Engage with internal stakeholders to share business-relevant updates and insights and participate in business-driven workstreams in support of shared priorities
  • Participate in PA & PA cross-team initiatives above disease-area to differentiate Sanofi’s leadership in the healthcare space
  • Collaborate effectively with global teams and alliance partners as needed to ensure One Sanofi approach with stakeholders

Partnership Mapping and Engagement

  • Identify and map key partners in the current and future immunology disease states. Participate in stewardship of relationships with existing partners and initiate relationships with new partner organizations as needed.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with partner organizations focused on understanding shared unmet needs.
  • Collaborate with partners to build their capacity in relevant areas and support programs aligned with shared needs.

Strategic Planning

  • Work closely with business stakeholders to inform the development of strategic plans related to immunology indications (current and future) and support implementation of cross-functional and global initiatives where US involvement is vital.
  • Drive US PA & PA strategic plan for immunology indications, particularly pipeline assets
  • Identify gaps in strategic plans and develop solutions to address them.
  • Participate in the implementation of strategic plans.

Access and Affordability

  • Address access and affordability issues across various indications within immunology.
  • Build capacity at partner organizations to enhance their understanding and ability to tackle access and affordability challenges.
  • Liaise with Government Relations and Policy teams to share patient community perspectives on access and affordability issues.
  • Create educational resources to inform partner organizations about key issues related to access and affordability trends.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including patient advocacy groups, healthcare professionals, and policymakers.
  • Communicate the company's patient advocacy initiatives and perspectives clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences.
  • Identify areas of synergy with other functions and move forward collaborative programs as One Sanofi

About You

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of experience in public affairs, patient advocacy, or related roles within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage with patient advocacy group; preference for experience in immunology.
  • Strong understanding of access and affordability issues in healthcare.
  • Ability to communicate clearly to a variety of audiences.

The ideal candidate will be

  • Flexible, adaptive, open-minded
  • Creative, innovative, curious
  • Results-oriented, driven, focused on goals
  • Positive, motivated, eager to learn and grow

Why Choose Us

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness program

jobs.title: Senior Graphic Designer
jobs.excerpt: Full-time | Remote, U. S.  | 9 a. m.  to 5 p. m.  Central Who We Are and What We Do Fluxe Digital Marketing is a content marketing agency.
jobs.description:
Full-time | Remote, U.S. | 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central

Who We Are and What We Do

Fluxe Digital Marketing is a content marketing agency. We interview business owners about what they know, then turn one hour of their time each month into a month of content in their own voice. Since 2009 we have worked with more than 150 clients across more than 30 industries, from concierge medical practices to ecommerce brands.

Please take some time to learn about our mission and values. They drive everything we do.

Why This Role Exists

We are taking on new clients and doing more for the ones we have. We are hiring a senior designer to make the emails, graphics, and pages behind our clients’ marketing, and to raise the standard of how our clients and Fluxe itself look.

This is a hands-on role. Most weeks are full of client production work across many formats. The senior part is the judgment you bring to it: you see what could be better and you say so.

If this sounds like the work you want to do, we’d like to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Design and build email

  • Design email and newsletter templates and campaign graphics that read well on desktop and mobile.
  • Build campaign emails in Klaviyo and other email platforms.

Design client creative

  • Featured images for blog posts, plus graphics inside the post, such as mini infographics, callouts, and charts that make the content easier to understand.
  • Social graphics and quote cards.
  • Static ads for Meta, plus charts and mockups.
  • Light video edits and simple motion graphics for social.

Design landing pages

  • Design landing pages and web pages for our clients. Our team builds them; you design them and check the result on desktop and mobile.

Design longer pieces

  • PDFs, brochures, and downloadable guides, plus the occasional print piece such as a magazine ad or postcard.
  • Keep each client’s brand style guide current.

Improve our own brand

  • Help us improve Fluxe’s own identity, website, and collateral.

You’ll work with our CRO specialist, our account manager, our strategists, our editors, and our scheduling assistant.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Client emails and creative ship on time and on brand.
  • Most graphics are approved after one round of feedback, and most email and page designs within two.
  • You bring us improvements to our clients’ brands and to our own before we ask.

Logistics

  • Full-time, 100 percent remote position.
  • Open to candidates based in the U.S.
  • Working hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central time.
  • Start date: as soon as possible.
  • We expect to close applications by December 31, 2026, and may extend.

How We Hire

We keep our process simple and we pay you for your time on the test.

  1. Apply and answer the questions in the application.
  2. We review your portfolio.
  3. A 30-minute video call with our team, including a short screen-share walkthrough of one piece of your work.
  4. A short paid design test.
  5. Two interviews: one about your work so far, and one with our founder.

What to send: your resume, your portfolio link, and your LinkedIn profile (if you have one).

A note on AI: we use AI every day and expect you to as well. In your answers, give us the specifics only you would know: the situation, the numbers, and what changed. Polished but general answers will not move forward.

Interested? We’d love to hear from you!

Fluxe Digital Marketing is an equal opportunity employer.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Four or more years of professional graphic design, with a portfolio that includes email designs, at least one web page or landing page design, and at least two other formats, such as social posts, ads, PDFs, or print.
  • Strong skills in Figma, Canva, or Adobe Creative Cloud, including print-ready files when a project calls for one.
  • Hands-on experience building emails in an email platform such as Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or HubSpot. If yours is not Klaviyo, you’ll be building in it within your first 30 days.
  • A working knowledge of web design. You know what a good landing page looks like and can design one. You do not need to code or build it.
  • Basic video editing skills, and an eye for a good edit: pacing, where to cut, and what to keep.
  • The ability to follow a brand guide closely, and the confidence to point out where a client’s visuals, or ours, could be better.
  • You use AI tools in your design work today and want to learn more of them, with the eye to fix what they get wrong. We provide the subscriptions.
  • Strong organization. You work from due dates and deliver on time.
  • Based in the U.S. and able to work 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central time.

Preferred

  • Experience building emails in Klaviyo, including its drag-and-drop editor.
  • Experience designing for healthcare or ecommerce brands.
  • Experience with Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.
  • Motion graphics experience, such as After Effects or animated social graphics.

Benefits

  • Regular performance reviews, with opportunities for pay increases as you grow in the role.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, with Fluxe paying 50 percent of the premium.
  • Paid time off and 13 paid company holidays. Time off is planned ahead with the team so client work stays covered.
  • Fully remote.
  • No nights or weekends.

jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

This position is responsible for developing the capabilities of Henry Schein's US Dental sales organization through high-impact facilitation, coaching, reinforcement, and field-based learning. This role translates sales strategy, business priorities, products, processes, and technology into practical skills and behaviors that Field Sales Consultants and other sales professionals can apply with customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Facilitate engaging, practical sales training for new and existing Field Sales Consultants and other sales roles through live, virtual, blended, and field-based learning experiences.
  • Build seller capability across consultative selling, customer conversations, business acumen, product and solution knowledge, systems, technology, tools, and strategic initiatives.
  • Create opportunities for practice, role play, application, feedback, and coaching that move learning beyond presentation-based training.
  • Conduct regular field co-travels and observations with Field Sales Consultants and other appropriate sales roles to assess capability, identify skill gaps, evaluate application of training, and understand emerging development needs.
  • Observe seller performance and provide practical, actionable coaching and feedback to strengthen confidence, proficiency, and execution.
  • Partner with Regional Managers and other field sales leaders to identify capability needs, reinforce learning after formal training, and support consistent execution of national training priorities.
  • Support sales managers with tools, resources, and coaching approaches that help reinforce desired sales behaviors and continued development.
  • Follow up on major training initiatives to understand adoption, identify areas requiring additional support, and provide targeted coaching when appropriate.
  • Partner with the Instructional Designer to translate field needs into relevant curricula, learning experiences, simulations, case studies, job aids, and performance-support tools while providing field insight and application expertise.
  • Support the introduction and adoption of new sales tools, technology, processes, products, and strategic initiatives by connecting training to practical customer and field application.
  • Collect structured feedback from learners, managers, and field leaders and evaluate learner proficiency and observed application of targeted skills and behaviors.
  • Partner with Sales Training leadership and the Instructional Designer to evaluate training effectiveness using proficiency, adoption, field behavior, manager feedback, and relevant business performance indicators where measurable.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of Henry Schein's sales processes, customer environment, solutions, strategic priorities, and the evolving dental marketplace.
  • Facilitate national, regional, new-hire, supplier, and other sales training programs as required and participate in strategic projects supporting the national Sales Training organization.

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong facilitation, presentation, coaching, and communication skills with demonstrated ability to engage adult learners.
  • Strong understanding of consultative selling, customer conversations, sales processes, and field sales execution.
  • Ability to translate complex product, process, technology, or business information into practical sales application.
  • Ability to coach individuals and groups in a constructive, motivating, and performance-focused manner.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to establish credibility with sales professionals, managers, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to quickly learn new products, technologies, processes, and business strategies and effectively teach others.
  • Experience using virtual facilitation tools, learning technologies, sales enablement platforms, CRM systems, and related digital tools preferred.
  • Dental, healthcare distribution, B2B sales, sales enablement, or comparable commercial experience preferred.

GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

  • Strong management and leadership skills and ability to attract, retain, motivate, develop and mentor team members for high performance
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills and ability to resolve disputes effectively
  • Excellent presentation and public speaking skills
  • Excellent independent decision making, analysis and problem solving skills
  • Understand and act on financial information that contributes to business profitability
  • Ability to plan and manage successful projects; understand available resources, develop timeline, budget, assign tasks and areas of responsibility
  • Lead team(s) to achieve company goals in creative and effective ways
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills and techniques
  • Communicate effectively with senior management
  • Good negotiating skills and ability to effectively manage outsourced relationships
  • Ability to influence,build relationships, understand organizational complexities and manage conflict
  • Broad professional and managerial skills with a good understanding of industry practices and company policies and procedures
  • Ability to lead virtual teams

MINIMUM WORK EXPERIENCE:

Typically 10 or more years of increasing responsibility and complexity in terms of any applicable professional experience; 1 or more years of management experience.

PREFERRED EDUCATION:

Typically a Bachelor's Degree or global equivalent in related discipline. Master's degree or global equivalent a plus.

jobs.description:
About the team

Follow Up Boss (FUB) is Zillow’s central Customer Relationship Management platform, empowering real estate agents and teams to manage leads, build client relationships, and automate workflows. As the core of Zillow’s agent tooling ecosystem, we partner closely with other Zillow teams to deliver innovative solutions that help agents and consumers connect and collaborate. Our team is focused on accelerating FUB’s evolution through product innovation, platform modernization, operational maturity, and AI-powered capabilities that enhance both agent and engineering experiences.

About the role

As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will lead high-impact initiatives that shape the future of Follow Up Boss. You will bring clarity to complex challenges, unite teams around shared goals, and drive programs that advance FUB’s capabilities and strategic roadmap. Your work will influence architectural and product direction, strengthen agent workflows, and help integrate AI into next-generation experiences for agents and engineers. This is an opportunity to drive meaningful change and raise the bar for program leadership at Zillow.


As a Principal Technical Program Manager, You Will Get To:

  • Define and drive strategic initiatives and technical investments across multiple engineering teams, creating clarity in ambiguous problem spaces and ensuring alignment with product and engineering leadership.
  • Collaborate with leaders and cross-functional partners to translate business objectives into clear technical program structures, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Serve as the connective tissue across engineering, product, design, operations, and customer support, fostering strong cross-team partnerships.
  • Partner with engineering and technical leaders to influence architectural direction, identify risks, recommend scalable solutions, and guide teams toward sound technical decisions.
  • Lead program execution from concept through delivery, shaping scope, breaking work into milestones, anticipating risks, and enabling teams to deliver reliably.
  • Drive process and operational improvements that enhance visibility, reduce coordination costs, and strengthen platform reliability and maturity.
  • Champion AI adoption by identifying opportunities to incorporate AI into agent-facing products and engineering workflows, and modeling effective use of AI tools.
  • Mentor TPMs and other program leaders, share best practices, and help scale program leadership capabilities across Follow Up Boss Engineering.

This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $173,000.00 - $276,400.00 annually. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 8+ years of Technical Program Management experience leading complex, multi-team engineering initiatives.
  • Strong technical fluency across modern engineering practices and the software development lifecycle, with the ability to engage in technical discussions and drive quality improvements.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering leaders to influence long-term technical and platform strategy.
  • Proven track record of driving clarity, alignment, and execution across engineering, product, and operational teams in high-ambiguity environments.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

jobs.description:
Who we are

We’re Ethena, an AI platform that’s revolutionizing the Compliance space. Our team of agents helps Compliance and People leaders run proactive Compliance programs that drive real behavior change.

From Policies and Disclosures to Training, Hotline, and Analytics, our agents work together to drive smarter, faster, human-led decision-making. Hotline and training data rolls up into fully customizable, board-ready risk reports. Our AI call taker synthesizes data to recommend improvements to company policies and training. Every signal lands in one place, so Compliance leaders can spot risk early and fix it before it becomes a problem. The agents do the legwork, and people make every judgment call.

More than 2,000 organizations, from Pinterest and Zendesk to the Salvation Army, run their programs on Ethena. That covers millions of employees, from the warehouse floor to desktop workers. Learners give our training a 93% approval rating, 96% of customers renew, and our business is growing quickly with 50%+ YoY revenue growth.

Lots of companies call themselves AI-forward. We’ve actually built the tools to prove it. Come help us build what’s next.

How we work

We’re a team that values diversity in all its forms and loves adding new perspectives. We ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and build with empathy — for customers and each other. We're passionate about the work we do, love feedback, and lead with high agency and accountability. When we see something that could be better, we step up to the plate and do something about it. We take our work seriously, but are careful not to take ourselves too seriously. Because doing great work should be fun.
Our workforce is fully remote, and your personal working hours can be based on your own timezone. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of all North American time zones.

Who we’re looking for

Ethena is looking for a Customer Success Engineer who sits at the intersection of technical implementation, product expertise, and AI-powered workflows. This isn't a traditional CSM role — you'll be central to how new customers get onboarded and configured, using AI tools to move faster and build smarter than a traditional implementation function. You'll work closely with our Account Management team to ensure customers go live quickly, integrate deeply, and expand confidently.

What You'll Do

  • Own technical implementation for your book of customers — HRIS integrations, SSO setup, LMS connectors, API configurations, and assignment automation logic.

  • At the Associate level you'll start with mid-market accounts and grow into enterprise; at the Senior level you'll own complex enterprise implementations from the start.

  • Use, extend and build AI-powered workflows to automate repeatable implementation tasks (e.g., launch requirements, config QA, onboarding documentation generation)

  • Partner with AMs to run discovery on technical requirements during kickoffs and translate them into scoped implementation plans

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact during onboarding, reducing time-to-value for new customers

  • Diagnose and resolve integration issues, working cross-functionally with Product and Engineering when needed

  • Work from our implementation playbooks and documentation, and flag where the process could be more efficient. You'll also own improving them, using AI tooling like AI Training Builder, internal Compass workflows, and vibe-coding your own apps

  • Contribute to the scaled enablement motion by building reusable templates, guides, and self-serve assets

  • Experience in a Customer Success, CS Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Implementation Consulting, or Technical CSM role — ideally at a SaaS company

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to improve workflow efficiency and solve customer problems — not just "familiar with AI," but actually building workflows that save time and reduce manual work

  • Excitement to take troubleshooting work off an engineer’s plate and solve a problem yourself

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and interest in building process where none exists

  • Strong written communication skills; you can explain technical concepts to non-technical compliance buyers

  • Passion for what we're building at Ethena and strong alignment with our core values.

  • Bonus: experience in compliance, HR tech, or legal tech

At Ethena, we're committed to fair and equitable compensation. We carefully evaluate each candidate's skills and qualifications to provide our best possible offer upfront. Our no-negotiation policy ensures that our first offer is always our best offer, promoting pay equity throughout our organization.

Physical Demands

This is sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing in a home office environment.

Location

Ethena is a remote-first organization and is currently hiring candidates based in the United States.
We are not currently offering employer visa sponsorship for this role.

AI Usage in Interviews:

We’re big fans of AI and use it heavily in our day-to-day work. That said, to ensure fairness and accurate skill assessment, we do not allow the use of AI tools (including note takers, transcription tools, or recordings) during interviews. If you have questions or need accommodations, we’re happy to chat — just let us know.

Benefits

How to Apply

Applications for this position will be accepted via our job board. Excited about the opportunity, but worried you don’t meet all the requirements? Apply anyway, and give us both the chance to find out. We welcome you to read more about our approach to job descriptions by our Chief People Officer, Melanie Naranjo. Curious to know what it’s like to interview with us? Read more here.
Ethena is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a successful organization is one that celebrates its employees for who they are, who they love, and the unique lens through which they experience the world. Ethena does not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or other legally protected status. jobs.description:
What You Can Expect

This role is the operational backbone of Zoom’s Renewals function, responsible for transforming how the business forecasts, interprets, and acts on renewal and churn performance across a global, multi-geo post-sales organization. You will partner directly with Data Science, Analytics, Finance, Customer Success, and Renewals leadership to refine and scale an existing forecasting framework, surface leading indicators early, and build executive-ready insights that drive clear decisions and accountable outcomes.
This is a high-velocity environment where the expectation is to make an impact immediately: data ownership sits with partner teams, which means your ability to collaborate, influence without authority, and build trusted relationships is as important as your analytical depth.


About the Team

The Retention Operations team is part of Zoom’s broader post-sales organization, which spans deployment, Customer Success, and Renewals across four global theaters, each led by geo-focused Renewals leaders. The team’s mission is to bring structure, rigor, and accountability to a Renewals function that is actively maturing: building the standardized forecasting cadence, governance, and operational infrastructure that Zoom’s scale now demands. By aligning data, tooling, and process across cross-functional partners, Retention Operations enables Renewals leadership to make faster, more confident decisions that protect and grow Zoom’s recurring revenue base.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end renewals and churn forecasting, including methodology refinement, model design, reporting, and operational cadence, serving as the primary point of contact for renewals forecasting in partnership with FP&A and Renewals leadership.
  • Establish quarterly and half-year churn and renewals forecasts by synthesizing predictive models, historical performance, business signals, and field inputs into a bottoms-up, account- and product-level outlook.
  • Drive measurable improvement in forecasting accuracy as the primary lagging metric, identifying and closing gaps between early-quarter assumptions and in-quarter actuals.
  • Continuously improve forecasting models in collaboration with Analytics and Data Science, incorporating leading indicators to increase accuracy, confidence, and visibility.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Renewals leadership, developing an independent, data-backed view of business performance and constructively challenging forecast assumptions when data indicates a different outcome.
  • Proactively identify and communicate material in-quarter changes based on shifts in model predictions, leading indicators, and business performance, independent of Renewal Manager (RM)-reported line of sight.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Renewals, Customer Success, Sales, and Finance on forecast assumptions, account ownership, renewal timing, risks, and execution.
  • Establish governance around renewal processes and programs, covering suspensions, account movement, deal hygiene, and end-to-end program performance tracking and optimization.
  • Build executive-ready reporting and insights that clearly articulate forecast movement, churn and contraction risk, key drivers, forecast gaps, and required actions.
  • Partner with Analytics and Data Science to evolve predictive capabilities, including churn-risk and renewal opportunity scoring, to improve prioritization and decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Renewals leadership and Finance on long-range planning, capacity modeling, and target setting for the Renewals organization.
  • Identify and lead process, tooling, and automation improvements that reduce manual effort, improve RM productivity, and increase operational scalability.
  • Partner with Compensation and Finance on renewals compensation operations, including attainment calculations, quota setting, and payout validation.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in RevOps, SalesOps, RenewalOps, or RetentionOps with demonstrated ownership of forecasting and business performance in a recurring-revenue environment.
  • Proven ownership of renewals or retention forecasting methodology, with fluency in GRR, NRR, and churn metrics and experience translating those signals into bottoms-up forecasts and executive-ready insights.
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to develop an independent, data-backed point of view, constructively challenge assumptions, and influence senior leaders across Renewals, Finance, and Customer Success.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience building forecasts, dashboards, and executive reporting, translating complex data into clear business recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively across cross-functional teams including Finance, Renewals, Customer Success, Analytics, and Data Science, including in environments with challenging stakeholder groups and limited prior operational support.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker; experience with Clari or equivalent revenue forecasting platforms strongly preferred.
  • Experience in enterprise SaaS or subscription-based tech with a track record of driving measurable improvements in forecasting accuracy, retention, or RM productivity, and the proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal process infrastructure.
