jobs.description:
Job Title: Head of Customer Success

Salary: Up to £60,000

About IMP

At IMP we help Multi-Academy Trusts (MATs) take control of their finances. Our MAT-first software is built by people who know the sector inside out. Former trust professionals, finance experts and product specialists are all part of our team. More than half of all MATs in the UK already use IMP to plan with confidence, simplify complex processes and make smarter decisions.

We’re proud to be independent, founder-led and growing fast. Alongside our award-winning products, we’ve built a culture we’re equally proud of. We are ranked as one of the UK’s Top 25 Great Places to Work for mid-sized companies. Respect, collaboration and personal growth sit at the heart of how we work. You’ll find flexibility, support and opportunities to develop here, alongside regular team socials and funded CPD.

Role Description:

The Head of Customer Success leads the team that makes sure our customers get the value they bought. Once a trust is live on an IMP product, your team is the one thinking about them: whether they are using what they have, whether they are getting results from it, what they will need next, and what might get in the way.

The job in one line: make sure our customers have what they need before they have to ask for it.

As IMP scales, Customer Success becomes its own department with its own Head, separate from Support. This role shapes how it works: what the team does, how it works with Account Management, Support, Implementations and our R&D team, and what good looks like for our customers. You will not inherit a fully formed process. You will take what exists today and build it into one that works as we grow.

You work closely with R&D to know what is coming for each product and what customers will need from it, and you decide what customers should hear, learn and do ahead of a launch, then make it happen. You build the retention plan with the Head of Account Management. This is not a commercial role: renewal and expansion sit with Account Management, and you own the customer health and adoption work behind them.

This is a leadership role. You are accountable for customer outcomes and for the team, and you report to the Chief Customer Officer.

What the role is accountable for:

  • Successful customers: every live customer getting the value they bought, with the Customer Success team in front of the ones who need it before they have to ask.

  • The health of every live customer: a current read across the whole customer base, so the trusts that need attention are found early and acted on before they tell us.

  • Adoption: customers using what they have bought, with depth measured and worked on, not assumed.

  • Escalations prevented: problems headed off by a named intervention, not just escalations handled well.

  • The go-live handover: the named receiver of each customer handed over from Implementations, with the right to accept it or send it back.

  • The retention plan, built jointly with the Head of Account Management: Customer Success owns the health and adoption actions in it; Account Management owns the commercial outcome.

  • Customers knowing what is coming: a customer-facing view of each product's direction, kept current with R&D, and a regular rhythm of sessions that keeps live customers engaged and informed.

  • Customers staying successful through every product launch: what they need to hear, learn and do, planned and delivered before the launch lands on them.

  • A well-led team: clear portfolios, clear priorities, every person managed and developed.

Key responsibilities:

  • Have a view of every live customer: what they bought, how they are using it, who at IMP they deal with, and where they are heading.

  • Build and run the customer health framework using the data the business already holds: usage, support contact, engagement, renewal timing. Keep the read current across the whole customer base and act on what it shows.

  • Set priorities across the Customer Success team's portfolios and move effort to the customers who need it.

  • Receive every go-live handover from Implementations: agree the criteria, accept the customer or send the handover back with what is missing.

  • Build and run the retention plan with the Head of Account Management, and design how the two teams work together: who contacts which customer, when, and about what.

  • Give early warning to Support when a customer pattern shows a product or knowledge problem, and to Account Management when it shows a commercial one.

  • Work directly with R&D to understand what is coming for each product, and turn it into something customers can plan around.

  • Decide, for each launch and release, what customers need before it reaches them, and get the right people in to deliver it, from Customer Success, Support, Implementations or R&D.

  • Run a regular customer-facing rhythm of sessions on product direction and adoption, and own their content and attendance.

  • Give Support the customer demand signal ahead of a launch: what customers will ask, when, and in what volume.

  • Lead, manage and develop the Customer Success team: portfolios, objectives, one-to-ones, development plans.

  • Report monthly to the Chief Customer Officer on customer risk, health, adoption and launches supported, and feed the senior leadership team's view of customer risk.

  • Work through tooling rather than by hand: our CRM, our work management tools and AI, so the health picture stays current and the admin stays out of the job.

Skills, experience, and attributes:

  • You are customer obsessed. You have either led a customer success team in a B2B software business, or you have been an outstanding customer success lead and are ready and hungry to lead a team. Either way, you can show what changed for customers because you were there.

  • You think ahead of the customer. You can show where you spotted what customers would need, built it, and delivered it before they asked.

  • You are comfortable in a non-commercial seat: you can work alongside a commercial team, build a shared plan with them, and not need to own the number to care about it.

  • You have run customer-facing sessions at scale, such as webinars, user groups or product briefings, and you know what makes people turn up and come back.

  • You can hold a picture across a whole customer base, spot the ones drifting before they tell you, and act early.

  • You can build a process with a peer, agree the boundaries, and hold both teams to them.

  • You have worked closely enough with a product team to translate a roadmap into what it means for a customer, and to carry the customer's voice back without losing it.

  • You work through tooling and AI by default; a CRM such as HubSpot is an advantage, and appetite matters more than the track record.

  • You can lead a small team: set direction, give honest feedback, develop people.

  • Experience in education, MAT finance or a comparably regulated sector is welcome, but not essential.

Monitors delinquency queues, and reports non-compliance as needed for physicians. Reviews charts for billing and coding accuracy, May participates in audits, and ensures complete and accurate health records.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Game Developer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Game Developers to contribute to a pioneering customer project focused on evaluating and advancing AI capabilities in the domain of game creation and interaction. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Leverage your hands-on experience to build authentic debugging and feature challenges within real game projects, directly impacting how AI agents learn to analyze, play, and develop games. Developers from all backgrounds—whether from AAA studios, indie circles, or solo projects—are encouraged to participate.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and build small-scale game projects or interactive scenes in a major game engine to serve as the foundation for assessment tasks.
  2. Integrate realistic gameplay bugs that require thorough playtesting and on-screen analysis to discover and resolve.
  3. Develop multifaceted gameplay feature challenges that rely on multiple in-game systems and mechanics.
  4. Draft clear and concise briefs for each task, emulating the style of instructions from players, designers, or producers.
  5. Create comprehensive reference solutions—including both bug fixes and feature implementations—for every assignment.
  6. Define detailed success criteria, including input sequences, expected visual outcomes, and verifiable in-game states.
  7. Conduct end-to-end playtesting of each task to guarantee reliability and solvability.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated experience in game development, whether in AAA, indie, solo, or serious hobby contexts.
  2. A portfolio or verifiable published work (personal site, itch.io, Steam, GitHub, game jam entries, or shipped title credits). Your portfolio is the most important part of your application and plays a major role in our selection, so please include the work that best represents your skills.
  3. Advanced proficiency with at least one major game engine (Unity, Godot, Unreal), including editor tools, scene management, and debugging utilities.
  4. Comfort with engine scripting languages such as C#, GDScript, C++, or Blueprints, with the ability to interpret, troubleshoot, and enhance gameplay logic.
  5. Proven ability to identify and resolve gameplay issues through iterative playtesting.
  6. Strong written communication skills for drafting precise task instructions and acceptance criteria.
  7. Experience in game QA, technical design, systems design, automated testing, or prior contribution to AI evaluation projects is a plus.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Responsibilities are organized across four areas of focus. Prioritization is directed by the Divisional General Manager and may shift based on evolving business needs. When a vacancy is being covered, coverage takes priority and the remaining allocation adjusts.

Data, Insights and Storytelling

Communications and Operations

Field Support and Vacancy Coverage

  • Analyze performance: Track and analyze performance metrics across account, divisional, regional, and territory levels to generate actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making

  • Tell the story: Turn analysis into a clear business story. Build the narrative, visuals and recommendation for divisional and regional business reviews, leadership updates and home office presentations

  • Manage divisional resources and budget: Coordinate promotional programming, congress activities, and budget allocation to maximize business impact

  • Provide operational support to the regions: Support regional teams with business review preparation, account plan upkeep, program and congress execution, and systems and reporting needs
  • Potentially cover territory vacancies: Provide temporary coverage for vacant Area Business Manager territories. Maintain continuity with priority customers and accounts, keep account plans and call activity current, and protect in-flight commitments. Customer-facing coverage requires completion of product training and certification and full adherence to promotional compliance requirements
  • Support regional leadership vacancies: As directed by the Divisional General Manager, sustain the operating cadence, business planning and field communication of a region during a Regional Business Director vacancy. Personnel decisions (performance management, compensation, hiring) remain with the Divisional General Manager
  • Ensure effective transition: Deliver a structured handoff to the incoming hire, including account status, open commitments and customer history

  • Home office collaboration: Partner with head of oncology operations to support field level needs and functional tool assessments.

  • Support analytic and storytelling skills: Work with field team members one-on-one and in groups on building data-backed business stories and presenting them with confidence
  • Support National Planning Meetings (POAs): Collaborate with training and field teams to develop comprehensive POAs that align with organizational goals, and support planning and execution of POA meetings in conjunction with the POA Planning Group

At BCBSRI, our greatest resource is our people.

We come from varying backgrounds, different cultures, and unique experiences. We are hard-working, caring, and creative individuals who collaborate, support one another, and grow together. Passion, empathy, and understanding are at the forefront of everything we do—not just for our members, but for our employees as well.

We recognize that to do your best work, you have to be your best self.
It’s why we offer flexible work arrangements that include remote and hybrid opportunities and paid time off. We provide tuition reimbursement and assist with student-loan repayment. We offer health, dental, and vision insurance as well as programs that support your mental health and well-being. We pay competitively, offer bonuses and investment plans, and are committed to growing and developing our employees.

Our culture is one of belonging.
We strive to be transparent and accountable. We believe in equipping our associates with the knowledge and resources they need to be successful. No matter where you’re at in the organization, you’re an integral part of our team and your input, thoughts, and ideas are valued.

Join others who value a workplace for all.
We appreciate and celebrate everything that makes us unique, from personal characteristics to past experiences. Our different perspectives strengthen us as an organization and help us better serve all Rhode Islanders.

We’re dedicated to serving Rhode Islanders.
Our focus extends beyond providing access to high-quality, affordable, and equitable care. To further improve the health and well-being of our fellow Rhode Islanders, we regularly roll up our sleeves and get to work (literally) in communities all across the state—building homes, working in food pantries, revitalizing community centers, and transforming outdoor spaces for children and adults. Because we believe it is our collective responsibility to uplift our fellow Rhode Islanders when and where we can, our associates receive additional paid time to volunteer.

Why this job matters:


Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Rhode Island is seeking an analytical and financially oriented Enterprise Risk Management Analyst to join our Enterprise Risk Management team. This role will support the evolution of BCBSRI's ERM program by helping identify, assess, quantify, monitor, and report enterprise risks across the organization.


The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of enterprise risk management principles, business and financial analysis, and risk quantification methodologies. Candidates should be comfortable translating complex risks into financial impact estimates, supporting risk-informed decision making, and working with business leaders to evaluate risk exposure, mitigation alternatives, and risk-reward tradeoffs. Experience with FAIR (Factor Analysis of Information Risk) principles or other quantitative risk assessment methodologies is highly desirable.


What you will do:


  • Identify, assess, and monitor enterprise risks across strategic, operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and emerging risk domains.
  • Perform qualitative and quantitative risk assessments, including estimating potential financial impacts and supporting risk quantification efforts using FAIR principles and related methodologies.
  • Partner with business leaders to evaluate risk exposure, develop risk response strategies, and assess the effectiveness of mitigation activities.
  • Analyze risk trends, key risk indicators (KRIs), and business performance metrics to identify emerging risks and support proactive decision making.
  • Support development and maintenance of the enterprise risk register, including risk taxonomy, risk ratings, financial impact estimates, and risk reporting.
  • Prepare executive-level risk analyses, dashboards, presentations, and reports for senior leadership, board committees, and regulatory purposes, including ORSA-related activities.
  • Assist in the development and refinement of ERM methodologies, risk appetite measures, risk tolerance frameworks, and risk quantification capabilities.
  • Stay current on industry trends, economic conditions, regulatory developments, healthcare risks, and emerging risk management practices.

What you need to succeed:


  • Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Actuarial Science, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field from an accredited college or university or a high school diploma combined with significant relevant experience in enterprise risk management, financial analysis, audit, actuarial, banking, insurance, consulting, or related disciplines will be considered.
  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise risk management, financial analysis, risk consulting, internal audit, actuarial services, compliance, insurance, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Experience evaluating business risks and translating risk exposure into potential financial impact.
  • Working knowledge of FAIR principles, quantitative risk assessment methodologies, scenario analysis, or other risk quantification approaches preferred.
  • Strong proficiency with Excel and data analysis techniques, including financial modeling, trend analysis, and reporting.
  • Relevant certifications preferred but not required, including FAIR Analyst (FAIRA), CRISC, CRM, CERA, ARM, FRM, CIA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent.

The extras:


  • Strong understanding of enterprise risk management frameworks, including COSO ERM and quantitative risk management concepts.
  • Working knowledge of FAIR methodology concepts such as loss event frequency, probable loss magnitude, annualized loss exposure, and risk treatment analysis.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office; including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills.
  • Must be a self-driven, team player.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Knowledge of healthcare industry regulations and standards is a plus.

Location:
BCBSRI is headquartered in downtown Providence, conveniently located near the train station and bus terminal. We actively support associate well-being and work/life balance and offer the following schedules, based on role:

  • In-office: onsite 5 days per week
  • Hybrid: onsite 2-4 days per week
  • Remote: onsite 0-1 days per week. Permitted to reside in the following states, pending approval from the Human Resources Department: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia

Our culture of belonging at Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Rhode Island (BCBSRI) is at the core of all we do, and it strengthens our ability to meet the challenges of today’s healthcare industry. BCBSRI is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: About ERPS Group ERPS Group is a fast-growing accounting, tax, and business advisory firm dedicated to helping business owners build stronger, more profitable companies.
jobs.description:
About ERPS Group

ERPS Group is a fast-growing accounting, tax, and business advisory firm dedicated to helping business owners build stronger, more profitable companies. We provide accounting, tax planning, bookkeeping, payroll, CFO advisory, and business consulting services to clients across multiple industries.

Our mission is to deliver exceptional client service while helping entrepreneurs make informed financial decisions and achieve long-term success. We believe in professionalism, accountability, continuous improvement, and teamwork. Every member of our team plays an important role in creating an outstanding client experience.

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced U.S. Tax Preparer & Reviewer to join our growing team.
This position requires practical experience preparing U.S. tax returns, reviewing returns for accuracy and completeness before submission, and maintaining a strong understanding of U.S. federal and state tax regulations.

The ideal candidate is analytical, proactive, highly responsible, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with our U.S.-based team.

Key Responsibilities

1. U.S. Tax Return Preparation

Prepare accurate U.S. individual and business tax returns.
Work with various tax forms, including but not limited to Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.
Review financial statements, supporting documentation, and client-provided information to ensure accurate tax reporting.
Identify potential tax deductions, credits, and tax-saving opportunities within applicable tax regulations.
Ensure tax returns are prepared in compliance with current U.S. federal and applicable state tax laws.
Identify missing, inconsistent, or questionable information and request clarification when necessary.

2. Tax Return Review & Quality Control

Independently review prepared tax returns before submission to identify errors, inconsistencies, omissions, and potential compliance issues.
Verify calculations, supporting schedules, income reporting, deductions, credits, and tax liabilities.
Ensure all required forms, disclosures, and supporting documentation are included.
Identify potential tax risks and escalate complex or unusual tax situations to the appropriate manager or tax professional.
Maintain high standards of accuracy and quality while meeting established turnaround times.
Ensure all returns pass internal quality-control procedures before being finalized for filing.

3. Tax Research & Compliance

Maintain an up-to-date understanding of U.S. federal and state tax regulations.
Research tax questions and provide well-supported answers based on reliable IRS guidance and applicable tax authorities.
Stay informed about annual tax law changes, filing requirements, and regulatory updates.
Assist with resolving tax return discrepancies and responding to internal review comments.
Maintain proper documentation of research, calculations, and decisions.

4. Client Documentation & Workflow Management

Organize and maintain tax documents, workpapers, and client records.
Identify missing documentation and communicate outstanding requirements to the appropriate team members.
Maintain accurate records of assigned returns, progress, review status, and deadlines.
Work efficiently with the accounting and customer care teams to ensure a smooth tax preparation process.
Handle confidential financial and personal information with the highest level of discretion.

5. Team Collaboration & Accountability

Collaborate with U.S.-based tax professionals, accountants, and management.
Follow established company procedures, workflows, and quality standards.
Meet daily and weekly production targets without compromising accuracy.
Communicate proactively regarding delays, issues, or potential compliance concerns.
Take ownership of assigned returns from preparation through internal review and completion.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience preparing U.S. tax returns.
Demonstrated experience with both individual and business tax returns.
Strong knowledge of U.S. federal income tax regulations and familiarity with state taxation.
Practical experience reviewing tax returns for accuracy, completeness, and compliance before filing.
Strong understanding of IRS forms, instructions, and filing requirements.
Experience working with U.S. accounting and tax preparation software.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to understand complex U.S. tax terminology and communicate effectively with U.S.-based professionals.
Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.
Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple tax returns and deadlines simultaneously.
Ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet performance expectations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with professional tax preparation software such as ProSeries.
Experience working with QuickBooks Online and Desktop
Experience with U.S. accounting firms, CPA firms, or tax advisory companies.
Experience with real estate taxation, rental income, depreciation, S corporations, partnerships, and multi-entity business structures.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

What We Offer

Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
Long-term, full-time employment opportunity.
Opportunity to work with an established U.S.-based accounting and financial consulting firm.
Professional development and exposure to complex U.S. tax matters.
Collaborative international team environment.
Opportunities for career growth and advancement.

How to Apply

Please submit two links to : your resume and a 1-min video explaining why you’re the perfect fit for this role.

We're looking for a driven leader ready to help us 10X our impact while creating transformational results for our clients and team.


Important: Candidates must have actual professional experience preparing U.S. tax returns. General bookkeeping or accounting experience without direct U.S. tax preparation experience will not meet the requirements for this position.

3+ years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, preferably supporting U.S.-based businesses.
Advanced knowledge of QuickBooks Online/Desktop.
Strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and accounting principles.
Strong experience with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.

Strong bank and credit card reconciliation experience.
Experience with month-end closing and financial reporting.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to identify errors and discrepancies rather than simply entering data.
Excellent English written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with U.S. companies and U.S. accounting practices.
Experience with service-based businesses.
Experience working with multiple entities or businesses.
Familiarity with payroll transactions and payroll reconciliations.
Familiarity with sales tax accounting.

We are looking for someone who is:
Detail-oriented — small discrepancies do not get overlooked.
Proactive — you identify problems before they become bigger problems.
Accountable — you take ownership of your work and deadlines.
Organized — financial records are clean, structured, and easy to understand.
Analytical — you understand the numbers rather than simply entering transactions.

Confidential and trustworthy — you will be working with sensitive financial information.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role means:
Books are accurate and up to date.
Bank and credit card accounts are reconciled consistently.
AP and AR are properly maintained.
Invoices are issued accurately and on time.
Outstanding receivables are actively monitored.
Month-end closing is completed on schedule.
Financial reports are accurate and reliable.
Errors and discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly.
Management can rely on the bookkeeping records to make business decisions.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a 1-min video explaining why you’re the perfect fit for this role. We're looking for a driven leader ready to help us 10X our impact while creating transformational results for our clients and team.

IMPORTANT: Please do not apply if you only have basic QuickBooks or data-entry experience. We are specifically looking for a strong, hands-on full-charge bookkeeper who can own the bookkeeping function.

Director, Insurance Company Partnerships (ICP)

Leads Baldwin’s relationships with its insurance company partners (ICPs). Negotiates agreements, compensation, and program terms that create profitable growth for both Baldwin and the carrier. Owns the strategy, performance, and governance of Baldwin’s carrier relationships. Maximizes carrier compensation through profit share, contingent, and commission agreements. Relationship Management

jobs.description:
Description

We're looking for a hands-on Customer Success Engineer who owns customer relationships, drives customer outcomes, and enjoys solving complex data problems.

We're taking a different approach to Customer Success. Rather than primarily coaching customers on how to use Insycle, our team works directly in their environments to investigate problems, build solutions, and deliver results. Think of it as Customer Success with a Forward Deployed Engineer mindset.

With our secure Support Access, you'll be able to configure and test solutions directly in customers' Insycle environments. Customers retain control over approving and executing changes to their CRM data.

You'll own a portfolio of customers across onboarding, ongoing adoption, renewals, and expansion. You'll build relationships, understand customers' business challenges, and help them get lasting value from Insycle.

This role combines hands-on technical problem-solving with customer relationships and business understanding. You'll have the autonomy to investigate challenges, design practical solutions, and see your work make a difference.

Location: Remote. We're looking for candidates based in the Eastern or Central time zones who can collaborate effectively with our team and customers during U.S. business hours.

What you’ll do

Solve customer data challenges

  • Understand customers' business goals and translate their requirements into practical data solutions.
  • Investigate CRM records, fields, workflows, and existing configurations to understand problems and identify root causes.
  • Configure Blueprints, templates, matching rules, transformations, associations, assignments, and other Insycle capabilities on customers' behalf.
  • Test solutions against real customer data, review previews, investigate edge cases, and refine configurations until they produce the expected results.
  • Choose simple, reliable solutions that customers can understand and maintain, and follow through to ensure the original problem is resolved.

Drive adoption and customer outcomes

  • Lead customer onboarding, configuring initial use cases and helping customers achieve results quickly.
  • Help customers move from one-time cleanup to continuous data integrity using Blueprints, Data Logic, and Observability.
  • Proactively review customer usage, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and recommend additional use cases.
  • Monitor adoption, address challenges early, and help customers get sustained value from Insycle.

Build relationships and grow accounts

  • Own customer relationships across onboarding, ongoing use, renewals, and expansion.
  • Become a trusted partner by understanding customers' priorities, offering practical recommendations, and following through.
  • Identify opportunities to expand Insycle usage across teams, CRM objects, and business processes.
  • Communicate business value through measurable results, including time saved, data quality improvements, and reduced operational risk.
  • Proactively manage customer relationships, identify adoption and retention risks, initiate outreach when intervention is needed, and help customers achieve the outcomes that support renewal and growth.

Improve how we work

  • Share knowledge, document reusable solutions, and collaborate with teammates to solve challenging problems.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and contribute ideas to improve the product, onboarding, and customer experience.
  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to investigate problems, explore solutions, and improve workflows, while validating the results.
  • Take initiative to improve processes, learn from feedback, and help the team become more effective.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: You have 3+ years of experience in technical Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, Implementation, RevOps, or a similar customer-facing B2B SaaS role.
  • Customer account ownership: You have experience directly managing ongoing customer relationships or a portfolio of accounts, taking responsibility for customer outcomes, adoption, and retention—not solely responding to technical support requests.
  • Technical problem-solving: You enjoy investigating complex problems, working with data, asking thoughtful questions, and finding practical solutions.
  • CRM and data experience: You're comfortable with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms, including data management, business rules, workflows, and automation.
  • Ownership and initiative: You work independently, take responsibility for outcomes, and follow through without needing constant direction.
  • Customer communication: You can explain technical concepts clearly, understand business needs, and build strong customer relationships.
  • Judgment and attention to detail: You think through consequences, validate your work, and favor simple, reliable solutions.
  • Teamwork and growth: You enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, learning from feedback, and helping the team improve.

Experience with CRM data quality, deduplication, data transformation, record matching, or integrations is a plus. Software development experience is not required.

Why join Insycle

You'll work on real data challenges across a wide range of customers and industries, with the tools and autonomy to investigate problems and build solutions yourself. You'll see the results of your work directly and build strong relationships with the people you help.

We're a small team with an established product and ambitious plans. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we serve customers, improve our product, and help shape the next stage of Insycle's growth.

How we work

Our values shape how we work together, make decisions, and develop as a team:

  • Care deeply: Understand customers' needs and take initiative to help them succeed.
  • Everyone builds: Look for opportunities to improve how we work and contribute practical solutions.
  • Better together: Share knowledge, support teammates, and work toward shared success.
  • Quality counts: Think through the details, validate your work, and deliver reliable results.
  • Positive energy: Bring kindness, constructive communication, and a willingness to tackle challenges.
  • Own the outcome: Take responsibility, follow through, and deliver results.
  • Choose simplicity: Favor practical, reliable solutions over unnecessary complexity.
  • Raise the bar: Seek feedback, keep learning, and help others improve.

Compensation and benefits

  • Annual base salary of $80,000 - $100,000, depending on relevant experience and location.
  • Annual performance-based bonus with a target of 10% of base salary.
  • Equity through stock options.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) with a 4% company contribution.
  • Paid time off, sick leave, flexibility for unexpected needs, and paid holidays.

Company Overview

Insycle builds data integrity infrastructure for the agentic CRM. More than 700 customers trust our tools to resolve duplicates, standardize data, manage imports, and connect related records in platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce.

Those tools fix what’s wrong today. But clean data is a moment. Data integrity is a system.

Our platform helps businesses define what right looks like in Blueprints, continuously apply those standards through Data Logic, and use Observability to understand where data conforms, where it drifts, and whether it stays aligned over time.

As AI agents increasingly use CRM data to make decisions and write changes back, that foundation becomes essential. Businesses need reliable inputs and a system that detects when people, integrations, workflows, or agents move data away from their standards.

We’re a B2B SaaS company with an established customer base and a much larger ambition: to make data integrity foundational to how businesses operate with AI.

jobs.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

Sontiq is TransUnion’s identity protection and cyber safety business, helping consumers affected by identity theft, fraud, and data breaches protect and restore their identities through expert support and guidance. The team works closely with customers, clients, and internal specialists to provide timely assistance during challenging situations and make a meaningful difference throughout customers’ recovery journeys. This role offers an opportunity to develop expertise in identity protection and customer support within a collaborative, customer-focused environment. The position reports to the Associate Lead, Customer Support Operations.This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

As a Customer Service Incident Coordinator, you will support Arabic-, French-, and English-speaking customers and clients affected by fraud, data breaches, or identity theft. You will coordinate incident activities, maintain accurate records, and connect customers and clients with the appropriate internal and external resources.


This is a shift-pattern role: Wednesday to Sunday, 2.00pm-10.30pm

  • Interview customers and clients by telephone to gather information about suspected or confirmed data breaches, fraud, and identity theft.
  • Examine and analyse available information to assess incident severity and determine the assistance or remediation required.

  • Serve as a point of contact for customers, clients, and internal specialists, providing timely communication and coordinating discussions, meetings, escalations, and updates.

  • Prepare correspondence and coordinate communications with creditors, law enforcement agencies, government agencies, legal counsel, and other relevant third parties.
  • Consult with prospective and existing clients regarding breach incidents, remediation requirements, proposals, project schedules, document transfers, and customer communications.
  • Coordinate incident administration, including data review, letter production, client approvals, mailings, document transfers, and reporting on trends or unique customer situations.
  • Maintain complete and accurate case notes, monitor incident progress, support efficient case management, close resolved incident records, and provide final reports to clients or customers.

We know imposter syndrome is real, lets confront it so we can continue to grow and thrive together.

We recognise that our people need the freedom to balance their day-to-day lives with their work. This is why we’ve set out to create inclusive and flexible policies and practices for you to accommodate all your responsibilities and needs: children, family and beyond. If the role is advertised as full time, don’t let this stop you from applying. Let us know if you’re looking for a part time or flexible working arrangement and we can discuss this with you.

Additional support:

At TransUnion, we’re committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all individual’s talents and perspectives are valued. When you apply for a position with us, you’re not just joining a team, you’re becoming part of a community that celebrates differences and embraces equality. jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.

About the Role

We are seeking a Global Supply Sourcing Coordinator to join our team working remotely.

As a Global Supply Sourcing Coordinator, you will provide tactical sourcing solutions for depots, investigational medicinal products, couriers, and ancillary supplies. You will analyze complex study requirements, advise internal customers, and coordinate sourcing activities that help ensure compliant products and services are available when clinical studies need them.

You will join a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your work will support clinical study execution through supplier selection, sourcing, contracting, problem resolution, and supply planning. By building effective supplier relationships and offering out of the box solutions, you will help teams respond to urgent study needs while maintaining quality, compliance, and service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain close working relationships with internal and external customers and provide professional sourcing advice and assistance at all levels.
  • Monitor the quality, pricing accuracy, purchase requests, approvals, and purchase orders.
  • Conduct commodity research, regulatory requirements, supplier selection, and requests for information, quotation, and proposals.
  • Ensure products and services are obtained at budgeted prices and that ancillary materials and investigational products meet local requirements.
  • Coordinate the return of rental equipment and medical devices.
  • Own and action sourcing help desk tickets, create and execute Statements of Work, and complete on-demand sourcing activities that support study needs.
  • Anticipate sourcing challenges, take ownership through resolution, and work with suppliers to identify comparable compliant ancillary supplies.
  • Obtain required supplier and manufacturer documentation for import and export activities.
  • Take action on quality issues involving third-party suppliers and manage risk mitigation through resolution.
  • Assist internal customers with sourcing questions and system challenges and mentor junior team members.

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in sourcing, supplier coordination, analytical problem-solving, and project management
  • An operational understanding of clinical studies, clinical supply chains, and sourcing and contracting principles
  • A client-focused approach with the ability to work with urgency and accountability in a changing environment
  • The ability to collaborate across functions, work effectively in a matrix environment, and communicate across cultures
  • Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail when managing multiple priorities and tight timelines
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to learn new systems and processes
  • A flexible, self-motivated, and professional approach to assignments and continued learning

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, Master's degree, or equivalent in biology, pharmacy, another health-related discipline, international trade, business administration, or logistics, or relevant work experience
  • Operational understanding of clinical studies, related supply chain activities, sourcing, and contracting principles
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice, Good Distribution Practice, and Good Practice requirements
  • Strong Microsoft Office knowledge
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt to changing study needs
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Ability to prioritize work with tight timelines and significant urgency while maintaining attention to detail and first-time quality

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years of sourcing or procurement experience in a contract research organization or pharmaceutical environment
  • Knowledge of sourcing operations and supplier management
  • Cross-functional business team experience
  • Process and project management capabilities

Benefits and Compensation

  • Health, Vision & Dental Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Vacation/Holiday/Sick Time
  • Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
  • Work/Life Balance
  • 401(k) with Company match
  • Pet Insurance

jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. General Description:


BeOne is seeking an Associate Director, Enterprise Data Governance to build, enable, and scale enterprise data governance and stewardship capabilities across the organization. This role is a key member of the Enterprise Data Governance function and is responsible for operationalizing data stewardship within a federated governance model.


Working closely with the Head of Enterprise Data Governance, this position will serve as a subject matter expert (SME), translating governance strategy, policy, and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable business processes. The Associate Director will lead domain onboarding, drive stewardship adoption, and oversee strategic governance initiatives.


This role partners across business, technology, security, privacy, legal, and compliance teams to establish trusted, compliant, and well-governed data assets that support analytics, AI readiness, regulatory compliance, and business decision-making. The position will also provide leadership to managed service providers and junior governance resources while monitoring stewardship effectiveness through defined metrics and reporting.


Essential Functions of the Job:


  • Serve as a SME for enterprise data governance and data stewardship, contributing to governance operating models, policies, standards, processes, and best practices.
  • Lead onboarding of business and data domains into the federated governance framework, including role enablement, stewardship adoption, and governance process implementation.
  • Enable enterprise data discovery, transparency, and reuse through metadata management, data catalog, and data marketplace capabilities.
  • Implement metadata management, business glossary curation, and stewardship workflows.
  • Integrate governance processes across enterprise platforms and business workflows.
  • Influence the adoption of governance and stewardship practices without direct authority by building trusted relationships and aligning stakeholders around shared objectives.
  • Leverage automation and AI-enabled capabilities to improve stewardship efficiency and governance effectiveness.
  • Establish, monitor, and report governance KPIs, initiative progress, stewardship outcomes, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Partner with platform owners, architects, and data teams to ensure governance technologies effectively support stewardship, metadata management, data quality, and compliance requirements.
  • Author governance policies, standards, procedures, and operating models aligned with enterprise data management best practices.
  • Lead stakeholder engagement sessions, governance working groups, and training programs that drive accountability, stewardship, and sustained adoption.

Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of experience in data governance, data stewardship, enterprise data management, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a data governance SME within a federated, matrixed, or enterprise-scale operating model.
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes and drive adoption of governance processes, standards, and platforms without formal authority.
  • Experience leading cross-functional governance initiatives involving business, technology, and compliance stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and driving adoption of enterprise data governance platforms such as Informatica, Atlan, Alation, or similar solutions.
  • Experience enabling and training data stewards, data owners, and business stakeholders on governance processes and tools.
  • Experience with data classification, metadata management, data quality, and regulatory-aligned governance practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to navigate competing priorities across business and technology organizations.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating team members, managed service providers, or governance resources.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate governance strategy, policy, and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable operating processes.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience leading governance platform implementations and stewardship adoption initiatives (Informatica, Atlan, Collibra, Alation, etc…).
  • Strong facilitation skills, including governance workshops, onboarding sessions, and working groups.
  • Experience supporting Data-as-a-Product operating models on modern data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake.
  • Experience governing data within regulated environments, including GxP, clinical, R&D, or pharmaceutical domains.
  • Experience defining and reporting governance and stewardship KPIs to senior leadership.
  • Understanding of how metadata, stewardship, and data quality capabilities enable analytics, AI, and business outcomes.
  • Relevant certifications such as CDMP, DGSP, DCAM, DAMA, or equivalent credentials.

Supervisory Responsibilities:


  • Supervisory responsibilities are delivery-focused and include leading and providing direction for our managed service providers on certain projects, while providing strategic oversight and direction to junior data governance resources.

  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback

Cerence AI is the global leader in AI for transportation, specialized in building AI and voice-powered companions for cars, two-wheelers, and more that enable people to focus on what matters most. With over 500 million cars shipped with Cerence AI's technology, we partner with leading automakers (such as Volkswagen, Mercedes, Audi, Toyota and many more), mobility providers, and technology companies to power intuitive, integrated experiences that create safer, more connected, and more enjoyable journeys for drivers and passengers alike.

Our Driving Force

Our team is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of AI innovation, working around the globe with headquarters in Burlington, Massachusetts, USA and 16 other offices across Europe, Asia, and North America. We bring together diverse backgrounds, and varied skill sets with the shared goal of advancing the next generation of transportation user experiences. Our culture is customer-centric, collaborative, fast-paced, and fun, with continuous opportunities for learning and development to support your career growth.

Interested in having a significant impact in a dynamic industry with a high-performing global team? We’re looking for an exceptional SeniorPrincipalAI Scientist in Generative AI who is ready to drive the future of mobility with us!

What You Will Work On

  • Design and train large‑scale transformer and hybrid foundation models

  • Own model architecture choices across text, multimodal, and emerging paradigms

  • Diagnose and resolve training instabilities at scale

  • Navigate scaling tradeoffs across data, compute, and architecture

  • Define the technical direction for next‑generation models

Core Responsibilities

Deep Learning & Transformer Foundations

  • Apply strong fundamentals in deep learning and representation learning

  • Design and modify transformer architectures, including:

  • Attention variants

  • RoPE, ALiBi

  • Grouped Query Attention (GQA)

  • Mixture‑of‑Experts (MoE)

  • Build models from first principles, not just adapt pre‑existing codebases

OptimisationDynamics & Training Stability

  • Own optimizer and scheduler choices, including:

  • AdamW

  • Lion

  • Adafactor

  • Learning‑rate and warmup schedulers

  • Understand and debug:

  • Optimizer instability

  • Gradient pathologies

  • Divergence at large scale

Scaling Laws & Compute Tradeoffs

  • Apply and validate scaling laws

  • Navigate Chinchilla‑style compute vs data tradeoffs

  • Make informed decisions about model size, dataset size, and training duration

Loss Functions & Alignment

  • Design and experiment with loss functions including:

  • Next‑token prediction

  • Contrastive objectives

  • RLHF, DPO, GRPO

  • Understand how loss design impacts convergence, generalization, and alignment

Distributed Foundation Model Training

  • Design and execute large‑scale training using:

  • FSDP

  • ZeRO‑3

  • Tensor parallelism

  • Pipeline parallelism

  • Apply

  • Mixed precision (bf16, fp8)

  • Gradient checkpointing

  • Partner closely with ML systems teams while retaining architectural ownership

Architecture Innovation

  • Explore and implement novel model designs, including:

  • MoE routing strategies

  • Multimodal fusion architectures

  • SSM / hybrid architectures

  • Design architectures with KV cache efficiency and inference implications in mind

What Success Looks Like

  • Training remains stable as models scale in size and complexity

  • Architectural decisions are principled and defensible

  • Models converge faster and generalize better due to architecture and optimisation choices

  • Failure modes are understood, not mysterious

  • The organization develops true in‑house foundation model expertise

Required Experience & Skills

Strongly Required

  • Deep theoretical and practical understanding of modern deep learning

  • Hands‑on experience training large models from scratch

  • Ability to reason about optimization, not just tune hyperparameters

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, research‑driven environments

Critical Technical Skills

  • Transformer internals and attention mechanisms

  • Optimisationalgorithms and training dynamics

  • Scaling laws and compute/data tradeoffs

  • Distributed training strategies and mixed precision

  • Architecture innovation for large, real‑world models

Common Problems You’ll Be Solving

  • Why training diverges at scale

  • How optimizer dynamics interact with architecture

  • When scaling laws break down

  • The real tradeoffs between data, compute, and model design

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Content Production Manager

ABOUT AVID

Avid makes technology and collaborative tools so creators can entertain, inform, educate and enlighten the world. Our customers are the visionaries behind the most inspiring feature films, television programs, news broadcasts, televised sporting events, music recording and live concerts.

To learn how Avid powers greater creators or for more information, visit .

JOB SUMMARY

Avid is seeking a creative and technically skilled Content Production Manager to develop compelling content that educates, inspires, and engages media professionals. This role sits within the Marketing organization and is responsible for creating industry-specific content, thought leadership, technical demonstrations, and instructional assets that support integrated marketing campaigns, product launches, customer engagement programs, and social media initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines storytelling, technical fluency, and content creation expertise. They are comfortable developing content concepts, filming and editing video, creating product demonstrations, working with subject matter experts, and measuring content performance against defined business objectives. This role requires a highly collaborative individual who can bridge product expertise, industry insights, customer stories, and marketing strategy to produce content that drives awareness, engagement, and demand.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create industry-focused and technical content that delivers crucial storytelling and ‘so what’ to marketing campaigns, including but not limited to account-based digital marketing, customer lifecycle campaigns, web-based content, and content supporting product development.
  • Record, write, produce, and edit technical content, tutorials, workflow demonstrations, and "how-to" videos focused on Avid media solutions and post-production workflows.
  • Create engaging demonstrations, both recorded and live, of Avid media products that help customers understand features, workflows, and best practices through accessible and engaging content.
  • Support the development of customer success stories, interviews, panel discussions, and educational content featuring industry professionals.
  • Capture expert insights, testimonials, and customer perspectives that strengthen credibility and demonstrate real-world value.
  • Optimize content formats and storytelling approaches for channel-specific performance and multiple campaigns.
  • Collaborate on content calendars and campaign activation plans.
  • Manage content production processes from concept through final delivery, including filming, recording, editing, and packaging video content, graphics, screenshots, and supporting assets.
  • Deliver production-ready materials and creative briefs to Avid's Creative team for final design, formatting, and campaign deployment
  • Ensure content assets are delivered on time and as promised for campaigns, including adding content IDs to track performance.
  • Track content performance and effectiveness against campaign objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Analyze engagement, consumption, conversion, and audience insights to improve future content strategies; recommend optimizations based on performance data and feedback.

SUCCESS MARKERS

  • Consistent delivery of high-quality, performance-informed content that supports campaign and business objectives.
  • Growth in content engagement, viewership, and campaign performance, including digital and paid, email, social, web, and activations.
  • Increased utilization of content across marketing programs and channels.
  • Creation of impactful technical and educational content that drives product understanding and adoption.
  • Effective collaboration with internal teams, industry experts, customers, and creative partners.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • At least 3 years of experience in content marketing, content production, video production, digital marketing, or a related role.
  • Experience creating content across multiple channels and formats, including video, social media, educational content, and thought leadership.
  • Strong video recording and editing skills using professional editing tools.
  • Experience developing product demonstrations, tutorials, or technical educational content.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfortable interviewing subject matter experts, customers, and industry professionals.
  • Experience measuring content performance and optimizing content based on data and business objectives.
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and content distribution best practices.
  • Familiarity with campaign-driven marketing and integrated content planning.

Preferred:

  • Experience in media, broadcast, film, television, post-production, or creative technology industries.
  • Hands-on experience with Avid Media Composer, Pro Tools or other relevant Avid products.
  • Working knowledge of post-production workflows and media technology.
  • Experience managing YouTube channels or video-focused social programs.
  • Familiarity with content analytics and marketing performance tools.

jobs.title: CGI Automotive Artist (3Ds Max & V-Ray)
jobs.excerpt: INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands.
jobs.description:
INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE Digital verantwortest du die operative Steuerung in der Organisation. Über EVOLVE Digital

EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Founded in 2006, Pirkey Barber is one of the largest firms in the United States focused on trademark, trade dress, copyright, and unfair competition law. We are frequently recognized as one of the leading trademark firms in the country.

We are seeking a full-time Trademark Docketing Clerk with at least two years of full-time equivalent experience in trademark law to join our firm. What You’ll Do

  • Create new records as needed and assist in the docketing of transferred cases
  • Review and develop internal policies and procedures related to docketing
  • Ensure that loss of rights deadlines are cleared in accordance with firm policies
  • Assist with ensuring the integrity of internal and external contacts maintained in the database and handle global updates or reassignment of contacts as needed
  • Prepare reports and assist other department staff in the preparation of reports; customize standard reports as needed
  • Assist with client and firm projects as needed
  • Assist in ensuring the smooth operations of docketing support functions during their absence
  • Assist in training new assistants, paralegals, and associates on docketing processes and/or software as directed
  • Maintain confidentiality in all client and firm matters
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years' experience with the trademark prosecution process within a law firm setting is required
  • Bachelor's degree preferred
  • A comprehensive understanding of PTO rules and procedures for obtaining and maintaining trademark protection worldwide
  • Ability to apply that knowledge to review and docketing of inbound, outbound, and internal communications and related docketing requests
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and handle multiple, detailed tasks; availability to work overtime as needed
  • Ability to plan, organize and carry out multiple related activities
  • Excellent communication skills (oral, written, and interpersonal) and attention to detail with ability to follow up and follow through
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook; and a demonstrable ability to learn any department-specific software
  • Ability to maintain a professional demeanor in all situations and to work effectively and collaboratively in a culturally and educationally diverse team environment
  • Ability to adhere to the firm's policies, procedures, and core values.

Location:

Remote candidates will be considered in the following states: Arizona, Colorado, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Washington DC.

Pay: $25.00 - $36.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible schedule
  • Flexible spending account
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Retirement plan
  • Telehealth
  • Vision insurance

This position is not available to candidates who now or in the future will require U.S. visa sponsorship (including H‑1B, TN, or E‑3 visas).

jobs.excerpt: At Chase, we are passionate about creating memorable experiences for our clients and employees, making them feel welcomed, valued, and understood.
jobs.description:
At Chase, we are passionate about creating memorable experiences for our clients and employees, making them feel welcomed, valued, and understood. We build lasting relationships by doing the right thing, exceeding expectations, and embracing diversity and inclusion.

As a Virtual Banker II within Consumer Banking, you will represent our brand and culture with the utmost hospitality, using the latest banking solutions and cutting-edge financial technology combined with friendly and attentive service. You will engage clients via both inbound and outbound communication through phone and video, providing strong customer service. Your responsibilities include offering advice and sharing products and services to help them meet their financial needs, connecting them to our team of experts to assist with specialized financial needs, all while making them feel appreciated and embodying our commitment to being the bank for all.

Job Responsibilities
  • Foster a welcoming atmosphere by delivering attentive and friendly service, acting with a client-first attitude, and collaborating with team members to provide the most appropriate solutions.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to hospitality by consistently exceeding client expectations and creating a warm and inviting environment.
  • Handle inbound and outbound communication to engage in meaningful conversations, identify financial needs, and offer personalized financial solutions.
  • Cultivate strong client relationships through active listening, thoughtful questioning, and exceptional customer service, referring clients to our team of experts as needed.
  • Partner with One Chase Partners (Private Client Advisors, Home Lending Advisors, and Business Relationship Managers) to connect customers to experts for specialized financial needs.
  • Guide clients in utilizing technology self-service options such as the Chase Mobile App, Chase.com, and ATMs to enhance their banking experience.
  • Achieve or exceed performance metrics related to client engagement and referrals, while staying informed about Chase products, services, and industry trends.
  • Resolve client issues promptly and with attention to detail, ensuring a consistent and positive client experience.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • 1+ year of sales experience in Retail Banking, Financial Services, or other related industries with proven success in establishing new clients, deepening relationships, and delivering results.
  • Demonstrated client-first attitude with the ability to create a hospitable and friendly experience.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, showing genuine care and concern during client interactions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage clients clearly and courteously over the phone, video, and via email.
  • Proficiency in quickly and accurately learning products, services, and procedures.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as a team to deliver seamless service with care and sincerity.
  • Commitment to operating within established risk parameters and compliance obligations, completing required training efficiently.
  • Proven client service experience or comparable experience.
  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
  • Strong desire and ability to influence, educate, and connect customers to technology solutions.
  • Experience adhering to banking policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Experienced in retail banking, financial services, or a consultative customer relationship role in a related industry, such as hospitality service industries, with proven success in deepening client relationships and delivering results.
  • College degree or military equivalent.
Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act

This position is subject to the Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act qualification requirements for Loan Originators. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMC's review of your criminal conviction history, credit report, information available through NMLS, and any other information relevant to a determination by JPMC that you demonstrate financial responsibility, good character, and general fitness for the position. Note that any felony conviction within the last seven years will disqualify you from consideration for this position. Your continued employment in this position would be contingent upon compliance with Truth in Lending Act/Dodd Frank Loan Originator requirements.

In addition, this position requires National Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) registration under the SAFE Act of 2008. As such, upon active employment with JPMorgan Chase, you will be required to either register on NMLS, or to update your existing registration as necessary to grant access to and reflect your employment with JPMorgan Chase. Your continued employment in this position with JPMorgan Chase is contingent upon compliance with the SAFE Act, including successful registration immediately after your start date, and timely completion of annual renewal and required updates thereafter.

Any information obtained during the registration, update, and renewal processes or through NMLS notifications may impact your employment with the firm. Any of the completed information you provide during the Chase on-line application process may be transferred, on your behalf, to NMLS by JPMorgan Chase. Please carefully review the information you provide to Chase for accuracy and consistency and with any current NMLS record, if applicable, before submitting. We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description

Olsson provides multidisciplinary design services for some of the largest and most forward-thinking and desirable companies in the world to work for. We design large hyperscale data center campuses and colocation data centers throughout the U.S.. This role will give you the opportunity to work on some of the largest and most complex engineering-driven projects being built today. Our clients are relationship based and truly value the work we do for them, affording us the opportunity to contribute to society’s technological and connected community through the design of the critical infrastructure that is the foundation of these projects.

As a Project Civil Engineer on our Data Center Civil Team, you will be a part of the firm’s largest and most complex projects. You will serve as a project manager on some projects and lead design engineer on others. Prepare planning and design documents, process design calculations, and develop and maintain team and client standards. You may lead quality assurance/quality control and act as an advisor on complex projects. You will also coordinate with other Olsson teams, professional staff, technical staff, clients, and other consultants.

You may travel to job sites for observation and attend client meetings.

We have several current openings and will consider candidates interested in being located out of any Olsson office location, hybrid, or fully remote in various locations of the US. This role includes flexible work options to accommodate diverse working preferences and promote work-life balance.

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

  • Working collaboratively with others
  • Having ownership in the work you do
  • Using your talents to positively affect communities
  • Empowering others to use their talents

You bring to the team:

  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to contribute and work well on a team
  • Bachelor's degree in civil engineering
  • Must be a registered professional engineer
  • Proficiency in Civil 3D software
  • 6 or more years of related project experience

The salary range for this position correlates with our Colorado office locations and is commensurate with experience relative to the position.

Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, geographic location, skills, education, and internal equity.

Colorado Pay Range
$103,000—$135,000 USD

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

As an Olsson employee, you will:

  • Receive a competitive 401(k) match
  • Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths
  • Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements
  • Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities
  • Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles

In addition, full-time employees will receive our traditional benefits package (health care, vision, dental, paid time off, etc.) and the opportunity to participate in a bonus system that rewards performance.

Olsson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage qualified minority, female, veteran, and disabled candidates to apply and be considered for open positions. We do not discriminate against any applicant for employment or any employee because of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender, disability, age, military status, or other protected status.

Olsson understands the importance of privacy and is committed to protecting job applicants’ personal information. Pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (collectively, the “CCPA”), this notice explains Olsson’s practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information for job applicants residing in California. Please read this Notice carefully to understand our privacy practices.

The Translator’s role is to provide French translation, editing, proofreading and project management that maintain and strengthen the integrity of the Fidelity brand.
